translations.short_meaning_val: O Custódio: Aquele que protege o que criou, e Sua ciência abarca aquilo que Ele fez existir, protegeu seus aliados de caírem nos pecados e na destruição, e contabilizou as ações e a recompensa de seus servos.

english_name.name: Al-Hafīzh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hafīzh (The All-Preserver) is the One Who preserves what He created; Whose knowledge encompasses all that He brought into existence; Who protects His pious servants from committing sins and ruinous acts; and Who records their deeds and the recompense for them.

translations.name: O Provisor (Al-Muqít)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Provisor: Aquele que através de Sua sabedoria determina as provisões das criaturas, em seguida, conduz a ela com o Seu poder e distribui entre elas.

english_name.name: Al-Muqīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqīt (The All-Nourisher) is the One Who determines the sustenance of His creation according to His knowledge, brings it to them with His power, and distributes it amongst them.

translations.name: O Ajustador (Al-Hassíb)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Ajustador: Ele é o bastante para seus servos crentes que confiam n'Ele, o Sábio das obras de Seus servos e ajustador deles sobre as mesmas (obras).

english_name.name: Al-Hasīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hasīb (The Ever-Reckoner) is the One Who grants sufficiency to His believing servants who rely upon Him, and Who knows their deeds and holds them accountable for them.

translations.name: O Generoso (Al-Karim)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Generoso: Aquele que tem muita bondade e grandiosa beneficiência.

english_name.name: Al-Karīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Karīm (The Generous) is the One Who gives abundant good and welfare.

translations.name: O Observador (Al-Raqiib)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Observador: Aquele que observa todas as coisas, a testemunha dos segredos e coisas intimas, Aquele que sabe e vê, não se oculta segredo e nem confidência diante d'Ele.

english_name.name: Ar-Raqīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Raqīb (The Ever-Watchful) is the One Who watches over everything and witnesses inner thoughts and secrets, and Who knows and sees all things and no secret or private talk is hidden from Him.

translations.name: O Atendedor (Al-Mujíb)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Atendedor: Aquele que atende o pedido dos pedintes e a súplica dos suplicantes com respostas e aceitação.

english_name.name: Al-Mujīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mujīb (The All-Responsive) is the One Who responds to supplications by answering them and to requests by fulfilling them.

translations.name: O Munificente (Al-Wásií)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Munificente: Aquele que em cada atributo possui um significado mais íntegro e o poder mais perfeito.

english_name.name: Al-Wāsi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāsi‘ (The All-Embracing) is the One to Whom belongs the most perfect and complete meaning of every attribute.

translations.name: O Sapientíssimo (Al-Hakim)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Sapientíssimo: dotado de uma sabedoria completa nas suas ordens e sua legislação e um íntegro julgamento entre suas criaturas.

english_name.name: Al-Hakīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakīm (The All-Wise) is the One Who possesses perfect wisdom in His commands and legislations, and perfect judgment between His creation.

translations.name: O Afetuoso (Al-Wadúd)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Afetuoso: o Amoroso e o Querido, Aquele que ama seus profetas e mensageiros junto com seus seguidores e eles O amam.

english_name.name: Al-Wadūd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wadūd (The Most Affectionate) is the One Who loves and is loved. He loves His prophets and messengers and their followers, and they love Him.

translations.name: O Afetuoso (Al-Wadúd)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Afetuoso: o Amoroso e o Querido, Aquele que ama seus profetas e mensageiros junto com seus seguidores e eles O amam.

english_name.name: Al-Majīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Majīd (The Most Glorious) is the One Who possesses the various attributes of supreme majesty and perfection.

translations.name: O Testemunhador: (Ash-Shahid)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Testemunhador: Aquele que nada pode se ocultar d'Ele, pois Ele é observador de todas as coisas, é seu Testemunhador, Sábio com todos seus detalhes.

english_name.name: Ash-Shahīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shahīd (The Ever-Witness) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, rather He knows and witnesses everything and is Aware of its details.

translations.name: O Verídico (Al-Haqq)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Verídico: Aquele que sua existência é verdadeira, e que todos Seus nomes, Seus atributos, Suas ações, Suas regras e Sua recompensa, são perfeitos e verdadeiros. Não existe nada de falsidade.

english_name.name: Al-Haqq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Haqq (The Truth) is the True One in terms of His being and His existence; and the One Whose names, attributes, actions, judgments, and recompense are all perfect and true.

translations.name: O Patrono (Al-Wakil)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Patrono: o Patrono pela subsistência de Suas criaturas, o Mantedor de seus bons assuntos, e Aquele que assumiu Seus devotos e facilitou-lhes o caminho e afastou-lhes da dificuldade e lhes concluiu os assuntos.

english_name.name: Al-Wakīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wakīl (The Trustee) is the One Who guarantees the sustenance of His creation and manages their affairs and maintains their welfare; and Who supports His pious servants and, thus, guides them to ease, grants them sufficiency, and keeps them away from difficulty.

translations.name: O Fortíssimo (Al-Qawiy)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Fortíssimo: Aquele que tem força absoluta a qual ninguém o supera, e ninguém rejeita Seu decreto.

english_name.name: Al-Qawiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qawiyy (The All-Powerful) is the One with complete power Who cannot be overcome and Whose predestination cannot be repelled.

translations.name: O Inquebrantável (Al-Matín)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Inquebrantável: Aquele que é firme em Sua força e poder, não lhe alcança cansaço nem sobrecarga.

english_name.name: Al-Matīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Matīn (The Most Firm) is the One Who possesses infinite power and ability so He never experiences any weakness or hardship.

translations.name: O Tutor (Al-Wali)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Tutor: o apoiador de seus servos crentes e mantedor dos assuntos de todas as Suas criaturas.

english_name.name: Al-Walyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Walyy (The Guardian) is the One Who supports His believing servants and manages the affairs of all His creation.

translations.name: O Louvado (Al-Hamid)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Louvado: nome que mostra todos louvores e perfeições de Allah - o Altíssimo -, que merece o louvor pela Sua perfeição em Si próprio, em Seus nomes, atributos e ações.

english_name.name: Al-Hamīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hamīd (The Praiseworthy) is a name that denotes all the praiseworthy and perfect attributes of Allah Almighty, Who deserves praise for the perfection of His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: O Onivivente (Al-Hay)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Onivivente: Aquele que tem todo o significado de vida plena (perfeita) que não tem início e nem tem fim.

english_name.name: Al-Hayy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayy (The Ever-Living) is the One to Whom belong all meanings of perfect life that is not preceded by nothingness nor followed by doom.

translations.name: O Auto-Suficiente: (Al-Qayum)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Auto-Suficiente: Aquele que se mantém por Si mesmo, não depende de ninguém, todas as coisas se mantêm através d'Ele, não há nada que não necessite d'Ele.

english_name.name: Al-Qayyūm
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Qayyūm (The Self-Subsisting) is the One Who is self-sustaining, so He does not need anyone, and everything depends on Him and none can dispense with Him.

translations.name: O Uno (Al-Wáhid)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Uno: Aquele que se unificou em todas as perfeições, em Si próprio, em Seus atributos e ações, não tem parceiro em nada dessas coisas.

english_name.name: Al-Wāhid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāhid (The One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His essence, attributes, and actions, and none shares any of this with Him.

translations.name: O Absoluto (As-Samad)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Absoluto: O Perfeito e Grandioso Senhor, o procurado em toda necessidade através do desejo e medo.

english_name.name: As-Samad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samad (The Eternal Refuge) is the Perfect Lord and the Magnificent Master to Whom everyone turns, out of hope and fear.

translations.name: O Poderoso (Al-Qádir)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Poderoso: Aquele que tem o poder completo, abrangente e perfeito, no qual nada o torna incapaz e nem perde o que foi pedido.

english_name.name: Al-Qādir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qādir (The Able) is the One Who possesses complete and comprehensive power, nothing can challenge Him, and none can escape His power or will.

translations.name: O Potentíssimo (Al-Muqtadir)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Potentíssimo: Aquele que tem o poder completo (no que executa) e nada pode abster.

english_name.name: Al-Muqtadir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqtadir (The Dominant) is the One Who possesses complete unopposed power.

translations.name: O Que adianta (Al-Muqaddim)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Que adianta: Aquele que promove as coisas e estabelece no seu devido lugar, adianta o que Ele quer dentre elas e atrasa o que quer.

english_name.name: Al-Muqaddim
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqaddim (The Advancer) is the One Who puts things in their due places, advancing what He wills and delaying what He wills.

translations.name: O Que atrasa: (Al-Mu'akhir)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Que atrasa: Ele é Quem atrasa as coisas que merecem atraso e coloca-as no seu devido lugar.

english_name.name: Al-Mu’akhkhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu’akhkhir (The Delayer) is the One Who delays things that should be delayed, thus putting them in their proper place.

translations.name: O Primeiro (Al-Awwal)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Primeiro: Aquele que nada existiu antes d'Ele.

english_name.name: Al-Awwal
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Awwal (The First) is the One before Whom there was nothing.

translations.name: O Último (Al-Ákhir)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Último: depois d'Ele, nada existe.

english_name.name: Al-Ākhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ākhir (The Last) is the One after Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: O Manifesto (Az-Zháhir)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Manifesto: Aquele que nada há acima d'Ele.

english_name.name: Azh-Zhāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Azh-Zhāhir (The Manifest) is the One above Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: O Oculto (Al-Bátin)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Oculto: Aquele cujo não há nada abaixo dEle.

english_name.name: Al-Bātin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Bātin (The Hidden) is the One beneath Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: O Magnífico (Al-Mutaal)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Magnífico: nome que mostra absoluta alteza de Allah em todos os sentidos: alteza de Si mesmo, alteza da autoridade e alteza do domínio.

english_name.name: Al-Muta‘āl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muta‘āl (The Exalted) is a name that denotes the absolute exaltation of Allah in all aspects: His essence, His status, and His power.

translations.name: O Bondoso: (Al-Bar)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Bondoso: o benfeitor que abençoou o servo por variadas dádivas.

english_name.name: Al-Barr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Barr (The Beneficent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of blessings upon His servants.

translations.name: O Remissório (At-Tawwab)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Remissório: é Aquele que encaminha o servo para o arrependimento e Ele aceita dele.

english_name.name: At-Tawwāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tawwāb (The Accepting of Repentance) is the One Who guides His servants to repentance and accepts it from them.

translations.name: O Indulgente (Al-Aafu)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Indulgente: Aquele que apaga os erros e perdoa os pecados.

english_name.name: Al-‘Afuww
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Afuww (The Pardoner) is the One Who erases misdeeds and pardons sins.

translations.name: O Compassivo (Al-Raúf)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Compassivo: que possui demasiada compaixão e misericórdia de seus servos.

english_name.name: Ar-Ra’ūf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Ra’ūf (The All-Kind) is the One Who is the most kind and merciful towards His creation.

english_name.name: Maalik-Ul-Mulk
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE ETERNAL POSSESSOR OF SOVEREIGNTY

The One who controls the Dominion and gives dominion to whoever He willed.

translations.name: Dono da Majestade e Nobreza (Zhul Jalal wal Ikram)
translations.short_meaning_val: Dono da Mejestade e Nobreza: Possuidor da grandiosidade, orgulho, misericórdia e bondade, o merecedor de enaltecimento e louvor.

english_name.name: Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām (Lord of Majesty and Bounty) is the Possessor of greatness, pride, mercy, and bounty, Who deserves glorification and praise.

translations.name: O Opulento (Al-Ghani)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Opulento: Aquele que todas criaturas necessitam e Ele não necessita de ninguém.

english_name.name: A-Ghanyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿A-Ghanyy (The Self-Sufficient) is the One Who is needed by all and Who does not need anyone.

translations.name: O Guiador (Al-Hadi)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Guiador: Aquele que orienta seus servos para todas as coisas benéficas e a se abster de coisas prejudiciais, e concede sucesso a quem Ele quer dentre eles (servos).

english_name.name: Al-Hādi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hādi (The Guide) is the One Who guides His servants to all beneficial things and leads them away from harmful ones, and Who leads whomever He wills to guidance.

translations.name: O Herdeiro (Al-Wárith)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Herdeiro: Aquele que permanece após o fim da criatura, Aquele que herda a terra e quem estiver sobre ela.

english_name.name: Al-Wārith
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wārith (The Inheritor) is the One Who lasts after the doom of all creation and Who inherits the earth and all that is in it.

translations.name: O Belo (Al-Jamil)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Belo: Aquele que possui uma beleza absoluta em Si mesmo, em Seus nomes, atributos e ações.

english_name.name: Al-Jamīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jamīl (The Beautiful) is the One Who possesses absolute beauty in His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: O Dominador (Al-Qáhir)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Dominador: Aquele que todas as criações se sujeitam a Ele, e a Ele se submetem todas as criaturas e se rebaixam pelo Seu poder e Sua vontade.

english_name.name: Al-Qāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qāhir (The Vanquisher) is the One to Whom all beings submit and before Whose power and will all beings stand humbly.

translations.name: O Próximo (Al-Qaríb)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Próximo: Aquele que é próximo de Seu servo (obediente) ao lhe recompensar, e de Seu suplicante ao atendê-lo e próximo dos restantes servos através do conhecimento, e Ele não contradiz a Sua alteza - Glorificado seja -.

english_name.name: Al-Qarīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qarīb (The Near) is the One Who is near His obedient servants with reward; near those who supplicate Him with the answer; and near the rest of His servants with knowledge. This does not contradict His being high above.

translations.name: O Senhor (Al-Rabb)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Senhor: Ele é o Senhor, o Dono que mantém suas criações, o Criador de seus servos com o conveniente e variadas dádivas.

english_name.name: Ar-Rabb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rabb (The Lord) is the Master, the Owner, the Reformer, and the One Who fosters His servants by managing their affairs and bestowing favors upon them.

translations.name: O Evidente (Al-Mubin)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Evidente: Aquele cujo assunto é evidente, em Sua unicidade, e que Ele não tem parceiros, e Aquele que evidencia a verdade para os seus servos.

english_name.name: Al-Mubīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mubīn (The Evident) is the One Who is evident in His Oneness and that He has no partner, and Who clarifies the truth to His servants.

translations.name: O Concessor (Al-Muati)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Concessor: Que se unifica em dar verdadeiramente, ninguém impede o que Ele concede e ninguém concede o que Ele impede.

english_name.name: Al-Mu‘ti
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu‘ti (The Giver) is the only One Who gives, and no one can withhold what He has given or give what He has withheld.

translations.name: O Suficiente (Al-Kafi)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Suficiente: Aquele que provê para seus servos tudo o que necessitam d'Ele, e Aquele que é suficiente em seu auxílio aos outros e prescinde-se dos outros fora d'Ele.

english_name.name: Al-Kāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kāfi (The All-Sufficient) is the One Who fulfills all the needs of His servants and Who is sufficient for them beyond need for anyone else.

translations.name: O Ímpar (Al-Witr)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Ímpar: Ele é Único, que não tem parceiro e nem semelhante.

english_name.name: Al-Witr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Witr (The Odd) is the One Who has no partner or equal.

translations.name: O Único (Al-Ahad)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Único: é aquele que se unificou em todas as perfeições, no Seu senhorio, na Sua adoração e nos Seus nomes e atributos, onde nenhum parceiro compartilha com ele.

english_name.name: Al-Ahad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ahad (The Only One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His lordship, divinity, names, and attributes, and none shares any of them with Him.

translations.name: O Generoso em Sua dádiva (Al-Jawad)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Generoso em Sua dádiva: Aquele que muito concede e o Seu conceder abrange todas as criaturas.

english_name.name: Al-Jawād
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jawād (The Munificent) is the One Who gives abundantly to all creatures.

translations.name: O Terno (Ar-Rafíq)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Terno: Aquele que é ameno nos assuntos, é gradativo neles, Aquele que não se apressa na punição dos desobedientes (pecadores).

english_name.name: Ar-Rafīq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rafīq (The Kind) is the One Who acts deliberately and gradually, and does not hasten to punish sinners.

translations.name: O Senhor (As-Sayid)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Senhor: o Senhor, o Soberano, Dono da verdadeira nobreza, Aquele para o qual a criatura volta-se nos assuntos mundanos e do Além.

english_name.name: As-Sayyid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Sayyid (The Master) is the Lord and the Owner, the One Who possesses true dominance, and to Whom all creation turns for their worldly and their Hereafter affairs.

translations.name: O Glorificado (As-Subbúh)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Glorificado: Aquele que é livre de toda imperfeição e defeito, Aquele que é santificado e exaltado por todos que estão nos céus e na terra.

english_name.name: As-Subbūh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Subbūh (The All-Glorious) is the One far exalted above deficiencies and defects and Who is extolled and glorified by all those in the heavens and the earth.

translations.name: O Curador (Al-Sháfii)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Curador: Aquele que cura os servos das doenças do corpo, as dúvidas do coração e as obscenidades das almas.

english_name.name: Ash-Shāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shāfi (The Healer) is the One Who cures His servants from the illnesses of their bodies, the doubts of their hearts, and the vain desires of their selves.

translations.name: O Retribuidor (Al-Shákr)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Retribuidor: Elogia e enaltece quem O adora, recompensa a ação pela sua obediência acima daquilo que merece.

english_name.name: Ash-Shākir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shākir (The Appreciative) is the One Who praises those who obey Him and rewards them beyond what is due to them.

translations.name: O Puro (At-Tayib)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Puro: Ele, o Altíssimo é puro e livre de todas as imperfeições e defeitos.

english_name.name: At-Tayyib
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tayyib (The Good) means that Allah Almighty is extolled and exalted far above all deficiencies and defects.

translations.name: O Puro (At-Tayib)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Puro: Ele, o Altíssimo é puro e livre de todas as imperfeições e defeitos.

english_name.name: Al-A‘la
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-A‘la (The Most High) is a name that denotes the affirmation of all meanings of highness for Allah Almighty from every aspect: highness in His essence, highness in His status, and highness in His power.

translations.name: O Onipotente (Al-Qadir)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Onipotente: é Quem possui o poder perfeito que não demonstra incapacidade e nem relaxamento.

english_name.name: Al-Qadīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qadīr (The Omnipotent) is the One Who possesses complete power and does not suffer any incapability or fatigue.

translations.name: O Que faz mercê (Al-Mannan)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Que faz mercê: Ele concede dádivas, grandioso ofertador que através da bondade concede dádiva antes de ser pedido.

english_name.name: Al-Mannān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mannān (The Bestower of Favors) is the One Who bestows great favors and gives blessings to His servants before they ask for them.

translations.name: O Abarcador (Al-Muhit)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Abarcador: nome que indica a alteza de Allah sobre suas criaturas, e Ele abarca todas as coisas através da sua ciência, poder e domínio.

english_name.name: Al-Muhīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhīt (The All-Encompassing) is a name that denotes the exaltedness of Allah above His creation and that He encompasses everything in terms of knowledge, power, and subjugation.

translations.name: O Mais Generoso (Al-Akram)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Mais Generoso: Aquele que concede e oferece demasiadamente, Aquele que todo o bem está em Suas mãos e todo o bem provém d'Ele - Glorificado seja.

english_name.name: Al-Akram
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Akram (The Most Generous) is the One Who gives generously, and all goodness lies in His hand and comes from Him.

translations.name: A Divindade (Al-Ilah)
translations.short_meaning_val: A Divindade: O que reúne todos atributos de perfeição e denominações de majestade, o adorado cujo ninguém merece a adoração exceto Ele.

english_name.name: Al-Ilāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ilāh (The God) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection and majesty and Who alone is worthy of being worshiped.

translations.name: O Auxiliador (An-Nassír)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Auxiliador: Aquele que apoia e ajuda Seus servos crentes.

english_name.name: An-Nasīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿An-Nasīr (The Helper) is the One Who helps and supports His believing servants.

translations.name: O Protetor (Al-Maula)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Protetor: Protetor de todas as criaturas, significa que Ele é seu Senhor e Dono, o Criador e o verdadeiro Adorado por eles; Protetor de Seus servos crentes, ama-os e ajuda-os e faz chegar a eles o que lhes beneficia e facilita-lhes seus interesses religiosos e mundanos.

english_name.name: Al-Mawla
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mawla (The Protector) of all creation is their Master, Owner, Creator, and True Deity worthy of worship; and Al-Mawla of the believing servants is the One Who loves them, guides and supports them, and leads them to their religious and worldly interests.

translations.name: O Envergonhado (Al-Haiyi)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Envergonhado: isto é, que tem muita vergonha, mas um tipo de vergonha compatível a Ele e não como a vergonha das criaturas, mas aquela em que Ele deixa aquilo que não é adequado para a Sua ampla misericórdia, sua perfeita virtude, generosidade e o Seu grandioso perdão e tolerância.

english_name.name: Al-Hayiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayiyy (The Modest) is the One Who is very modest. This description befits Allah Almighty and it is nothing like the modesty of people. Rather, it means abandoning what does not suit His vast mercy, perfect generosity, and great forgiveness and forbearance.

translations.name: O Benfeitor (Al-Muhssin)
translations.short_meaning_val: O Benfeitor: Aquele que concede variados tipos de bençãos, aparentes e ecultas, a seus servos.

english_name.name: Al-Muhsin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhsin (The Superb Benevolent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of outward and inward favors upon His servants.

translations.name: اللہ
translations.short_meaning_val: اللہ : جو حقیقی طور پر عبادت کے لائق اور پرستش کا سزاوار ہے اور اس بات کا حق دار ہے کہ اس سے محبت کی جائے، امیدیں وابستہ کی جائیں اور ڈرا جائے۔ یہ لفظ اللہ کے تمام اسمائے حسنی کا جامع اور اس کی تمام صفات کو شامل ہے۔

english_name.name: Allāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Allah is the deity worthy of being worshiped out of love, hope, and fear. This name encompasses all the meanings of the beautiful names and attributes of the Almighty Lord.

translations.name: رحمان
translations.short_meaning_val: رحمان : لامحدود اور بے پناہ رحمتوں والا، جس کی رحمت کے دائرے سے کوئی چیز باہر نہیں۔

english_name.name: Ar-Rahmān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahmān (The Most Compassionate) is the One with great and immense mercy that encompasses everything.

translations.name: رحیم
translations.short_meaning_val: رحیم: بڑی رحمتوں والا، جس کی رحمت مخلوق سے جڑی ہوئی ہے۔

english_name.name: Ar-Rahīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.

translations.name: بادشاہ
translations.short_meaning_val: المَلِك (بادشاہ) : جو عظمت، غلبہ اور تدبیر کی صفات سے متصف ہے، تمام چیزوں کا مالک ہے اور ان کے بارے میں جیسے چاہتا ہے تصرف کرتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Malik
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.

translations.name: ہر نقص و عیب سے پاک
translations.short_meaning_val: القُدُّوس (ہر نقص و عیب سے پاک) : ہر طرح کی کمیوں سے پاک اور اس بات سے بالا و برتر کہ اس کی کوئی مخلوق اس کی طرح ہو۔

english_name.name: Al-Quddūs
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Quddūs (The Holy One) is the Glorified One Who is exalted far above any defect and far above resembling any of His creation.

translations.name: نقائص اور عیوب سے پاک
translations.short_meaning_val: نقائص و عیوب سے پاک : وہ ذات، جو ہر نقص، آفت اور عیب سے پاک ہو۔

english_name.name: As-Salām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ As-Salām (The Source of Perfection) is the One free from any defect or fault.

translations.name: تصدیق کرنے والا اور امن دینے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: المُؤْمِن (تصدیق کرنے والا اور امن دینے والا) : جو اپنے نبیوں کو دلیلیں اور معجزے عطا کرکے ان کی سچائی کو عالم آشکارا کرتا ہے اور اپنے مکمل وصف عدل کی بنیاد پر مخلوقات کو ظلم سے محفوظ رکھتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Mu’min
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.

translations.name: نگہبان
translations.short_meaning_val: المُهَيْمِن (نگہبان) : وہ ذات جو مخلوق کی نگہبان، حاکم، انھیں اپنے حساب سے چلانے والی اور ان کی پوری خبر رکھنے والی ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Muhaymin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhaymin (The All-Controller) is the Guardian over His creation, their Ruler, and the Disposer of all their affairs, Who encompasses everything in His knowledge.

translations.name: غالب
translations.short_meaning_val: العزيزُ (غالب) : وہ ذات جو کامل عزت کی مالک ہو اور اپنی طاقت و قوت اور بالادستی کی بنا پر ہر چیز پر غالب ہو۔

english_name.name: Al-‘Azīz
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azīz (The All-Mighty) is the One Who possesses the absolute might and vanquishes all others with His power, dominance, and invincibility.

translations.name: زور آور
translations.short_meaning_val: الجَبَّار (زور آور) : وہ ذات جو اپنی مخلوق سے بالا و برتر ہو، ہر چیز پر غالب ہو، ہر چیز اس کی فرماں برداری کرتی اور اس کے آگے جھکتی ہو اور جو بھی اس کی پناہ میں آئے اس کی تسلی کا سامان کرتی ہو۔

english_name.name: Al-Jabbār
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.

translations.name: بڑائی والا
translations.short_meaning_val: المُتَكَبِّر (بڑائی والا) : وہ ذات جو اس قدر کامل اور صاحب جلال ہے کہ ہر برائی، نقص اور عیب سے برتر و بالا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Mutakabbir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mutakabbir (The Supreme) is the One Who is far exalted above evil, deficiency, and defects, given His perfection and majesty.

translations.name: خالق
translations.short_meaning_val: خالق : جس نے کسی نمونے کے بغیر ساری چیزوں کو وجود بخشا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Khāliq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khāliq (The Creator) is the One Who brings things into existence and invents them in an unprecedented way.

translations.name: پیدا کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: البَارِئُ (پیدا کرنے والا) : وہ ذات جس نے تمام موجود چیزوں کو پیدا کیا، صورت بخشی اور عدم سے وجود عطا کیا۔

english_name.name: Al-Bāri’
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Bāri’ (The Initiator) is the Creator Who created the whole creation from nothing and gave them forms after they were non-existent.

translations.name: صورت گری کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: المُصَوِّر (صورت گری کرنے والا) : جس نے مخلوقات کو الگ الگ شکل و صورت دے کر پیدا کیا، جو اس کے علم و حکمت کی دلیل ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Musawwir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Musawwir (The Supreme Fashioner) is the One Who fashioned His creation in different forms and appearances that indicate His perfect knowledge and wisdom.

english_name.name: Al-Ghaffaar
english_name.short_meaning_val:
AL-Ghaffaar (The Great Forgiver)

The Forgiver, The One who forgives the sins of His slaves time and time again

english_name.name: Al-Qahhār
english_name.short_meaning_val: THE ALL-PREVAILING ONE
english_name.meanings_val: <p><span style="font-size: 19px; color: #202122; font-weight: normal; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Arial'; font-style: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none;">The Dominant, The One who has the perfect Power and is not unable over anything.</span></p>

translations.name: بہت زیادہ دینے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الوَهَّاب (بہت زیادہ دینے والا) : جو بڑے پیمانے پر نوازنے والا اور عطا کرنے والا ہے اور جس کی نوازش اور سخاوت سے ساری کائنات مستفید ہو رہی ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Wahhāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wahhāb (The Bestower) is the One Who gives abundantly, and Whose generosity and bounty encompass all beings.

translations.name: بہت زیادہ روزی دینے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الرَّزَّاق (بہت زیادہ روزی دینے والا) : وہ جس نے بندوں کو روزی دینے کا ذمہ لے رکھا ہے، جو ان کے جسمانی اور روحانی نشو و نما کے لیے بے حد ضروری ہے۔

english_name.name: Ar-Razzāq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Razzāq (The All-Provider) is the One Who guarantees His servants the sustenance that maintains their hearts and bodies.

translations.name: فیصلہ کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الفَتَّاح (فیصلہ کرنے والا) :جو اپنے بندوں کے بیچ اپنے شرعی احکام کے ذریعے حکم صادر کرتا ہے، ان کے درمیان اپنے قدری احکام کے ذریعے فیصلہ کرتا ہے اور ان کا اپنے جزا و سزا پر مبنی احکام کے ذریعے محاسبہ کرتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Fattāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Fattāh (The Greatest Judge) is the One Who judges between His servants by His religious rulings, decrees His predestination for them, and calls them to account.

translations.name: جاننے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: ﻿العَلِيمُ (جاننے والا) : وہ ذات جس نے ہر چیز کو اپنے علم کے دائرے میں لے رکھا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-‘Alīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alīm (The All-Knowing) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses everything.

english_name.name: Al-Qaabid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE RESTRICTING ONE

The Constrictor, The Withholder, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Baasit
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE EXTENDER

The Englarger, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Khaafid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE REDUCER

The One who lowers whoever He willed by His Destruction and raises whoever He willed by His Endowment.

translations.name: بلند کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الرَّافِع (بلند کرنے والا) : وہ جسے چاہتا ہے، جیسا چاہتا ہے، بلندی عطا کرتا ہے۔ جیسے اپنے اولیا کو دنیا اور آخرت کی سربلندی عطا کرتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Ar-Rāfi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Rāfi‘ (The Raiser) is the One Who raises whomever He wills the way He wills, as He elevates the ranks of His pious servants in this world and in the Hereafter.

translations.name: سننے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: السَّمِيْع (سننے والا) : وہ جو تمام سنی جانے والی چیزوں کو سنتا ہے۔ چپکے سے کہی جانے والی بات اور سرگوشی بھی اس کے دست رس کے اندر ہے اور زور سے بولنا اور آہستہ بولنا نیز بولنا اور خاموش رہنا سب اس کے حق میں برابر ہے۔

english_name.name: As-Samī‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samī‘ (The All-Hearing) is the One Who hears everything. He hears secret and private talk. Loud and low voices, and speaking and silence are all the same to Him - He grasps all.

translations.name: دیکھنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: البَصِيرُ (دیکھنے والا) : وہ ذات جس کے دیکھنے کے دائرے سے کوئی چیز باہر نہ ہو، جو ہر چھوٹی بڑی چیز کو دیکھ رہی ہو، اس کی خبر رکھتی ہو اور اس کی اندرونی باتوں سے واقف ہو۔

english_name.name: Al-Basīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Basīr (The All-Seeing) is the One Whose sight encompasses everything, no matter how small or minute they may be, and He is the One Who is All-Aware of everything and All-Knowing of their hidden aspects.

translations.name: فیصلہ کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الحَكَم (فیصلہ کرنے والا) : جو ہر چیز کا فیصلہ کرتا ہے، اور وہ جیساچاہتا ہے کرتا ہے اور اپنے بندوں کے بیچ حق اور انصاف کی بنیاد پر فیصلہ کرتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Hakam
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakam (The Judge) is the One to Whom belongs judgment in all things, and Who ordains what He wills and judges between His servants with the truth and justice.

translations.name: باریک بیں
translations.short_meaning_val: اللطِيْف (باریک بیں) : جس سے کوئی چیز، خواہ کتنی چھوٹی ہو، چھپی نہیں رہتی اور جو اپنے بندوں کے ساتھ احسان و نرمی کا برتاؤ کرتا ہے اور انھیں ایسے کاموں کی توفیق دیتا ہے جو ان کے حق میں اچھے ہوں۔

english_name.name: Al-Latīf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Latīf (The All-Subtle) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, no matter how small it may be, and the One Who shows kindness and leniency to His servants and guides them to what is good for them.

translations.name: خبر رکھنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: خبر رکھنے والا : جو تمام چیزوں کے ظاہر و باطن سے واقف ہو۔

english_name.name: Al-Khabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khabīr (The All-Aware) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses the inward and hidden aspects of things, as well as their outward aspects.

translations.name: بُردبار
translations.short_meaning_val: الحَلِيْم (بُردبار) : وہ بُردبار ہستی، جو اپنے بندوں کے گناہوں کی سزا دینے میں جلدی نہیں کرتی۔

english_name.name: Al-Halīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Halīm (The Forbearing) is the One Who possesses deliberation and does not hasten to punish His servants for their sins.

translations.name: عظیم
translations.short_meaning_val: عظیم : وہ ذات جس کے اندر کمال، بزرگی، بڑائی اور عظمت کی تمام صفتیں پائی جاتی ہیں اور جس کی محبت دلوں میں بسی ہوئی ہے اور جس کی عظمت کی خوشبو ہر روح میں سمائی ہوئی ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-‘Azhīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azhīm (The Magnificent) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection, glory, pride, and majesty, and Who is loved and extolled by His servants.

translations.name: بخشنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الغَفُوْر (بخشنے والا) : وہ ذات، جو اپنے بندوں کو ان کے گناہوں کے شر سے بچاتی ہے اور انھیں اس پر سزا نہیں دیتی۔

english_name.name: Al-Ghafūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ghafūr (The All-Forgiving) is the One Who spares His servants the evil of their sins and does not punish them.

translations.name: نہایت قدردان
translations.short_meaning_val: الشَّكُوْر (نہایت قدردان) : جو چھوٹے چھوٹے کاموں کی قدردانی کرتے ہوئے بڑے بڑے ثواب عطا کرتا ہے اور بہت سی لغزشوں سے درگزر کرتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Ash-Shakūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shakūr (The Most Appreciative) is the One Who appreciates even little deeds and gives immense and multiple rewards in return, and Who forgives numerous errors.

translations.name: بہت بلند
translations.short_meaning_val: العَلِيّ (بہت بلند) : وہ ذات جو اپنی ہستی، مقام و مرتبہ اور غلبہ الغرض ہر اعتبار سے بلند و بالا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-‘Alyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alyy (The High) is the One Who possesses absolute highness in all aspects: His status, His power, and His essence.

translations.name: بڑا
translations.short_meaning_val: الكَبِيْر (بڑا) : وہ ذات جس سے بڑی کوئی چیز نہیں اور ہر چیز اس سے چھوٹی ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Kabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kabīr (The Great) is the One Who is greater than everything, and all else are inferior to Him.

translations.name: حفاظت کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الحَفِيْظُ (حفاظت کرنے والا) : جو اپنی پیدا کردہ تمام چیزوں کی حفاظت کرتا ہے، ساری مخلوقات کا علم رکھتا ہے، اپنے اولیا کو گناہوں سے بچاتا ہے اور بندوں کے اعمال کا حساب رکھتے ہوئے انھیں ان کے مطابق بدلہ دیتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Hafīzh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hafīzh (The All-Preserver) is the One Who preserves what He created; Whose knowledge encompasses all that He brought into existence; Who protects His pious servants from committing sins and ruinous acts; and Who records their deeds and the recompense for them.

translations.name: روزی اتارنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: المُقِيْت (روزی اتارنے والا) : جواپنے علم کے مطابق مخلوق کی روزی متعین کرتا ہے، پھر اپنی قدرت سے انھیں روزی فراہم کرتا ہے اور ان کے درمیان تقسیم کرتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Muqīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqīt (The All-Nourisher) is the One Who determines the sustenance of His creation according to His knowledge, brings it to them with His power, and distributes it amongst them.

translations.name: كافی
translations.short_meaning_val: الحَسِيْب (کافی) : وہ جو اپنے اوپر بھروسہ رکھنے والے مؤمن بندوں کے لیے کافی ہے، ان کے اعمال کی خبر رکھتا ہے اور ان اعمال کی بنیاد پر ان کا محاسبہ بھی کرے گا۔

english_name.name: Al-Hasīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hasīb (The Ever-Reckoner) is the One Who grants sufficiency to His believing servants who rely upon Him, and Who knows their deeds and holds them accountable for them.

translations.name: کریم
translations.short_meaning_val: کریم : بڑی بھلائی اور عظیم نفع والا۔

english_name.name: Al-Karīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Karīm (The Generous) is the One Who gives abundant good and welfare.

translations.name: نگہبان
translations.short_meaning_val: الرَّقِيْب (نگہبان) : وہ جو ہر چیز کی خبر رکھتا ہے، چھپی ہوئی باتوں اور رازہائے سربستہ سے واقف ہے، جو ہر شے کو جانتا اور دیکھتا ہے اور کوئی مخفی سے مخفی بات اور سرگوشی اس سے چھپی نہیں رہتی۔

english_name.name: Ar-Raqīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Raqīb (The Ever-Watchful) is the One Who watches over everything and witnesses inner thoughts and secrets, and Who knows and sees all things and no secret or private talk is hidden from Him.

translations.name: دعا قبول کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: المُجِيْب (دعا قبول کرنے والا) : جو مانگنے والے کا دامن بھر دیتا ہے اور پکارنے والے کی مراد پوری کرتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Mujīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mujīb (The All-Responsive) is the One Who responds to supplications by answering them and to requests by fulfilling them.

translations.name: کشادگی والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الوَاسِع (کشادگی والا) : وہ جس کے اندر ساری خوبیاں اور اچھائیاں بدرجۂ اتم اور کامل ترین مقدار میں پائی جاتی ہیں۔

english_name.name: Al-Wāsi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāsi‘ (The All-Embracing) is the One to Whom belongs the most perfect and complete meaning of every attribute.

translations.name: حکمت والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الحَكِيْم (حکمت والا) : وہ ذات جو اپنے اوامر اور تشریعات میں کامل حکمت والی اور مخلوقات کے درمیان فیصلہ کرنے میں کامل و مکمل ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Hakīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakīm (The All-Wise) is the One Who possesses perfect wisdom in His commands and legislations, and perfect judgment between His creation.

translations.name: بہت زیادہ محبت کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الوَدُوْد (بہت زیادہ محبت کرنے والا) : یعنی جو محبت کرتا ہے اور اس سے محبت کی جاتی ہے۔ وہ اپنے نبیوں، رسولوں اور انھیں ماننے والوں سے محبت کرتا ہے اور یہ سب لوگ اس سے محبت کرتے ہیں۔

english_name.name: Al-Wadūd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wadūd (The Most Affectionate) is the One Who loves and is loved. He loves His prophets and messengers and their followers, and they love Him.

translations.name: بہت زیادہ محبت کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الوَدُوْد (بہت زیادہ محبت کرنے والا) : یعنی جو محبت کرتا ہے اور اس سے محبت کی جاتی ہے۔ وہ اپنے نبیوں، رسولوں اور انھیں ماننے والوں سے محبت کرتا ہے اور یہ سب لوگ اس سے محبت کرتے ہیں۔

english_name.name: Al-Majīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Majīd (The Most Glorious) is the One Who possesses the various attributes of supreme majesty and perfection.

translations.name: باخبر
translations.short_meaning_val: الشَّهِيْد (باخبر) : جس سے کوئی چیز اوجھل نہیں ہوتی، بلکہ وہ ہر چیز سے باخبرہے، ہر شے کو دیکھتا ہے اور اس کی تفصیلات سے واقف رہتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Ash-Shahīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shahīd (The Ever-Witness) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, rather He knows and witnesses everything and is Aware of its details.

translations.name: حق
translations.short_meaning_val: حق : وہ ذات جس کی ہستی اور وجود متحقق ہے اور جس کے اسما، صفات، افعال، احکام اور جزا سب کامل اور حق ہیں اور اس میں باطل کا کوئی گزر نہیں ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Haqq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Haqq (The Truth) is the True One in terms of His being and His existence; and the One Whose names, attributes, actions, judgments, and recompense are all perfect and true.

translations.name: کام بنانے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الوَكِيْل (کام بنانے والا) : مخلوقات کی روزی کا کفیل، ان کے مصالح کو دیکھنے والا، ساتھ ہی اپنے اولیا کا حامی و ناصر بن کر ان کے لیے آسانیوں کی راہ ہموار کرنے والا، انھیں مشکلات سے بچانے والا اور سارے معاملوں میں ان کی طرف سے کافی ہونے والا۔

english_name.name: Al-Wakīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wakīl (The Trustee) is the One Who guarantees the sustenance of His creation and manages their affairs and maintains their welfare; and Who supports His pious servants and, thus, guides them to ease, grants them sufficiency, and keeps them away from difficulty.

translations.name: طاقتور
translations.short_meaning_val: القَوِيّ (طاقتور) : وہ مکمل طاقت و قوت کی مالک ذات، جس پر کسی کا زور نہیں چلتا اور جس کے فیصلے کو کوئی ٹال نہیں سکتا۔

english_name.name: Al-Qawiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qawiyy (The All-Powerful) is the One with complete power Who cannot be overcome and Whose predestination cannot be repelled.

translations.name: مضبوط
translations.short_meaning_val: المَتِيْن (مضبوط) : انتہا درجے کی طاقت، قوت اورقدرت کا مالک، جسے نہ کمزوری کا سامنا ہو اور نہ مشقت کا۔

english_name.name: Al-Matīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Matīn (The Most Firm) is the One Who possesses infinite power and ability so He never experiences any weakness or hardship.

translations.name: مددگار
translations.short_meaning_val: الوَلِيُّ (مددگار) : جو اپنے مؤمن بندوں کی مدد کرتا ہے اور ساری مخلوقات کے مسائل حل کرتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Walyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Walyy (The Guardian) is the One Who supports His believing servants and manages the affairs of all His creation.

translations.name: قابل تعریف
translations.short_meaning_val: قابل تعریف : یہ ایسا اسم ہے جو یہ بتلاتا ہے کہ ساری تعریفیں اللہ کےلیے ہیں اور سارے کمال اسی کو حاصل ہیں۔ وہ تعریف کا مستحق اس لیے ہے کہ وہ اپنی ذات، اسما و صفات اور افعال میں کامل ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Hamīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hamīd (The Praiseworthy) is a name that denotes all the praiseworthy and perfect attributes of Allah Almighty, Who deserves praise for the perfection of His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: زندہ
translations.short_meaning_val: الحَيّ (زندہ) : وہ ذات جس کے اندر کامل حیات کا وصف اپنے سارے رنگ و روپ کے ساتھ موجود ہے، نہ اس نے عدم کو دیکھا ہے اور نہ اسے فنا ہونا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Hayy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayy (The Ever-Living) is the One to Whom belong all meanings of perfect life that is not preceded by nothingness nor followed by doom.

translations.name: سب کو تھامنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: القَيُّوْم (سب کو تھامنے والا) : جو بذات خود قائم ہے اور کسی کا محتاج نہیں ہے، جب کہ دیگر ساری چیزیں اسی سے وجود پذیر ہوئی ہیں اور کوئی بھی اس سے بے نیاز نہیں ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Qayyūm
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Qayyūm (The Self-Subsisting) is the One Who is self-sustaining, so He does not need anyone, and everything depends on Him and none can dispense with Him.

translations.name: ایک
translations.short_meaning_val: الوَاحِد (ایک) : وہ ہستی جو اپنی ذات، صفات اور افعال میں کامل و مکمل ہونے کی وجہ سے منفرد و یگانہ ہے اور مذکورہ چیزوں میں نہ تو کوئی اس کا ساجھی ہے اور نہ ہی شریک ۔

english_name.name: Al-Wāhid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāhid (The One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His essence, attributes, and actions, and none shares any of this with Him.

translations.name: بے نیاز
translations.short_meaning_val: الصَّمَد (بے نیاز) : کامل رب اور عظیم سرپرست، جس کے در کو ہر ضرورت کے وقت چاہت اور ڈر کے ساتھ کھٹکھٹایا جاتا ہے۔

english_name.name: As-Samad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samad (The Eternal Refuge) is the Perfect Lord and the Magnificent Master to Whom everyone turns, out of hope and fear.

translations.name: قدرت والا
translations.short_meaning_val: القَادِر (قدرت والا) : مکمل اور ہمہ گیر قدرت کی مالک ذات، جسے کوئی چیز بے بس نہیں کر سکتی اور جس کا کوئی مقصد فوت نہیں ہوتا۔

english_name.name: Al-Qādir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qādir (The Able) is the One Who possesses complete and comprehensive power, nothing can challenge Him, and none can escape His power or will.

translations.name: بڑی قدرت والا
translations.short_meaning_val: المُقْتَدِر (بڑی قدرت والا) : وہ ذات، جو کامل قدرت کی مالک ہے اور کوئی چیز اس کے بس سے باہر نہیں ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Muqtadir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqtadir (The Dominant) is the One Who possesses complete unopposed power.

translations.name: آگے کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: المُقَدِّم (آگے کرنے والا) : ہر چیز کو اس کی صحیح جگہ میں رکھنے والا۔ وہ جس چیز کو چاہے آگے کرتا ہے اور جس چیز کو چاہے پیچھے کرتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Muqaddim
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqaddim (The Advancer) is the One Who puts things in their due places, advancing what He wills and delaying what He wills.

translations.name: پیچھے کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: المُؤَخِّر (پیچھے کرنے والا) : جو ان چیزوں کو مؤخر کر کےانہیں ان کے صحیح مقام میں رکھتا ہے، جو پیچھے کیے جانے کی حق دار ہیں۔

english_name.name: Al-Mu’akhkhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu’akhkhir (The Delayer) is the One Who delays things that should be delayed, thus putting them in their proper place.

translations.name: اوّل
translations.short_meaning_val: اول : جس سے پہلے کچھ نہ ہو۔

english_name.name: Al-Awwal
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Awwal (The First) is the One before Whom there was nothing.

translations.name: آخر
translations.short_meaning_val: آخر : جس کے بعد کچھ نہ ہو

english_name.name: Al-Ākhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ākhir (The Last) is the One after Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: ظاہر
translations.short_meaning_val: ظاہر : وہ جس سے اوپر کچھ نہ ہو۔

english_name.name: Azh-Zhāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Azh-Zhāhir (The Manifest) is the One above Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: باطن
translations.short_meaning_val: باطن : جس سے کوئی چیز مخفی نہ ہو۔

english_name.name: Al-Bātin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Bātin (The Hidden) is the One beneath Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: بلند مرتبہ والا
translations.short_meaning_val: المُتَعال (بلند مرتبے والا) : یہ ایک ایسا اسم ہے جو اس بات پر دلالت کرتا ہے کہ اللہ اپنی ذات، مقام و مرتبہ اور طاقت و قوت، الغرض ہر اعتبار سے بلند و برتر ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Muta‘āl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muta‘āl (The Exalted) is a name that denotes the absolute exaltation of Allah in all aspects: His essence, His status, and His power.

translations.name: محسن
translations.short_meaning_val: البَرُّ (محسن) : جس نے بندوں کو طرح طرح کی نعمتوں سے نوازا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Barr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Barr (The Beneficent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of blessings upon His servants.

translations.name: توبہ قبول کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: توبہ قبول کرنے والا : جو بندوں کو توبہ کی توفیق دیتا ہے اور ان کی توبہ قبول کرتا ہے۔

english_name.name: At-Tawwāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tawwāb (The Accepting of Repentance) is the One Who guides His servants to repentance and accepts it from them.

translations.name: بہت زیادہ معاف کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: بہت زیادہ معاف کرنے والا : جو برائيوں کو مٹاتا ہے اور گناہوں سے درگزر کرتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-‘Afuww
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Afuww (The Pardoner) is the One Who erases misdeeds and pardons sins.

translations.name: شفیق
translations.short_meaning_val: الرَّؤُوْف (شفیق) : وہ ذات، جو اپنے بندوں پر بے انتہا شفقت و رحمت کرنے والی ہے۔

english_name.name: Ar-Ra’ūf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Ra’ūf (The All-Kind) is the One Who is the most kind and merciful towards His creation.

english_name.name: Maalik-Ul-Mulk
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE ETERNAL POSSESSOR OF SOVEREIGNTY

The One who controls the Dominion and gives dominion to whoever He willed.

translations.name: عزت و جلال والا
translations.short_meaning_val: ذُو الجَلالِ والإِكْرام (عزت و جلال والا) : عظمت، بڑائی، رحمت، سخاوت کا مالک اور تعظیم و تعریف کا مستحق ہے ۔

english_name.name: Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām (Lord of Majesty and Bounty) is the Possessor of greatness, pride, mercy, and bounty, Who deserves glorification and praise.

translations.name: بے نیاز
translations.short_meaning_val: الغَنِيُّ (بے نیاز) : جس کے سب محتاج ہوں، لیکن وہ کسی کامحتاج نہ ہو۔

english_name.name: A-Ghanyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿A-Ghanyy (The Self-Sufficient) is the One Who is needed by all and Who does not need anyone.

translations.name: ہدایت دینے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الهَادِي (ہدایت دینے والا) : جو اپنے بندوں کو تمام منافع کی راہ دکھاتا اور نقصانات سے بچنے کے طریقے بتاتا ہے اوران میں سے جسے چاہتا ہے سیدھے راستے پر چلنے کی توفیق دیتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Hādi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hādi (The Guide) is the One Who guides His servants to all beneficial things and leads them away from harmful ones, and Who leads whomever He wills to guidance.

translations.name: وارث
translations.short_meaning_val: وارث : جو مخلوق کے فنا ہونے کے بعد باقی رہے گا نیز زمین اور اس کے اوپر کی ساری چیزوں کا وارث ہو گا۔

english_name.name: Al-Wārith
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wārith (The Inheritor) is the One Who lasts after the doom of all creation and Who inherits the earth and all that is in it.

translations.name: خوب صورت
translations.short_meaning_val: الجَمِيْل (خوب صورت) : جو اپنی ذات، ناموں، صفات اور اپنے افعال میں جمال مطلق کا حامل ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Jamīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jamīl (The Beautiful) is the One Who possesses absolute beauty in His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: زبردست
translations.short_meaning_val: القَاهِر (زبردست) : جس کے آگے ساری کائنات سربسجود ہو اور جس کی قدرت و ارادے کے تابع ساری مخلوقات ہوں۔

english_name.name: Al-Qāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qāhir (The Vanquisher) is the One to Whom all beings submit and before Whose power and will all beings stand humbly.

translations.name: قریب
translations.short_meaning_val: قریب : جو اپنے فرماں بردار بندے کو ثواب دینے، پکارنے والے کی پکار سننے اور تمام بندوں سے اس اعتبار سے قریب ہے کہ وہ ان کی پوری خبر رکھتا ہے۔ واضح رہے کہ یہ اللہ کے بلندی (عرش) پر ہونے کے منافی نہیں ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Qarīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qarīb (The Near) is the One Who is near His obedient servants with reward; near those who supplicate Him with the answer; and near the rest of His servants with knowledge. This does not contradict His being high above.

translations.name: رب
translations.short_meaning_val: رب : آقا، مالک، مصلح اور اپنی حسن تدبیر اور طرح طرح کی نعمتوں کے ذریعے تمام بندوں کی تربیت کرنے والا۔

english_name.name: Ar-Rabb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rabb (The Lord) is the Master, the Owner, the Reformer, and the One Who fosters His servants by managing their affairs and bestowing favors upon them.

translations.name: واضح کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: المُبِيْن (واضح کرنے والا) : وہ ذات جس کی وحدانیت واضح اور روشن ہے، جس کا کوئی ساجھی نہیں ہے اور جو اپنے مؤمن بندوں کے لیے حق کو روشن کر دیتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Mubīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mubīn (The Evident) is the One Who is evident in His Oneness and that He has no partner, and Who clarifies the truth to His servants.

translations.name: عطا کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: عطا کرنے والا : وہ جو درحقیت سب کچھ دینے والا ہے۔ وہ دینا چاہے تو کوئی روک نہیں سکتا اور روک لے تو کوئی دے نہیں سکتا۔

english_name.name: Al-Mu‘ti
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu‘ti (The Giver) is the only One Who gives, and no one can withhold what He has given or give what He has withheld.

translations.name: کافی
translations.short_meaning_val: کافی : جو بندوں کی تمام ضرورتوں کو پورا کرنے کے لیے کافی ہے اور جس کی مدد کے بعد کسی اور کے سہارے کی ضرورت نہیں رہتی۔

english_name.name: Al-Kāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kāfi (The All-Sufficient) is the One Who fulfills all the needs of His servants and Who is sufficient for them beyond need for anyone else.

translations.name: يگانہ
translations.short_meaning_val: الوِتْر (يگانہ) : وہ ذات، جو اکیلی ہے اور اس کا کوئی ساجھی و نظیر نہیں ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Witr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Witr (The Odd) is the One Who has no partner or equal.

translations.name: یکتا
translations.short_meaning_val: الأَحَد (یکتا) : وہ ذات، جو اپنی ربوبیت، الوہیت اور اسما و صفات کے تمام کمالات میں یکتا اور بے مثل ہو اور ان صفات میں اس کا کوئی ساجھی و شریک نہ ہو۔

english_name.name: Al-Ahad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ahad (The Only One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His lordship, divinity, names, and attributes, and none shares any of them with Him.

translations.name: سخی
translations.short_meaning_val: الجَوَاد (سخی) : جو بڑی داد و دہش کرنے والا ہے اور اس کی دادو دہش کے دائرے سے کائنات کی کوئی چیز باہر نہیں ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Jawād
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jawād (The Munificent) is the One Who gives abundantly to all creatures.

translations.name: نرمی سے کام لینے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: الرَّفِيْق (نرمی سے کام لینے والا) : تمام معاملوں میں نرمی سے کام لینے اور ڈھیل دینے والا، جو نافرمانوں کو سزا دینے میں جلدی نہیں کرتا۔

english_name.name: Ar-Rafīq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rafīq (The Kind) is the One Who acts deliberately and gradually, and does not hasten to punish sinners.

translations.name: سردار
translations.short_meaning_val: السَّيِّد (سردار) : رب، مالک اور حقیقی سردار، جس کی جانب ساری مخلوقات دنیا اور آخرت کے تمام معاملوں میں رجوع کرتی ہیں۔

english_name.name: As-Sayyid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Sayyid (The Master) is the Lord and the Owner, the One Who possesses true dominance, and to Whom all creation turns for their worldly and their Hereafter affairs.

translations.name: ہر عیب سے پاک
translations.short_meaning_val: السُّبُّوْح (ہر عیب سے پاک) : جو ساری خامیوں اور عیبوں سے پاک ہے اور آسمانوں اور زمین کی ساری چیزیں جس کی پاکی بیان کرتی ہیں۔

english_name.name: As-Subbūh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Subbūh (The All-Glorious) is the One far exalted above deficiencies and defects and Who is extolled and glorified by all those in the heavens and the earth.

translations.name: شفا دینے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: شفا دینے والا : وہ جو بندوں کو جسمانی امراض، دل کے شبہات اور نفس کی شہوتوں سے عافیت دیتا ہے ۔

english_name.name: Ash-Shāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shāfi (The Healer) is the One Who cures His servants from the illnesses of their bodies, the doubts of their hearts, and the vain desires of their selves.

translations.name: قدردان
translations.short_meaning_val: الشَّاكِر (قدردان) : جو اپنے اطاعت گزاروں کی تعریف کرتا ہے اور انھیں ان کی اطاعت کا بدلہ ان کے استحقاق سے زیادہ دیتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Ash-Shākir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shākir (The Appreciative) is the One Who praises those who obey Him and rewards them beyond what is due to them.

translations.name: طیب
translations.short_meaning_val: طیب : یعنی اللہ تمام کمیوں، خامیوں اور عیبوں سے پاک ہے۔

english_name.name: At-Tayyib
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tayyib (The Good) means that Allah Almighty is extolled and exalted far above all deficiencies and defects.

translations.name: اعلی
translations.short_meaning_val: اعلی : اللہ کا ایسا نام جو بلندی و برتری کے تمام معانی کو اللہ کے لیے ثابت کرنے پر دلالت کرتا ہے۔ ذات کے اعتبار سے بھی اور مقام و مرتبے اور طاقت و قوت کے اعتبار سے بھی۔

english_name.name: Al-A‘la
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-A‘la (The Most High) is a name that denotes the affirmation of all meanings of highness for Allah Almighty from every aspect: highness in His essence, highness in His status, and highness in His power.

translations.name: قدرت والا
translations.short_meaning_val: القَدِيْرُ (قدرت والا) : جو کامل قدرت کا مالک ہے اور اس کے اندر بے بسی و کوتاہ دستی کا شائبہ تک نہیں ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Qadīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qadīr (The Omnipotent) is the One Who possesses complete power and does not suffer any incapability or fatigue.

translations.name: بن مانگے دینے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: المَنَّان (بن مانگے دینے والا) : جو بڑا نوازنے والا اور بن مانگے ہی نعمتیں عطا کرنے والا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Mannān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mannān (The Bestower of Favors) is the One Who bestows great favors and gives blessings to His servants before they ask for them.

translations.name: احاطہ کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: احاطہ کرنے والا : اللہ کا یہ نام یہ بتلاتا ہے کہ وہ اپنی مخلوق سے بلند و بالا ہے اور کائنات کی ساری چیزیں اس کے علم، قدرت اور غلبہ کے دائرے میں ہیں۔

english_name.name: Al-Muhīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhīt (The All-Encompassing) is a name that denotes the exaltedness of Allah above His creation and that He encompasses everything in terms of knowledge, power, and subjugation.

translations.name: بڑا کریم
translations.short_meaning_val: الأَكْرَم (بڑا کریم) : بڑی بھلائی اور نوازش کا مالک، جس کے ہاتھ میں ساری بھلائیاں ہیں اور اسی کی جانب سے ہر خیر ملتی ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Akram
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Akram (The Most Generous) is the One Who gives generously, and all goodness lies in His hand and comes from Him.

translations.name: معبود
translations.short_meaning_val: الإِلَه (معبود) : یہ ایک ایسا کلمہ ہے، جو کمال و جلال کے تمام اوصاف کا جامع ہے اور ایسے معبود کی نشان دہی کرتا ہے، جس کے سوا کوئی عبادت کے لائق نہیں ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Ilāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ilāh (The God) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection and majesty and Who alone is worthy of being worshiped.

translations.name: مددگار
translations.short_meaning_val: النَّصِيْر (مددگار) : جو اپنے مومن بندوں کی نصرت اور مدد کرتا ہے۔

english_name.name: An-Nasīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿An-Nasīr (The Helper) is the One Who helps and supports His believing servants.

translations.name: مولی
translations.short_meaning_val: مولی : اللہ تمام مخلوقات کا مولی ہے، اس معنی میں کہ وہ ان کا آقا، مالک، خالق اور برحق معبود ہے۔ مؤمن بندوں کا مولی اس معنی میں ہے کہ وہ ان سے محبت کرتا ہے، انھیں اچھے کاموں کی توفیق دیتا ہے، ان کے مدد کرتا ہے، ان کے مصالح کا خیال رکھتا ہے اور ان کے حق میں دینی اور دنیوی منافع کا حصول آسان کرتا ہے۔

english_name.name: Al-Mawla
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mawla (The Protector) of all creation is their Master, Owner, Creator, and True Deity worthy of worship; and Al-Mawla of the believing servants is the One Who loves them, guides and supports them, and leads them to their religious and worldly interests.

translations.name: نہایت باحیا
translations.short_meaning_val: نہایت با حیا : وہ ذات، جو بہت زیادہ حیا والی ہے۔ واضح ہو کہ یہاں حیا سے مراد مخلوقات جیسی حیا نہیں ہے، بلکہ اس سے مراد اس کا ان چیزوں کو ترک کرنا ہےجو اس کی بے پایاں رحمت ،کمال سخاوت اور عظیم عفو و درگزر کے مطابق نہ ہوں۔

english_name.name: Al-Hayiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayiyy (The Modest) is the One Who is very modest. This description befits Allah Almighty and it is nothing like the modesty of people. Rather, it means abandoning what does not suit His vast mercy, perfect generosity, and great forgiveness and forbearance.

translations.name: احسان کرنے والا
translations.short_meaning_val: احسان کرنے والا : وہ ذات، جس نے اپنے بندوں کو طرح طرح کی ظاہری اور باطنی نعمتیں دے رکھی ہیں۔

english_name.name: Al-Muhsin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhsin (The Superb Benevolent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of outward and inward favors upon His servants.

translations.name: Аллах
translations.short_meaning_val: Аллах: Истинный Бог, Единственный достойный поклонения с любовью, надеждой и страхом. Это имя вобрало в себя значения всех прекрасных имён Аллаха и охватывает все качества Всевышнего Аллаха.

english_name.name: Allāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Allah is the deity worthy of being worshiped out of love, hope, and fear. This name encompasses all the meanings of the beautiful names and attributes of the Almighty Lord.

translations.name: Ар-Рахман (Милостивый)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ар-Рахман: Обладатель великой, обширной милости, объемлющей всё сущее.

english_name.name: Ar-Rahmān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahmān (The Most Compassionate) is the One with great and immense mercy that encompasses everything.

translations.name: Ар-Рахим (Милующий)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ар-Рахим: Обладатель великой милости, проявляемой по отношению к объекту этой милости.

english_name.name: Ar-Rahīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.

translations.name: Аль-Малик (Царь, Владыка, Властелин)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Малик: Обладающий качествами величия, одолевания и управления, владеющий всем сущим, распоряжающийся всем сущим, власть Которого никто не способен оспорить и Которому никто не может противостоять.

english_name.name: Al-Malik
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.

translations.name: Аль-Куддус (Святой, Совершенный)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Куддус: Возвеличиваемый, свободный от каких-либо изъянов и недостатков и от того, чтобы что-то из сотворённого было равным или подобным Ему.

english_name.name: Al-Quddūs
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Quddūs (The Holy One) is the Glorified One Who is exalted far above any defect and far above resembling any of His creation.

translations.name: Ас-Салям (Пречистый, Свободный от всего неподобающего)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ас-Салям: Свободный от любых пороков, изъянов и недостатков.

english_name.name: As-Salām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ As-Salām (The Source of Perfection) is the One free from any defect or fault.

translations.name: Аль-Му’мин (Оберегающий, Дарующий безопасность)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Му’мин: подтверждающий истинность пророческой миссии Своих пророков посредством доказательств и чудес, и Тот, Кто дарует творениям безопасность от несправедливости в силу совершенства Своей справедливости.

english_name.name: Al-Mu’min
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.

translations.name: Аль-Мухаймин (Хранитель)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Мухаймин: главенствующий над творениями, распоряжающийся и управляющий ими, объемлющий всё Своим знанием.

english_name.name: Al-Muhaymin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhaymin (The All-Controller) is the Guardian over His creation, their Ruler, and the Disposer of all their affairs, Who encompasses everything in His knowledge.

translations.name: Аль-‘Азиз (Могущественный)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-‘Азиз: Обладающий абсолютным могуществом, одолевающий всё помимо Него Самого Своей силой, властью и непобедимостью.

english_name.name: Al-‘Azīz
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azīz (The All-Mighty) is the One Who possesses the absolute might and vanquishes all others with His power, dominance, and invincibility.

translations.name: Аль-Джаббар (Могучий)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Джаббар: Возвысившийся над творениями, Обладающий властью над всем сущим, Тот, Кому подчинено всё и Кому покоряется всё, Тот, Кто защищает и поддерживает того, кто обращается к Нему за защитой.

english_name.name: Al-Jabbār
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.

translations.name: Аль-Мутакаббир (Величавый, Горделивый)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Мутакаббир: Возвышенный, Свободный в Своём величии от всего скверного, от изъянов и пороков, в силу присущего Ему совершенства и величия.

english_name.name: Al-Mutakabbir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mutakabbir (The Supreme) is the One Who is far exalted above evil, deficiency, and defects, given His perfection and majesty.

translations.name: Аль-Халик (Творец)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Халик: Сотворивший всё сущее и создавший их без какого-либо образца и лекала.

english_name.name: Al-Khāliq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khāliq (The Creator) is the One Who brings things into existence and invents them in an unprecedented way.

translations.name: Аль-Бари (Создатель)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Бари: Творец, Который создал всё сущее и придал ему форму, сотворив всё это после небытия.

english_name.name: Al-Bāri’
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Bāri’ (The Initiator) is the Creator Who created the whole creation from nothing and gave them forms after they were non-existent.

translations.name: Аль-Мусаввир (Придающий облик)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Мусаввир: Тот, Кто придаёт Своим творениям разные облики и строение, что свидетельствует о совершенстве Его знания и мудрости.

english_name.name: Al-Musawwir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Musawwir (The Supreme Fashioner) is the One Who fashioned His creation in different forms and appearances that indicate His perfect knowledge and wisdom.

english_name.name: Al-Ghaffaar
english_name.short_meaning_val:
AL-Ghaffaar (The Great Forgiver)

The Forgiver, The One who forgives the sins of His slaves time and time again

english_name.name: Al-Qahhār
english_name.short_meaning_val: THE ALL-PREVAILING ONE
english_name.meanings_val: <p><span style="font-size: 19px; color: #202122; font-weight: normal; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Arial'; font-style: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none;">The Dominant, The One who has the perfect Power and is not unable over anything.</span></p>

translations.name: Аль-Ваххаб (Дарующий, Даритель)
translations.short_meaning_val: ль-Ваххаб: щедро и обильно дарующий, Объемлющий Своей щедростью все творения.

english_name.name: Al-Wahhāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wahhāb (The Bestower) is the One Who gives abundantly, and Whose generosity and bounty encompass all beings.

translations.name: Ар-Раззак (Дарующий удел, Наделяющий)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ар-Раззак: Обеспечивающий Своих рабов уделом, без которого не обойтись их сердцам и телам.

english_name.name: Ar-Razzāq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Razzāq (The All-Provider) is the One Who guarantees His servants the sustenance that maintains their hearts and bodies.

translations.name: Аль-Фаттах (Судия, Дарующий победу)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Фаттах: Управляющий Своими рабами посредством Своих законов и посредством Своего предопределения и подвергающий их расчёту в соответствии с установленными Им наказанием и наградой.

english_name.name: Al-Fattāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Fattāh (The Greatest Judge) is the One Who judges between His servants by His religious rulings, decrees His predestination for them, and calls them to account.

translations.name: Аль-‘Алим (Всезнающий)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-‘Алим: Охватывающий и объемлющий всё Своим знанием.

english_name.name: Al-‘Alīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alīm (The All-Knowing) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses everything.

english_name.name: Al-Qaabid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE RESTRICTING ONE

The Constrictor, The Withholder, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Baasit
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE EXTENDER

The Englarger, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Khaafid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE REDUCER

The One who lowers whoever He willed by His Destruction and raises whoever He willed by His Endowment.

translations.name: Ар-Рафи‘ (Возвышающий)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ар-Рафи‘: Возвышающий кого пожелает и как пожелает, например, возвышающий Своих приближённых в этом мире и в мире вечном.

english_name.name: Ar-Rāfi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Rāfi‘ (The Raiser) is the One Who raises whomever He wills the way He wills, as He elevates the ranks of His pious servants in this world and in the Hereafter.

translations.name: Ас-Сами‘ (Слышащий)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ас-Сами‘: Тот, Кто слышит все звуки, и Он слышит даже самые тихие и тайные беседы, Он слышит тихое и громкое, то, что произносят, и то, о чём умалчивают.

english_name.name: As-Samī‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samī‘ (The All-Hearing) is the One Who hears everything. He hears secret and private talk. Loud and low voices, and speaking and silence are all the same to Him - He grasps all.

translations.name: Аль-Басыр (Видящий)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Басыр: Тот, Чей взор охватывает всё сущее, сколь бы мелким и незаметным оно ни было, Обладающий проницательностью в отношении всех вещей, Сведущий о них, Знающий о сокрытом в них.

english_name.name: Al-Basīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Basīr (The All-Seeing) is the One Whose sight encompasses everything, no matter how small or minute they may be, and He is the One Who is All-Aware of everything and All-Knowing of their hidden aspects.

translations.name: Аль-Хакам (Справедливый Судия)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Хакам: Тот, Кто управляет всем и выносит такие решения, какие пожелает, и Он судит меж Своими творениями согласно истине и справедливости.

english_name.name: Al-Hakam
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakam (The Judge) is the One to Whom belongs judgment in all things, and Who ordains what He wills and judges between His servants with the truth and justice.

translations.name: Аль-Лятыф (Проницательный, Добрый)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Лятыф: Тот, от Кого ничто не укрывается, даже самое мелкое, незаметное и сокрытое, и Кто добр к Своим рабам и помогает им в том, в чём благо для них.

english_name.name: Al-Latīf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Latīf (The All-Subtle) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, no matter how small it may be, and the One Who shows kindness and leniency to His servants and guides them to what is good for them.

translations.name: Аль-Хабир (Ведающий; Осведомлённый)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Хабир: Объемлющий Своим знанием всё сокрытое в вещах точно так же, как объемлет Он Своим знанием всё явное в них.

english_name.name: Al-Khabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khabīr (The All-Aware) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses the inward and hidden aspects of things, as well as their outward aspects.

translations.name: Аль-Халим (Незлобливый, Сдержанный)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Халим: обладатель степенности, Который не спешит наказывать Своих рабов за их грехи.

english_name.name: Al-Halīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Halīm (The Forbearing) is the One Who possesses deliberation and does not hasten to punish His servants for their sins.

translations.name: Аль-‘Азым (Великий)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-‘Азым: Объединяющий в Себе все качества совершенства, гордости и величия, Тот, Кого любят сердца и возвеличивают души.

english_name.name: Al-‘Azhīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azhīm (The Magnificent) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection, glory, pride, and majesty, and Who is loved and extolled by His servants.

translations.name: Аль-Гафур (Прощающий)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Гафур: Оберегающий Своих рабов от зла их грехов и не подвергающий их наказанию за них.

english_name.name: Al-Ghafūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ghafūr (The All-Forgiving) is the One Who spares His servants the evil of their sins and does not punish them.

translations.name: Аш-Шакур (Благодарный)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аш-Шакур: Тот, Кто благодарит за небольшие деяния щедрой, приумноженной наградой и прощает многочисленные проступки.

english_name.name: Ash-Shakūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shakūr (The Most Appreciative) is the One Who appreciates even little deeds and gives immense and multiple rewards in return, and Who forgives numerous errors.

translations.name: Аль-‘Али (Возвышенный)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-‘Али: Тот, Кому присуща абсолютная возвышенность во всех формах: возвышенность положения, возвышенность одолевания, возвышенность Сущности.

english_name.name: Al-‘Alyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alyy (The High) is the One Who possesses absolute highness in all aspects: His status, His power, and His essence.

translations.name: Аль-Кабир (Великий)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Кабир: Великий, превосходящий всё Своим величием, Тот, Кого никто не превосходит своим величием.

english_name.name: Al-Kabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kabīr (The Great) is the One Who is greater than everything, and all else are inferior to Him.

translations.name: Аль-Хафиз (Хранящий, Оберегающий)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Хафиз: Оберегающий Свои творения, Объемлющий знанием всё, что сотворил, Оберегающий Своих приближённых от грехов и пагуб, и учитывающий деяния Своих рабов и их воздаяние.

english_name.name: Al-Hafīzh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hafīzh (The All-Preserver) is the One Who preserves what He created; Whose knowledge encompasses all that He brought into existence; Who protects His pious servants from committing sins and ruinous acts; and Who records their deeds and the recompense for them.

translations.name: Аль-Мукыт (Дающий пропитание)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Мукыт: Тот, Кто предопределяет пропитание творений в соответствии со Своим знанием, а потом дарует им его посредством Своего могущества и распределяет его между ними.

english_name.name: Al-Muqīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqīt (The All-Nourisher) is the One Who determines the sustenance of His creation according to His knowledge, brings it to them with His power, and distributes it amongst them.

translations.name: Аль-Хасиб (Требующий отчёта)
translations.short_meaning_val: Аль-Хасиб: Обеспечивающий Своих верующих рабов, уповающих на Него, Знающий о делах Своих рабов и подвергающий их расчёту за них.

english_name.name: Al-Hasīb
