english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Raqīb (The Ever-Watchful) is the One Who watches over everything and witnesses inner thoughts and secrets, and Who knows and sees all things and no secret or private talk is hidden from Him.

translations.name: مُجیب
translations.short_meaning_val: مُجیب: آنکه درخواست درخواست کنندگان و دعای دعاگویان را با اجابت و پذیرش پاسخ می گوید.

english_name.name: Al-Mujīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mujīb (The All-Responsive) is the One Who responds to supplications by answering them and to requests by fulfilling them.

translations.name: واسِع
translations.short_meaning_val: واسِع: آنکه از هر وصفی، کاملترین معنایش را دارد.

english_name.name: Al-Wāsi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāsi‘ (The All-Embracing) is the One to Whom belongs the most perfect and complete meaning of every attribute.

translations.name: حَکیم
translations.short_meaning_val: حَکیم: موصوف به کمالِ حکمت در دستورات و قوانینش و کمال حکمرانی در میان مخلوقاتش.

english_name.name: Al-Hakīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakīm (The All-Wise) is the One Who possesses perfect wisdom in His commands and legislations, and perfect judgment between His creation.

translations.name: وَدود
translations.short_meaning_val: وَدود: یعنی: کسی که دوست می دارد و دوستش می دارند زیرا اوست که پیامبران و رسولانش و پیروانش را دوست دارد و آنان نیز دوستش می دارند.

english_name.name: Al-Wadūd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wadūd (The Most Affectionate) is the One Who loves and is loved. He loves His prophets and messengers and their followers, and they love Him.

translations.name: وَدود
translations.short_meaning_val: وَدود: یعنی: کسی که دوست می دارد و دوستش می دارند زیرا اوست که پیامبران و رسولانش و پیروانش را دوست دارد و آنان نیز دوستش می دارند.

english_name.name: Al-Majīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Majīd (The Most Glorious) is the One Who possesses the various attributes of supreme majesty and perfection.

translations.name: شهید
translations.short_meaning_val: شهید: آنکه چیزی از وی پنهان نمی ماند بلکه بر هر چیزی مطلع و آن را مشاهده می کند و به جزئیاتش آگاه است.

english_name.name: Ash-Shahīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shahīd (The Ever-Witness) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, rather He knows and witnesses everything and is Aware of its details.

translations.name: حق
translations.short_meaning_val: حق: آنکه وجودش مُتَحقّق (ناگزیر) است و نامها و صفات و کارها و احکام و جزایش همه کمال [محض] و حق است و در آن باطلی نیست.

english_name.name: Al-Haqq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Haqq (The Truth) is the True One in terms of His being and His existence; and the One Whose names, attributes, actions, judgments, and recompense are all perfect and true.

translations.name: وَکیل
translations.short_meaning_val: وکیل: آنکه روزی بندگانش را بر عهده گرفته، و قائم به امر آنها بنابر مصلحتشان است و کسی است که امور دوستانش را بر عهده دارد و کارهای آنان را به سوی یُسر و آسانی میسر می سازد و از دشواری دورشان می سازد و خود برای کارهایشان کافی است.

english_name.name: Al-Wakīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wakīl (The Trustee) is the One Who guarantees the sustenance of His creation and manages their affairs and maintains their welfare; and Who supports His pious servants and, thus, guides them to ease, grants them sufficiency, and keeps them away from difficulty.

translations.name: قَوی
translations.short_meaning_val: قوی: دارای قدرت کامل که هیچ چیز او را شکت ندهد و از قضایش جلوگیری نکند.

english_name.name: Al-Qawiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qawiyy (The All-Powerful) is the One with complete power Who cannot be overcome and Whose predestination cannot be repelled.

translations.name: مَتین
translations.short_meaning_val: مَتین: شدید، آنکه در اوج نیرو و قدرت است بنابراین ضعف و مشقتی به او نمی رسد.

english_name.name: Al-Matīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Matīn (The Most Firm) is the One Who possesses infinite power and ability so He never experiences any weakness or hardship.

translations.name: وَلیّ
translations.short_meaning_val: وَلیّ: آنکه بندگانش مؤمنیش را یاری می دهد و امور همهٔ بندگانش را بر عهده دارد.

english_name.name: Al-Walyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Walyy (The Guardian) is the One Who supports His believing servants and manages the affairs of all His creation.

translations.name: حمید
translations.short_meaning_val: حمید: اسمی است دال بر همهٔ ستایشها و کمالها برای الله تعالی. آنکه به سبب کمال ذاتش و نامهایش و صفات و افعالش شایستهٔ حمد است.

english_name.name: Al-Hamīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hamīd (The Praiseworthy) is a name that denotes all the praiseworthy and perfect attributes of Allah Almighty, Who deserves praise for the perfection of His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: حَیّ
translations.short_meaning_val: حَیّ (زنده): آنکه همهٔ معانی زندگی را به شکل کامل دارد، آنکه وجودش بعد از عدم نبوده و به فنا منتهی نمی شود.

english_name.name: Al-Hayy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayy (The Ever-Living) is the One to Whom belong all meanings of perfect life that is not preceded by nothingness nor followed by doom.

translations.name: قَیّوم
translations.short_meaning_val: قَیّوم: او کسی است که به ذات خود قائم و استوار است و نیازمند کسی نبوده و همه چیز توسط او برپاست، بنابراین هیچکس از او بی نیاز نیست.

english_name.name: Al-Qayyūm
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Qayyūm (The Self-Subsisting) is the One Who is self-sustaining, so He does not need anyone, and everything depends on Him and none can dispense with Him.

translations.name: واحد
translations.short_meaning_val: واحد: آن که همهٔ کمالات را در ذات و صفات و افعالش به تنهایی دارد و در هیچ یک از آنها با کسی شریک نیست.

english_name.name: Al-Wāhid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāhid (The One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His essence, attributes, and actions, and none shares any of this with Him.

translations.name: صَمَد
translations.short_meaning_val: صَمَد: پروردگار کامل و سرور بزرگ، آنکه در هر نیازی از روی رَغبَت و رَهبَت به او رجوع می شود.

english_name.name: As-Samad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samad (The Eternal Refuge) is the Perfect Lord and the Magnificent Master to Whom everyone turns, out of hope and fear.

translations.name: قادر
translations.short_meaning_val: قادر: آنکه دارای قدرت کامل فراگیر است، آنکه چیزی ناتوانش نمی سازد و هیچ خواسته ای را از دست نمی دهد.

english_name.name: Al-Qādir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qādir (The Able) is the One Who possesses complete and comprehensive power, nothing can challenge Him, and none can escape His power or will.

translations.name: مُقتَدَر
translations.short_meaning_val: مُقتَدِر: آنکه دارای قدرت کامل است و هیچ چیزی برایش غیر ممکن نیست.

english_name.name: Al-Muqtadir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqtadir (The Dominant) is the One Who possesses complete unopposed power.

translations.name: مُقَدّم
translations.short_meaning_val: مُقَدِم: آنکه هر چیز را در جایگاه شایسته اش قرار می دهد، آنچه را بخواهد جلو می اندازد و آنچه را بخواهد به عقب می اندازد.

english_name.name: Al-Muqaddim
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqaddim (The Advancer) is the One Who puts things in their due places, advancing what He wills and delaying what He wills.

translations.name: مُؤَخِّر
translations.short_meaning_val: مُؤَخِر: (به تأخیر اندازنده): آنکه آنچه شایستهٔ تأخیر و عقب افتادن است را به تأخیر می اندازد و در جایگاه شایسته اش قرار می دهد.

english_name.name: Al-Mu’akhkhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu’akhkhir (The Delayer) is the One Who delays things that should be delayed, thus putting them in their proper place.

translations.name: اول
translations.short_meaning_val: اول: آنکه پیش از او چیزی نیست.

english_name.name: Al-Awwal
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Awwal (The First) is the One before Whom there was nothing.

translations.name: آخِر
translations.short_meaning_val: آخِر: آنکه پس از او چیزی نیست.

english_name.name: Al-Ākhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ākhir (The Last) is the One after Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: ظاهِر
translations.short_meaning_val: ظاهِر: آنکه چیزی بالای وی نیست.

english_name.name: Azh-Zhāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Azh-Zhāhir (The Manifest) is the One above Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: باطن:
translations.short_meaning_val: باطن: آنکه نهان تر از او چیزی نیست.

english_name.name: Al-Bātin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Bātin (The Hidden) is the One beneath Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: مُتَعال
translations.short_meaning_val: مُتَعال: نامی است دال بر بلندی و علو مطلقِ الله از همهٔ وجوه: بلندی ذات و بلندی قدر و بلندی قَهر (چیرگی).

english_name.name: Al-Muta‘āl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muta‘āl (The Exalted) is a name that denotes the absolute exaltation of Allah in all aspects: His essence, His status, and His power.

translations.name: بَرّ
translations.short_meaning_val: بَرّ: نیکوکاری که انواع نعمتها را به بندگانش ارزانی داشته است.

english_name.name: Al-Barr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Barr (The Beneficent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of blessings upon His servants.

translations.name: تواب (بسیار توبه پذیر)
translations.short_meaning_val: تواب: آنکه بندگانش را به سوی توبه توفیق می دهد و توبه را از آنان می پذیرد.

english_name.name: At-Tawwāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tawwāb (The Accepting of Repentance) is the One Who guides His servants to repentance and accepts it from them.

translations.name: عَفُوّ
translations.short_meaning_val: عَفُوّ: آن است که بدی ها را پاک می کند و از گناهان درمی گذرد.

english_name.name: Al-‘Afuww
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Afuww (The Pardoner) is the One Who erases misdeeds and pardons sins.

translations.name: رئوف
translations.short_meaning_val: رئوف: آنکه نسبت به بندگانش بسیار رأفت دارد و مهربان است.

english_name.name: Ar-Ra’ūf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Ra’ūf (The All-Kind) is the One Who is the most kind and merciful towards His creation.

english_name.name: Maalik-Ul-Mulk
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE ETERNAL POSSESSOR OF SOVEREIGNTY

The One who controls the Dominion and gives dominion to whoever He willed.

translations.name: دارای جلال و اکرام
translations.short_meaning_val: دارای جلال و اِکرام: صاحب عظمت و کبریا و رحمت و بخشش، که شایستهٔ بزرگداشت و ستایش است.

english_name.name: Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām (Lord of Majesty and Bounty) is the Possessor of greatness, pride, mercy, and bounty, Who deserves glorification and praise.

translations.name: غنی
translations.short_meaning_val: غنی: بی نیازی است که هرکه جز اوست نیازمند اوست و خود نیازمند کسی نیست.

english_name.name: A-Ghanyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿A-Ghanyy (The Self-Sufficient) is the One Who is needed by all and Who does not need anyone.

translations.name: هادی:
translations.short_meaning_val: هادی: آنکه بندگانش را به سوی همهٔ منافع و دفع همهٔ زیانها راهنمایی می کند و هر که را بخواهد به سوی هدایت توفیق می دهد.

english_name.name: Al-Hādi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hādi (The Guide) is the One Who guides His servants to all beneficial things and leads them away from harmful ones, and Who leads whomever He wills to guidance.

translations.name: وارِث
translations.short_meaning_val: وارِث: آنکه پس از فنای خلق باقی خواهد ماند، کسی که زمین و هرکه بر آن است را به ارث می برد.

english_name.name: Al-Wārith
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wārith (The Inheritor) is the One Who lasts after the doom of all creation and Who inherits the earth and all that is in it.

translations.name: جَمیل
translations.short_meaning_val: جمیل: کسی که در ذاتش و در نامهایش و صفات و کارهایشان دارای زیبایی مطلق است.

english_name.name: Al-Jamīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jamīl (The Beautiful) is the One Who possesses absolute beauty in His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: قاهِر
translations.short_meaning_val: قاهر: آنکه همهٔ قاهرات در برابرش سر فرو آورده اند و همهٔ مخلوقات در برابر او ذلیلند و تسلیم قدرت و مشیت اویند.

english_name.name: Al-Qāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qāhir (The Vanquisher) is the One to Whom all beings submit and before Whose power and will all beings stand humbly.

translations.name: قریب
translations.short_meaning_val: قریب: به هرکس که از او اطاعت کند با پاداش خود نزدیک می شود و به دعا کننده با اجابت، و به دیگر بندگانش با علمِ خود، و این نزدیکی در منافات با عُلُو و بالا بودن او نیست.

english_name.name: Al-Qarīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qarīb (The Near) is the One Who is near His obedient servants with reward; near those who supplicate Him with the answer; and near the rest of His servants with knowledge. This does not contradict His being high above.

translations.name: رَب
translations.short_meaning_val: رَب: آن سرور که مالک و مصلح دیگران است و همهٔ بندگانش را با تدبیر و انواع نعمتها می پروراند.

english_name.name: Ar-Rabb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rabb (The Lord) is the Master, the Owner, the Reformer, and the One Who fosters His servants by managing their affairs and bestowing favors upon them.

translations.name: مُبین
translations.short_meaning_val: مُبین: آنکه امر وحدانیتش واضح و آشکار است و شریکی ندارد و حق را برای بندگانش آشکار می سازد.

english_name.name: Al-Mubīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mubīn (The Evident) is the One Who is evident in His Oneness and that He has no partner, and Who clarifies the truth to His servants.

translations.name: مُعطی
translations.short_meaning_val: مُعطی (عطا کننده): تنها اوست که حقیقتا عطا می کند و کسی نمی تواند از عطای او جلوگیری کند و اگر او باز بدارد، کسی را یارای عطا نیست.

english_name.name: Al-Mu‘ti
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu‘ti (The Giver) is the only One Who gives, and no one can withhold what He has given or give what He has withheld.

translations.name: کافی
translations.short_meaning_val: کافی : جو بندوں کی تمام ضرورتوں کو پورا کرنے کے لیے کافی ہے اور جس کی مدد کے بعد کسی اور کے سہارے کی ضرورت نہیں رہتی۔

english_name.name: Al-Kāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kāfi (The All-Sufficient) is the One Who fulfills all the needs of His servants and Who is sufficient for them beyond need for anyone else.

translations.name: وِتر
translations.short_meaning_val: وَتر (فرد): آن یگانه ای که شریک و نظیر ندارد.

english_name.name: Al-Witr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Witr (The Odd) is the One Who has no partner or equal.

translations.name: اَحَد
translations.short_meaning_val: اَحَد: کسی است که با همهٔ کمالات در ربوبیت و الوهیت و نام ها و صفاتش تَک است و بی همتا، آنطور که هیچ شریکی در این ها با او مشارکت ندارد.

english_name.name: Al-Ahad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ahad (The Only One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His lordship, divinity, names, and attributes, and none shares any of them with Him.

translations.name: جَواد
translations.short_meaning_val: آن که عطایش بسیار است و همهٔ کائنات را در بر گرفته است.

english_name.name: Al-Jawād
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jawād (The Munificent) is the One Who gives abundantly to all creatures.

translations.name: رَفیق
translations.short_meaning_val: رفیق: آنکه در کارها اهل تأنی است و کارها را مرحله به مرحله به آرامی به پیش می برد و در مجازات سرکشان عجله نمی کند.

english_name.name: Ar-Rafīq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rafīq (The Kind) is the One Who acts deliberately and gradually, and does not hasten to punish sinners.

translations.name: سیّد
translations.short_meaning_val: سید (سرور): پروردگار و مالک، صاحب سروری حقیقی، آنکه آفریدگان در امور دنیا و آخرت به او رجوع می کنند.

english_name.name: As-Sayyid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Sayyid (The Master) is the Lord and the Owner, the One Who possesses true dominance, and to Whom all creation turns for their worldly and their Hereafter affairs.

translations.name: سُبّوح
translations.short_meaning_val: سُبّوح: منزه از هرگونه نقص و عیب، که هر کس در آسمانها و زمین است او را تقدیس می گوید و از عیب و نقص پاک می داند.

english_name.name: As-Subbūh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Subbūh (The All-Glorious) is the One far exalted above deficiencies and defects and Who is extolled and glorified by all those in the heavens and the earth.

translations.name: شافی
translations.short_meaning_val: شافی: آنکه بندگانش را از امراض بدنی و شبهه های قلبی و شهوات نفوس درمان می کند.

english_name.name: Ash-Shāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shāfi (The Healer) is the One Who cures His servants from the illnesses of their bodies, the doubts of their hearts, and the vain desires of their selves.

translations.name: شاکر
translations.short_meaning_val: شاکِر: اوست که دهنده را ستایش می کند و برای طاعتش عطایی به او می بخشد که بیشتر از شایستگی اوست.

english_name.name: Ash-Shākir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shākir (The Appreciative) is the One Who praises those who obey Him and rewards them beyond what is due to them.

translations.name: طَیِّب
translations.short_meaning_val: طَیّب: یعنی آنکه او تعالی، از همهٔ نقصها و عیبها مقدس (پاک) و منزه است.

english_name.name: At-Tayyib
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tayyib (The Good) means that Allah Almighty is extolled and exalted far above all deficiencies and defects.

translations.name: اَعلیٰ
translations.short_meaning_val: اَعلیٰ: نامی است دال بر ثبوب همهٔ معانی عُلُو (بلندی ذات و جایگاه) از همهٔ وجوه: بلندی ذات و بلندی قَدر و بلندی قهر.

english_name.name: Al-A‘la
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-A‘la (The Most High) is a name that denotes the affirmation of all meanings of highness for Allah Almighty from every aspect: highness in His essence, highness in His status, and highness in His power.

translations.name: قَدیر
translations.short_meaning_val: قَدیر: آنکه دارای قدرتِ کامل است و هیچ ناتوانی یا سستی به آن راه نمی یابد.

english_name.name: Al-Qadīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qadīr (The Omnipotent) is the One Who possesses complete power and does not suffer any incapability or fatigue.

translations.name: مَنّان
translations.short_meaning_val: مَنّان: آن نعمت دهندهٔ عطا کنند که موهبتهایش بس بزرگ است و نعمت را پیش از آنکه درخواست شود عطا می کند.

english_name.name: Al-Mannān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mannān (The Bestower of Favors) is the One Who bestows great favors and gives blessings to His servants before they ask for them.

translations.name: مُحیط
translations.short_meaning_val: مُحیط (فراگیر): نامی است دال بر برتری و بالا بودن الله بر بندگانش و احاطه اش بر همه چیز با علم و قدرت و چیرگی.

english_name.name: Al-Muhīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhīt (The All-Encompassing) is a name that denotes the exaltedness of Allah above His creation and that He encompasses everything in terms of knowledge, power, and subjugation.

translations.name: اَکرَم
translations.short_meaning_val: اَکرَم: آنکه خیر و عطایش بسیار است و همهٔ خیر به دست اوست و هر خیر و خوبی از سوی او سبحانه و تعالی است.

english_name.name: Al-Akram
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Akram (The Most Generous) is the One Who gives generously, and all goodness lies in His hand and comes from Him.

translations.name: اِله
translations.short_meaning_val: اِله: جامع همهٔ صفات کمال و اوصاف جلال است، معبودی است که کسی جز او شایستهٔ پرستش نیست.

english_name.name: Al-Ilāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ilāh (The God) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection and majesty and Who alone is worthy of being worshiped.

translations.name: نَصیر
translations.short_meaning_val: نَصیر (یاری دهنده): آنکه بندگان مؤمنش را پیروز می گرداند و یاری می دهد.

english_name.name: An-Nasīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿An-Nasīr (The Helper) is the One Who helps and supports His believing servants.

translations.name: مَولیٰ
translations.short_meaning_val: مَولیٰ: مولای همهٔ آفریدگان، به این معنا که سرور و مالک و خالق و معبود حقیقی آنان است و مولای بندگانش مؤمنش است به این معنا که آنان را دوست دارد و توفیق و یاری می دهد و منافع آنان را به آنان می رساند و هر آنچه به صلاح دین و دنیایشان است را برایشان میسر می گرداند.

english_name.name: Al-Mawla
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mawla (The Protector) of all creation is their Master, Owner, Creator, and True Deity worthy of worship; and Al-Mawla of the believing servants is the One Who loves them, guides and supports them, and leads them to their religious and worldly interests.

translations.name: حَییّ
translations.short_meaning_val: حَییّ: یعنی بسیار باحیا، و این وصفی است که تنها شایستهٔ اوست نه مانند حیای مخلوقات، بلکه به معنای ترک آن چیزی است که با رحمت گستردهٔ او و کمال بخشندگی و کَرَم و عفو و شکیاییِ عظیمش همخوانی ندارد.

english_name.name: Al-Hayiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayiyy (The Modest) is the One Who is very modest. This description befits Allah Almighty and it is nothing like the modesty of people. Rather, it means abandoning what does not suit His vast mercy, perfect generosity, and great forgiveness and forbearance.

translations.name: مُحسِن
translations.short_meaning_val: محسن: آنکه با انواع نعمتهای آشکار و پنهان در حق بندگانش لطف می کند.

english_name.name: Al-Muhsin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhsin (The Superb Benevolent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of outward and inward favors upon His servants.

translations.name: Allāh (Allah)
translations.short_meaning_val: ﻿Allah adalah Ilah yang berhak disembah dengan penuh rasa cinta, harap, dan takut. Nama ini mencakup semua makna Al-Asmā` Al-Ḥusnā dan mengandung semua sifat-sifat Allah -Ta'ālā-.

english_name.name: Allāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Allah is the deity worthy of being worshiped out of love, hope, and fear. This name encompasses all the meanings of the beautiful names and attributes of the Almighty Lord.

translations.name: Ar-Rahmān (Maha Pengasih)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ar-Raḥmān: Pemilik rahmat yang luas lagi besar dan meliputi segala sesuatu.

english_name.name: Ar-Rahmān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahmān (The Most Compassionate) is the One with great and immense mercy that encompasses everything.

translations.name: Ar-Raḥīm (Maha Penyayang)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ar-Raḥīm: Pemilik rahmat agung yang melekat dan dicurahkan pada yang dirahmati.

english_name.name: Ar-Rahīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.

translations.name: Al-Malik (Maharaja)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Malik: Penghimpun sifat-sifat keagungan, kekuasaan, dan pengaturan, serta pemilik segala sesuatu dan pengaturnya tanpa ada perlawanan maupun penolakan.

english_name.name: Al-Malik
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.

translations.name: Al-Quddūs (Mahasuci)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Quddūs: Yang diagungkan dan disucikan dari seluruh sifat kekurangan, dan dari disamai oleh setiap makhluk.

english_name.name: Al-Quddūs
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Quddūs (The Holy One) is the Glorified One Who is exalted far above any defect and far above resembling any of His creation.

translations.name: As-Salām (Mahasejahtera)
translations.short_meaning_val: As-Salām: Yang selamat dari semua kekurangan, cacat, dan aib.

english_name.name: As-Salām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ As-Salām (The Source of Perfection) is the One free from any defect or fault.

translations.name: Al-Mu`min (Maha Pemberi Keamanan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Mu`min: Yang membenarkan para nabi-Nya dengan menegakkan bukti kebenaran dan mukjizat-mukjizat bagi mereka, dan Yang memberi jaminan keamanan bagi makhluk dari kezaliman karena adanya keadilan-Nya yang sempurna.

english_name.name: Al-Mu’min
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.

translations.name: Al-Muhaimin (Maha Memelihara)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Muhaimin: Pengurus seluruh makhluk dan pemutus perkara di antara mereka; Pemelihara dan pengatur mereka; Pemilik ilmu yang meliputi segala sesuatu.

english_name.name: Al-Muhaymin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhaymin (The All-Controller) is the Guardian over His creation, their Ruler, and the Disposer of all their affairs, Who encompasses everything in His knowledge.

translations.name: Al-'Azīz (Mahamulia)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-'Azīz: Pemilik kemuliaan yang sempurna dan Yang mengalahkan selain diri-Nya dengan kekuatan-Nya, keperkasaan-Nya, dan ketahanan-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-‘Azīz
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azīz (The All-Mighty) is the One Who possesses the absolute might and vanquishes all others with His power, dominance, and invincibility.

translations.name: Al-Jabbār (Mahaperkasa)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Jabbār: Yang tinggi di atas makhluk-Nya; Penguasa segala sesuatu; Yang tunduk kepada-Nya segala sesuatu; Yang melindungi dan menghibur orang yang berlindung kepada-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Jabbār
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.

translations.name: Al-Mutakabbir (Mahatakabur)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Mutakabbir: Mahatinggi dan Mahaagung dari berbagai keburukan, kekurangan, dan cacat karena kesempurnaan dan kemulian-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Mutakabbir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mutakabbir (The Supreme) is the One Who is far exalted above evil, deficiency, and defects, given His perfection and majesty.

translations.name: Al-Khāliq (Maha Pencipta)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Khāliq: Pencipta dan pembuat segala sesuatu tanpa ada contoh sebelumnya.

english_name.name: Al-Khāliq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khāliq (The Creator) is the One Who brings things into existence and invents them in an unprecedented way.

translations.name: Al-Bāri` (Maha Pencipta)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Bāri`: Maha Pencipta yang menciptakan semua makhluk, menciptakan rupanya, dan menciptakannya setelah sebelumnya tidak ada.

english_name.name: Al-Bāri’
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Bāri’ (The Initiator) is the Creator Who created the whole creation from nothing and gave them forms after they were non-existent.

translations.name: Al-Muṣawwir (Maha Membentuk Rupa)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Muṣawwir: Yang menciptakan makhluk dengan rupa dan bentuk yang berbeda-beda, yang menunjukkan kesempurnaan ilmu dan hikmah-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Musawwir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Musawwir (The Supreme Fashioner) is the One Who fashioned His creation in different forms and appearances that indicate His perfect knowledge and wisdom.

english_name.name: Al-Ghaffaar
english_name.short_meaning_val:
AL-Ghaffaar (The Great Forgiver)

The Forgiver, The One who forgives the sins of His slaves time and time again

english_name.name: Al-Qahhār
english_name.short_meaning_val: THE ALL-PREVAILING ONE
english_name.meanings_val: <p><span style="font-size: 19px; color: #202122; font-weight: normal; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Arial'; font-style: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none;">The Dominant, The One who has the perfect Power and is not unable over anything.</span></p>

translations.name: Al-Wahhāb (Maha Pemberi)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Wahhāb: Pemilik karunia dan pemberian yang mahaluas dan pemilik kebaikan dan kedermawanan yang meliputi seluruh makhluk.

english_name.name: Al-Wahhāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wahhāb (The Bestower) is the One Who gives abundantly, and Whose generosity and bounty encompass all beings.

translations.name: Ar-Razzāq (Maha Pemberi Rezeki)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ar-Razzāq: Penjamin rezeki para hamba yang menjadi sebab baik dan hidupnya hati dan badan mereka.

english_name.name: Ar-Razzāq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Razzāq (The All-Provider) is the One Who guarantees His servants the sustenance that maintains their hearts and bodies.

translations.name: Al-Fattāḥ (Maha Pemberi Keputusan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Fattāḥ: Pemberi keputusan di antara para hamba-Nya dengan hukum syariat-Nya; Pemberi ketentuan di antara mereka dengan hukum takdir-Nya; Penghisab amalan mereka dengan keadilan hukum balasan dan ganjaran-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Fattāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Fattāh (The Greatest Judge) is the One Who judges between His servants by His religious rulings, decrees His predestination for them, and calls them to account.

translations.name: Al-'Alīm (Maha Mengetahui)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-'Alīm: Pemilik ilmu yang meliputi segala sesuatu.

english_name.name: Al-‘Alīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alīm (The All-Knowing) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses everything.

english_name.name: Al-Qaabid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE RESTRICTING ONE

The Constrictor, The Withholder, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Baasit
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE EXTENDER

The Englarger, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Khaafid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE REDUCER

The One who lowers whoever He willed by His Destruction and raises whoever He willed by His Endowment.

translations.name: Ar-Rāfi' (Maha Meninggikan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ar-Rāfi': Yang meninggikan derajat siapa yang Dia kehendaki sesuai dengan yang Dia kehendaki, seperti mengangkat derajat para wali-Nya di dunia dan akhirat.

english_name.name: Ar-Rāfi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Rāfi‘ (The Raiser) is the One Who raises whomever He wills the way He wills, as He elevates the ranks of His pious servants in this world and in the Hereafter.

translations.name: As-Samī' (Maha Mendengar)
translations.short_meaning_val: As-Samī': Yang mengetahui semua yang terdengar; Allah mengetahui segala rahasia dan bisikan, bagi-Nya sama saja antara suara keras dan pelan, dan antara bicara dan diam.

english_name.name: As-Samī‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samī‘ (The All-Hearing) is the One Who hears everything. He hears secret and private talk. Loud and low voices, and speaking and silence are all the same to Him - He grasps all.

translations.name: Al-Baṣīr (Maha Melihat)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Baṣīr: Yang penglihatan-Nya meliputi segala sesuatu sekalipun halus dan kecil; Yang mampu melihat segala sesuatu; Maha Mengetahuinya dan Maha Melihat segala yang bersifat batin atau tersembunyi darinya.

english_name.name: Al-Basīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Basīr (The All-Seeing) is the One Whose sight encompasses everything, no matter how small or minute they may be, and He is the One Who is All-Aware of everything and All-Knowing of their hidden aspects.

translations.name: Al-Ḥakam (Maha Menetapkan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Ḥakam: Yang hanya kepada-Nyalah penentuan segala sesuatu diserahkan; Dia menetapkan apa yang Dia kehendaki; Dia memutuskan hukum di antara para hamba-Nya dengan benar dan adil.

english_name.name: Al-Hakam
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakam (The Judge) is the One to Whom belongs judgment in all things, and Who ordains what He wills and judges between His servants with the truth and justice.

translations.name: Al-Laṭīf (Mahalembut)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Laṭīf: Yang tidak samar bagi-Nya segala sesuatu walaupun halus nan kecil; Yang Mahabaik kepada hamba-Nya; Yang lembut kepada mereka dan memberi mereka taufik untuk meraih berbagai kebaikan untuk diri mereka.

english_name.name: Al-Latīf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Latīf (The All-Subtle) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, no matter how small it may be, and the One Who shows kindness and leniency to His servants and guides them to what is good for them.

translations.name: Al-Khabīr (Maha Mengetahui Rahasia)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Khabīr: Pemilik ilmu yang meliputi bagian batin segala sesuatu dan yang tersembunyi, sebagaimana ilmu-Nya meliputi segala yang tampak.

english_name.name: Al-Khabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khabīr (The All-Aware) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses the inward and hidden aspects of things, as well as their outward aspects.

translations.name: Al-Ḥalīm (Maha Penyantun)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Ḥalīm: Pemilik kesantunan yang tidak menyegerakan siksa dan azab kepada para hamba-Nya atas dosa-dosa mereka.

english_name.name: Al-Halīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Halīm (The Forbearing) is the One Who possesses deliberation and does not hasten to punish His servants for their sins.

translations.name: Al-'Aẓīm (Mahaagung)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-'Aẓīm: Penghimpun semua sifat kesempurnaan, kemuliaan, kebesaran, dan keagungan; Zat yang dicintai oleh hati dan diagungkan oleh jiwa.

english_name.name: Al-‘Azhīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azhīm (The Magnificent) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection, glory, pride, and majesty, and Who is loved and extolled by His servants.

translations.name: Al-Gafūr (Maha Pengampun)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Gafūr: Pelindung dan penjaga hamba-hamba-Nya dari keburukan dosa mereka dan tidak menyiksa mereka karenanya.

english_name.name: Al-Ghafūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ghafūr (The All-Forgiving) is the One Who spares His servants the evil of their sins and does not punish them.

translations.name: Asy-Syakūr (Maha Mensyukuri)
translations.short_meaning_val: Asy-Syakūr: Yang mensyukuri atau membalas amalan walaupun sedikit dengan pahala yang banyak dan belipat ganda; Yang memaafkan kesalahan walaupun banyak.

english_name.name: Ash-Shakūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shakūr (The Most Appreciative) is the One Who appreciates even little deeds and gives immense and multiple rewards in return, and Who forgives numerous errors.

translations.name: Al-'Aliy (Mahatinggi)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-'Aliy: Pemilik ketinggian mutlak dari semua sisi; ketinggian kedudukan, ketinggian kekuasaan, dan ketinggian zat.

english_name.name: Al-‘Alyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alyy (The High) is the One Who possesses absolute highness in all aspects: His status, His power, and His essence.

translations.name: Al-Kabīr (Mahabesar)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Kabīr: Yang Mahaagung, segala sesuatu berada di bawah-Nya dan tidak ada sesuatu pun yang lebih besar dari-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Kabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kabīr (The Great) is the One Who is greater than everything, and all else are inferior to Him.

translations.name: Al-Ḥafīẓ (Maha Menjaga)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Ḥafīẓ: Penjaga semua makhluk ciptaan-Nya, ilmu-Nya meliputi semua yang Dia adakan, menjaga wali-wali-Nya agar tidak jatuh ke dalam dosa dan kebinasaan, dan menghitung seluruh amal perbuatan hamba beserta menentukan balasannya.

english_name.name: Al-Hafīzh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hafīzh (The All-Preserver) is the One Who preserves what He created; Whose knowledge encompasses all that He brought into existence; Who protects His pious servants from committing sins and ruinous acts; and Who records their deeds and the recompense for them.

translations.name: Al-Muqīt (Maha Pemberi Kecukupan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Muqīt: Penentu kebutuhan dan rezeki seluruh makhluk dengan ilmu-Nya, kemudian Dia mengirimkan dan membagikannya kepada mereka dengan kodrat-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Muqīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqīt (The All-Nourisher) is the One Who determines the sustenance of His creation according to His knowledge, brings it to them with His power, and distributes it amongst them.

translations.name: Al-Ḥasīb (Maha Menghitung)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Ḥasīb: Pemberi kecukupan pada hamba-hamba-Nya yang beriman dan berserah diri kepada-Nya; Yang mengetahui seluruh perbuatan mereka; Penghitung hisab amal perbuatan mereka.

english_name.name: Al-Hasīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hasīb (The Ever-Reckoner) is the One Who grants sufficiency to His believing servants who rely upon Him, and Who knows their deeds and holds them accountable for them.

translations.name: Al-Karīm (Maha Pemurah)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Karīm: Pemilik banyak kebaikan dan berbagai manfaat besar.

english_name.name: Al-Karīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Karīm (The Generous) is the One Who gives abundant good and welfare.

translations.name: Ar-Raqīb (Maha Mengawasi)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ar-Raqīb: Yang melihat segala sesuatu; Yang menyaksikan yang tersembunyi dan samar; Yang mengetahui dan melihat, tidak samar bagi-Nya rahasia dan bisikan apa pun.

english_name.name: Ar-Raqīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Raqīb (The Ever-Watchful) is the One Who watches over everything and witnesses inner thoughts and secrets, and Who knows and sees all things and no secret or private talk is hidden from Him.

translations.name: Al-Mujīb (Maha Mengabulkan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Mujīb: Yang menyambut permintaan orang-orang yang meminta dan permohonan orang-orang yang berdoa dengan pengabulan dan penerimaan.

english_name.name: Al-Mujīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mujīb (The All-Responsive) is the One Who responds to supplications by answering them and to requests by fulfilling them.

translations.name: Al-Wāsi' (Mahaluas)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Wāsi': Pemilik setiap sifat yang bermakna sempurna dan berkadar terbaik.

english_name.name: Al-Wāsi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāsi‘ (The All-Embracing) is the One to Whom belongs the most perfect and complete meaning of every attribute.

translations.name: Al-Ḥakīm (Mahabijaksana)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Ḥakīm: Pemilik sifat kebijaksanaan yang sempurna di dalam perintah dan syariat-syariat-Nya dan pemilik keputusan yang sempurna di antara makhluk-makhluk-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Hakīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakīm (The All-Wise) is the One Who possesses perfect wisdom in His commands and legislations, and perfect judgment between His creation.

translations.name: Al-Wadūd (Maha Pengasih)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Wadūd: Yang mencintai dan dicintai; yaitu Allah mencintai para nabi dan rasul-Nya serta yang mengikuti mereka, dan mereka pun mencintai-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Wadūd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wadūd (The Most Affectionate) is the One Who loves and is loved. He loves His prophets and messengers and their followers, and they love Him.

translations.name: Al-Wadūd (Maha Pengasih)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Wadūd: Yang mencintai dan dicintai; yaitu Allah mencintai para nabi dan rasul-Nya serta yang mengikuti mereka, dan mereka pun mencintai-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Majīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Majīd (The Most Glorious) is the One Who possesses the various attributes of supreme majesty and perfection.

translations.name: Asy-Syahīd (Maha Menyaksikan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Asy-Syahīd: Yang tidak luput dari-Nya sesuatu apa pun, bahkan Dia melihat segala sesuatu, menyaksikannya, dan mengetahui rinciannya.

english_name.name: Ash-Shahīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shahīd (The Ever-Witness) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, rather He knows and witnesses everything and is Aware of its details.

translations.name: Al-Ḥaqq (Mahabenar)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Ḥaqq: Zat yang eksistensi dan wujud-Nya benar-benar hakiki; nama-nama, sifat, perbuatan, hukum, dan balasan-Nya seluruhnya sempurna dan hakiki, tidak sedikit pun di dalamnya yang mengandung kebatilan.

english_name.name: Al-Haqq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Haqq (The Truth) is the True One in terms of His being and His existence; and the One Whose names, attributes, actions, judgments, and recompense are all perfect and true.

translations.name: Al-Wakīl (Maha Memelihara)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Wakīl: Penjamin seluruh rezeki makhluk-Nya; Pemelihara berbagai maslahat mereka; Pembela para wali-Nya dengan memudahkan mereka kepada kebaikan, menjauhkan mereka dari kesulitan, dan mencukupkan urusan mereka.

english_name.name: Al-Wakīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wakīl (The Trustee) is the One Who guarantees the sustenance of His creation and manages their affairs and maintains their welfare; and Who supports His pious servants and, thus, guides them to ease, grants them sufficiency, and keeps them away from difficulty.

translations.name: Al-Qawiy (Mahakuat)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Qawiy: Yang Mahasempurna kekuatan-Nya, tidak ada yang mengalahkan-Nya dan tidak ada yang dapat menolak ketetapan-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Qawiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qawiyy (The All-Powerful) is the One with complete power Who cannot be overcome and Whose predestination cannot be repelled.

translations.name: Al-Matīn (Mahakukuh)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Matīn: Pemilik puncak kekuatan dan kekuasaan, sehingga tidak dihinggapi oleh kelemahan dan kesulitan.

english_name.name: Al-Matīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Matīn (The Most Firm) is the One Who possesses infinite power and ability so He never experiences any weakness or hardship.

translations.name: Al-Waliy (Maha Penolong)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Waliy: Penolong hamba-hamba-Nya yang beriman dan pemelihara urusan semua makhluk-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Walyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Walyy (The Guardian) is the One Who supports His believing servants and manages the affairs of all His creation.

translations.name: Al-Ḥamīd (Maha Terpuji)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Ḥamīd: sebuah nama yang menunjukkan semua pujian dan kesempurnaan bagi Allah -Ta'ālā-; Yang berhak mendapatkan pujian karena kesempurnaan-Nya pada zat-Nya, nama-nama-Nya, sifat-sifat-Nya, dan perbuatan-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Hamīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hamīd (The Praiseworthy) is a name that denotes all the praiseworthy and perfect attributes of Allah Almighty, Who deserves praise for the perfection of His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: Al-Ḥayyu (Mahahidup)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Ḥayyu: Pemilik semua hakikat kehidupan yang sempurna, tidak didahului oleh ketidakadaan dan tidak akan disusul oleh kefanaan.

english_name.name: Al-Hayy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayy (The Ever-Living) is the One to Whom belong all meanings of perfect life that is not preceded by nothingness nor followed by doom.

translations.name: Al-Qayyūm (Maha Berdiri Sendiri)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Qayyūm: Yang Maha Berdiri Sendiri, tidak membutuhkan siapa pun, dan segala sesuatu tegak dengan-Nya; tidak ada yang tidak butuh kepada-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Qayyūm
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Qayyūm (The Self-Subsisting) is the One Who is self-sustaining, so He does not need anyone, and everything depends on Him and none can dispense with Him.

translations.name: Al-Wāḥid (Mahatunggal)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Wāḥid: Mahatunggal dalam semua kesempurnaan diri-Nya, pada Zat-Nya, sifat-sifat-Nya, dan perbuatan-perbuatan-Nya; tidak ada sekutu bagi-Nya dalam hal itu sedikit pun.

english_name.name: Al-Wāhid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāhid (The One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His essence, attributes, and actions, and none shares any of this with Him.

translations.name: Aṣ-Ṣamad (Maha Dibutuhkan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Aṣ-Ṣamad: Rabb yang Mahasempurna; Tuhan yang Mahaagung; Yang dituju dalam segala hajat dengan penuh harap dan takut.

english_name.name: As-Samad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samad (The Eternal Refuge) is the Perfect Lord and the Magnificent Master to Whom everyone turns, out of hope and fear.

translations.name: Al-Qādir (Mahakuasa)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Qādir: Pemilik kekuasaan yang sempurna, universal, dan paripurna; tidak terkalahkan oleh sesuatu pun dan tidak ada yang lepas dari-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Qādir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qādir (The Able) is the One Who possesses complete and comprehensive power, nothing can challenge Him, and none can escape His power or will.

translations.name: Al-Muqtadir (Maha Berkuasa)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Muqtadir: Pemilik kekuasaan sempurna yang tidak ada hal mustahil bagi-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Muqtadir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqtadir (The Dominant) is the One Who possesses complete unopposed power.

translations.name: Al-Muqaddim (Maha Mendahulukan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Muqaddim: Yang menempatkan sesuatu pada tempat yang menjadi haknya, Dia mendahulukan dan mengakhirkan apa saja yang Dia kehendaki.

english_name.name: Al-Muqaddim
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqaddim (The Advancer) is the One Who puts things in their due places, advancing what He wills and delaying what He wills.

translations.name: Al-Mu`akh-khir (Maha Mengakhirkan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Mu`akh-khir: Yang mengakhirkan sesuatu yang berhak diakhirkan lalu menempatkannya pada tempat yang tepat.

english_name.name: Al-Mu’akhkhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu’akhkhir (The Delayer) is the One Who delays things that should be delayed, thus putting them in their proper place.

translations.name: Al-Awwal (Mahaawal)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Awwal: Yang tidak ada sesuatu pun sebelum-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Awwal
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Awwal (The First) is the One before Whom there was nothing.

translations.name: Al-Ākhir (Mahaakhir)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Ākhir: Yang tidak ada sesuatu pun setelah-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Ākhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ākhir (The Last) is the One after Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: Aẓ-Ẓāhir (Mahalahir)
translations.short_meaning_val: Aẓ-Ẓāhir: Yang tidak ada sesuatu pun di atas-Nya.

english_name.name: Azh-Zhāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Azh-Zhāhir (The Manifest) is the One above Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: Al-Bāṭin (Mahabatin)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Bāṭin: Yang tidak ada sesuatu pun di bawah-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Bātin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Bātin (The Hidden) is the One beneath Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: Al-Muta'āl (Mahatinggi)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Muta'āl: nama yang menunjukkan ketinggian mutlak bagi Allah dari semua sisi; ketinggian zat, ketinggian kedudukan, dan ketinggian kekuasaan.

english_name.name: Al-Muta‘āl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muta‘āl (The Exalted) is a name that denotes the absolute exaltation of Allah in all aspects: His essence, His status, and His power.

translations.name: Al-Barr (Mahabaik)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Barr: Mahabaik yang memberi berbagai macam nikmat kepada para hamba.

english_name.name: Al-Barr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Barr (The Beneficent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of blessings upon His servants.

translations.name: At-Tawwāb (Maha Pemberi Tobat)
translations.short_meaning_val: At-Tawwāb: Pemberi taufik kepada hamba untuk bertobat lalu Dia menerima tobatnya.

english_name.name: At-Tawwāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tawwāb (The Accepting of Repentance) is the One Who guides His servants to repentance and accepts it from them.

translations.name: Al-'Afuw (Maha Pemaaf)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-'Afuw: Yang menghapus segala dosa dan memaafkan kemaksiatan.

english_name.name: Al-‘Afuww
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Afuww (The Pardoner) is the One Who erases misdeeds and pardons sins.

translations.name: Ar-Ra`ūf (Maha Pembelas)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ar-Ra`ūf: Yang sangat berbelas kasih kepada hamba-hamba-Nya.

english_name.name: Ar-Ra’ūf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Ra’ūf (The All-Kind) is the One Who is the most kind and merciful towards His creation.

english_name.name: Maalik-Ul-Mulk
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE ETERNAL POSSESSOR OF SOVEREIGNTY

The One who controls the Dominion and gives dominion to whoever He willed.

translations.name: Żul-Jalāl wal-Ikrām (Pemilik Kebesaran dan Keagungan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Żul-Jalāl wal-Ikrām: Pemilik keagungan, kebesaran, rahmat dan kemurahan hati; Yang berhak diagungkan dan dipuji.

english_name.name: Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām (Lord of Majesty and Bounty) is the Possessor of greatness, pride, mercy, and bounty, Who deserves glorification and praise.

translations.name: Al-Ganīy (Mahakaya)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Ganīy: Yang segala sesuatu membutuhkan diri-Nya, sementara Dia tidak membutuhkan siapa pun.

english_name.name: A-Ghanyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿A-Ghanyy (The Self-Sufficient) is the One Who is needed by all and Who does not need anyone.

translations.name: Al-Hādī (Maha Pemberi Petunjuk, Maha Penuntun)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Hādī: Yang menuntun hamba-Nya kepada semua yang memberinya manfaat dan menjauhkannya dari mudarat, serta memberikan taufik kepada siapa yang dikehendaki-Nya agar mendapatkan hidayah.

english_name.name: Al-Hādi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hādi (The Guide) is the One Who guides His servants to all beneficial things and leads them away from harmful ones, and Who leads whomever He wills to guidance.

translations.name: Al-Wāriṡ (Maha Pewaris)
translations.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāriṡ: Yang Mahakekal setelah makhluk punah, mewarisi bumi dan semua yang ada padanya.

english_name.name: Al-Wārith
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wārith (The Inheritor) is the One Who lasts after the doom of all creation and Who inherits the earth and all that is in it.

translations.name: Al-Jamīl (Mahaindah)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Jamīl: Pemilik keindahan mutlak pada Zat-Nya, nama dan sifat-Nya, dan perbuatan-perbuatan-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Jamīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jamīl (The Beautiful) is the One Who possesses absolute beauty in His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: Al-Qāhir (Mahakuasa)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Qāhir: Yang seluruh makhluk tunduk dan menghinakan diri kepada-Nya; semuanya tunduk kepada kekuasaan dan kehendak-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Qāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qāhir (The Vanquisher) is the One to Whom all beings submit and before Whose power and will all beings stand humbly.

translations.name: Al-Qarīb (Mahadekat)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Qarīb: Yang Mahadekat balasan pahala-Nya bagi orang yang taat, dekat pengabulan-Nya dari orang yang berdoa, dan dekat ilmu-Nya dari semua hamba-Nya, dan hal itu tidak menafikan ketinggian-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Qarīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qarīb (The Near) is the One Who is near His obedient servants with reward; near those who supplicate Him with the answer; and near the rest of His servants with knowledge. This does not contradict His being high above.

translations.name: Ar-Rabb (Tuhan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ar-Rabb: Yang Maha dipertuan; Yang Maha Menguasai; Yang memperbaiki selain-Nya; Pembina semua hamba-Nya dengan berbagai pengaturan dan curahan beragam karunia.

english_name.name: Ar-Rabb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rabb (The Lord) is the Master, the Owner, the Reformer, and the One Who fosters His servants by managing their affairs and bestowing favors upon them.

translations.name: Al-Mubīn (Maha Menjelaskan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Mubīn: Yang jelas keesaan-Nya, tidak ada sekutu bagi-Nya, dan Yang menjelaskan kebenaran bagi hamba-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Mubīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mubīn (The Evident) is the One Who is evident in His Oneness and that He has no partner, and Who clarifies the truth to His servants.

translations.name: Al-Mu'ṭī (Maha Pemberi)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Mu'ṭī: Yang Mahatunggal dalam pemberian secara hakiki, tidak ada yang bisa menghalangi apa yang Dia beri dan tidak ada yang bisa memberikan apa yang Dia tahan.

english_name.name: Al-Mu‘ti
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu‘ti (The Giver) is the only One Who gives, and no one can withhold what He has given or give what He has withheld.

translations.name: Al-Kāfī (Maha Mencukupi)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Kāfī: Pemberi kecukupan pada semua hamba-Nya di semua kebutuhan mereka; Yang dengan inayat-Nya seseorang tak lagi memerlukan inayat selain-Nya; Dialah satu-satu-Nya yang dibutuhkan tanpa selain-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Kāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kāfi (The All-Sufficient) is the One Who fulfills all the needs of His servants and Who is sufficient for them beyond need for anyone else.

translations.name: Al-Witr (Mahatunggal)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Witr: Yang tunggal, tidak ada sekutu dan tandingan bagi-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Witr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Witr (The Odd) is the One Who has no partner or equal.

translations.name: Al-Aḥad (Maha Esa)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Aḥad: Yang Maha Esa dalam semua kesempurnaan; dalam rubūbiyyah (sifat ketuhanan), ulūhiyyah (sifat keilahian), dan asmā` (nama-nama) serta sifat-sifat-Nya, tidak ada seorang pun yang menjadi sekutu-Nya di dalamnya.

english_name.name: Al-Ahad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ahad (The Only One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His lordship, divinity, names, and attributes, and none shares any of them with Him.

translations.name: Al-Jawād (Mahadermawan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Jawād: Maha Pemberi karunia yang mencakup semua makhluk.

english_name.name: Al-Jawād
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jawād (The Munificent) is the One Who gives abundantly to all creatures.

translations.name: Ar-Rafīq (Mahalembut)
translations.short_meaning_val: Ar-Rafīq: Yang Mahalembut dan bertahap secara perlahan dalam segala urusan, dan tidak terburu-buru dalam menghukum para pelaku maksiat.

english_name.name: Ar-Rafīq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rafīq (The Kind) is the One Who acts deliberately and gradually, and does not hasten to punish sinners.

translations.name: As-Sayyid (Yang Maha Dipertuan)
translations.short_meaning_val: As-Sayyid: Tuhan, Yang Maha Memiliki, Yang dipertuan secara hakiki, dan hanya kepada-Nya semua makhluk kembali dalam semua urusan dunia dan akhirat.

english_name.name: As-Sayyid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Sayyid (The Master) is the Lord and the Owner, the One Who possesses true dominance, and to Whom all creation turns for their worldly and their Hereafter affairs.

translations.name: As-Subbūḥ (Mahasuci)
translations.short_meaning_val: As-Subbūḥ: Yang suci dari kekurangan dan cacat, serta diagungkan dan disucikan oleh semua yang ada di langit dan bumi.

english_name.name: As-Subbūh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Subbūh (The All-Glorious) is the One far exalted above deficiencies and defects and Who is extolled and glorified by all those in the heavens and the earth.

translations.name: Asy-Syāfī (Maha Penyembuh)
translations.short_meaning_val: Asy-Syāfī: Penyembuh para hamba dari penyakit fisik, syubhat hati, dan syahwat jiwa.

english_name.name: Ash-Shāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shāfi (The Healer) is the One Who cures His servants from the illnesses of their bodies, the doubts of their hearts, and the vain desires of their selves.

translations.name: Asy-Syākir (Maha Mensyukuri)
translations.short_meaning_val: Asy-Syākir: Yang memuji dan menyanjung setiap yang menaati-Nya, serta memberinya pahala atas ketaatannya dengan kadar pahala yang lebih dari kadar haknya.

english_name.name: Ash-Shākir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shākir (The Appreciative) is the One Who praises those who obey Him and rewards them beyond what is due to them.

translations.name: Aṭ-Ṭayyib (Mahabaik)
translations.short_meaning_val: Aṭ-Ṭayyib: Allah -Ta'ālā- diagungkan dan disucikan dari seluruh kekurangan dan cacat.

english_name.name: At-Tayyib
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tayyib (The Good) means that Allah Almighty is extolled and exalted far above all deficiencies and defects.

translations.name: Al-A'lā (Mahatinggi)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-A'lā: nama yang menetapkan semua makna ketinggian bagi Allah dari semua sisi; ketinggian zat, ketinggian kedudukan, dan ketinggian kekuasaan.

english_name.name: Al-A‘la
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-A‘la (The Most High) is a name that denotes the affirmation of all meanings of highness for Allah Almighty from every aspect: highness in His essence, highness in His status, and highness in His power.

translations.name: Al-Qadīr (Mahakuasa)
translations.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qadīr: Pemilik kekuasaan sempurna yang tidak dihinggapi kelemahan dan keletihan.

english_name.name: Al-Qadīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qadīr (The Omnipotent) is the One Who possesses complete power and does not suffer any incapability or fatigue.

translations.name: Al-Mannān (Maha Pemberi Karunia)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Mannān: Penyedia dan pemberi karunia; Pemilik berbagai anugerah besar; Penderma yang memberi nikmat sebelum diminta.

english_name.name: Al-Mannān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mannān (The Bestower of Favors) is the One Who bestows great favors and gives blessings to His servants before they ask for them.

translations.name: Al-Muḥīṭ (Maha Meliputi)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Muḥīṭ: nama yang menunjukkan ketinggian Allah di atas makhluk-makhluk-Nya, dan bahwa ilmu dan kekuasaan-Nya meliputi segala sesuatu.

english_name.name: Al-Muhīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhīt (The All-Encompassing) is a name that denotes the exaltedness of Allah above His creation and that He encompasses everything in terms of knowledge, power, and subjugation.

translations.name: Al-Akram (Mahamulia)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Akram: Pemilik banyak kebaikan dan karunia, Yang seluruh kebaikan ada di Tangan-Nya, dan dari-Nyalah semua kebaikan berasal.

english_name.name: Al-Akram
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Akram (The Most Generous) is the One Who gives generously, and all goodness lies in His hand and comes from Him.

translations.name: Al-Ilāh (Sembahan)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Ilāh: Penghimpun seluruh sifat kesempurnaan dan kemuliaan; Sembahan yang tidak ada seorang pun berhak disembah selain-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Ilāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ilāh (The God) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection and majesty and Who alone is worthy of being worshiped.

translations.name: An-Naṣīr (Maha Penolong)
translations.short_meaning_val: An-Naṣīr: Penolong dan pelindung hamba-hamba-Nya yang beriman.

english_name.name: An-Nasīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿An-Nasīr (The Helper) is the One Who helps and supports His believing servants.

translations.name: Al-Maulā (Maha Pelindung)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Maulā: Maha Pelindung bagi seluruh makhluk. Dengan kata lain, bahwa Allah adalah pelindung, pemilik, pencipta, dan sesembahan mereka yang hak. Dia adalah pelindung hamba-hamba-Nya yang beriman; Dia mencintai mereka; Dia memberikan taufik dan menolong mereka; Dia mengirimkan apa yang menjadi maslahat mereka; Dia memudahkan bagi mereka seluruh manfaat dunia dan agama.

english_name.name: Al-Mawla
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mawla (The Protector) of all creation is their Master, Owner, Creator, and True Deity worthy of worship; and Al-Mawla of the believing servants is the One Who loves them, guides and supports them, and leads them to their religious and worldly interests.

translations.name: Al-Ḥayiy (Maha Pemalu)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Ḥayiy: Yang sangat pemalu. Yaitu sifat malu yang pantas dengan-Nya, tidak seperti sifa malu para makhluk. Ia adalah sifat malu berupa meninggalkan yang tidak pantas dengan keluasan rahmat-Nya, kesempurnaan sifat dermawan-Nya, dan kebesaran sifat pemaaf dan santun-Nya.

english_name.name: Al-Hayiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayiyy (The Modest) is the One Who is very modest. This description befits Allah Almighty and it is nothing like the modesty of people. Rather, it means abandoning what does not suit His vast mercy, perfect generosity, and great forgiveness and forbearance.

translations.name: Al-Muḥsin (Maha Berbuat Baik)
translations.short_meaning_val: Al-Muḥsin: Yang memberi hamba-Nya berbagai jenis karunia, baik yang lahiriah maupun yang batin.

english_name.name: Al-Muhsin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhsin (The Superb Benevolent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of outward and inward favors upon His servants.

translations.name: 真主
translations.short_meaning_val: ﻿真主：就是真正应受崇拜的主宰，并带着喜悦、希望和害怕，这一名称集合了真主所有尊名之含意，也包括了崇高真主的其他属性。

english_name.name: Allāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Allah is the deity worthy of being worshiped out of love, hope, and fear. This name encompasses all the meanings of the beautiful names and attributes of the Almighty Lord.

translations.name: 普慈的
translations.short_meaning_val: 普慈的：具有宽宏大量，涵盖一切的仁慈。

english_name.name: Ar-Rahmān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahmān (The Most Compassionate) is the One with great and immense mercy that encompasses everything.

translations.name: 特慈的
translations.short_meaning_val: 特慈的：具有伟大仁慈，常系被疼慈之人的主宰

english_name.name: Ar-Rahīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.

translations.name: 国权
translations.short_meaning_val: 国权：是一种对伟大、征服、计划之属性的一种描述，是所有一切的掌管者，调配者，其中没有夸张，没有争论。

english_name.name: Al-Malik
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.

translations.name: 神圣的
translations.short_meaning_val: 神圣的：伟大的、没有任何瑕疵的，没有任何被造物可以比拟。

english_name.name: Al-Quddūs
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Quddūs (The Holy One) is the Glorified One Who is exalted far above any defect and far above resembling any of His creation.

translations.name: 平安的
translations.short_meaning_val: 平安的：平安没有任何缺点、残疾和毛病。

english_name.name: As-Salām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ As-Salām (The Source of Perfection) is the One free from any defect or fault.

translations.name: 信士
translations.short_meaning_val: 信士：坚信众先知所带来的一切明证和奇迹，并使众生免遭压迫，这是出自信士完美的公正。

english_name.name: Al-Mu’min
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.

translations.name: 掌控的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 掌控的主：站在众生之上，统治者他们，安排他们事务，周知一切。

english_name.name: Al-Muhaymin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhaymin (The All-Controller) is the Guardian over His creation, their Ruler, and the Disposer of all their affairs, Who encompasses everything in His knowledge.

translations.name: 强胜的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 强胜的主：他具有完美的能力，以他的力量、强胜和阻挡力掌控着一切。

english_name.name: Al-‘Azīz
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azīz (The All-Mighty) is the One Who possesses the absolute might and vanquishes all others with His power, dominance, and invincibility.

translations.name: 强大的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 强大的主：在众生之上，掌控一切，所有的一切都信仰他，臣服于他，不得不求助于他。

english_name.name: Al-Jabbār
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.

translations.name: 尊大的
translations.short_meaning_val: 尊大的：他是崇高伟大的，具有一切完美尊严的，超越一切恶、缺陷和不足。

english_name.name: Al-Mutakabbir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mutakabbir (The Supreme) is the One Who is far exalted above evil, deficiency, and defects, given His perfection and majesty.

translations.name: 创造者
translations.short_meaning_val: 创造者：创造万物，使他们从无到有。

english_name.name: Al-Khāliq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khāliq (The Creator) is the One Who brings things into existence and invents them in an unprecedented way.

translations.name: 造化者
translations.short_meaning_val: 造化者：创造了所有的一切，并赋予其形状，使他们从无到有。

english_name.name: Al-Bāri’
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Bāri’ (The Initiator) is the Creator Who created the whole creation from nothing and gave them forms after they were non-existent.

translations.name: 赋形者
translations.short_meaning_val: 赋形者：真主赋予众生不同的外表和生动的形象，证明了真主完美的知识和睿智。

english_name.name: Al-Musawwir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Musawwir (The Supreme Fashioner) is the One Who fashioned His creation in different forms and appearances that indicate His perfect knowledge and wisdom.

english_name.name: Al-Ghaffaar
english_name.short_meaning_val:
AL-Ghaffaar (The Great Forgiver)

The Forgiver, The One who forgives the sins of His slaves time and time again

english_name.name: Al-Qahhār
english_name.short_meaning_val: THE ALL-PREVAILING ONE
english_name.meanings_val: <p><span style="font-size: 19px; color: #202122; font-weight: normal; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Arial'; font-style: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none;">The Dominant, The One who has the perfect Power and is not unable over anything.</span></p>

translations.name: 博施的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 博施的主：真主是广泛恩赐和馈赠的主，以他的慷慨大方惠及所有的被造物。

english_name.name: Al-Wahhāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wahhāb (The Bestower) is the One Who gives abundantly, and Whose generosity and bounty encompass all beings.

translations.name: 赐予给养的
translations.short_meaning_val: 赐予给养的：给仆人提供给养的主，这些给养使他们身心得以成长。

english_name.name: Ar-Razzāq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Razzāq (The All-Provider) is the One Who guarantees His servants the sustenance that maintains their hearts and bodies.

translations.name: 开拓的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 开拓的主：他在仆人之间以教法进行裁决，以他前定的律法判决他们，以他的奖罚律法清算他们。

english_name.name: Al-Fattāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Fattāh (The Greatest Judge) is the One Who judges between His servants by His religious rulings, decrees His predestination for them, and calls them to account.

translations.name: 全知的
translations.short_meaning_val: 全知的：就是知道一切的主。

english_name.name: Al-‘Alīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alīm (The All-Knowing) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses everything.

english_name.name: Al-Qaabid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE RESTRICTING ONE

The Constrictor, The Withholder, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Baasit
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE EXTENDER

The Englarger, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Khaafid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE REDUCER

The One who lowers whoever He willed by His Destruction and raises whoever He willed by His Endowment.

translations.name: 提升的
translations.short_meaning_val: 提升的：真主按照他的意欲，提升他所意欲者，如他在今后两世提升他的盟友们。

english_name.name: Ar-Rāfi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Rāfi‘ (The Raiser) is the One Who raises whomever He wills the way He wills, as He elevates the ranks of His pious servants in this world and in the Hereafter.

translations.name: 全听的
translations.short_meaning_val: 全听的：能够得知所有的声音，能够听到公开的和秘密的，无论是高声还是低声，发音还是未发音。

english_name.name: As-Samī‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samī‘ (The All-Hearing) is the One Who hears everything. He hears secret and private talk. Loud and low voices, and speaking and silence are all the same to Him - He grasps all.

translations.name: 全观的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 全观的主：能够看到一切的主，即使细微，明鉴一切，周知万物，透析所有。

english_name.name: Al-Basīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Basīr (The All-Seeing) is the One Whose sight encompasses everything, no matter how small or minute they may be, and He is the One Who is All-Aware of everything and All-Knowing of their hidden aspects.

translations.name: 判决者
translations.short_meaning_val: 判决者：判决一切的主，以他的意欲而判决，在他的仆人之间以真理和公正而判决。

english_name.name: Al-Hakam
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakam (The Judge) is the One to Whom belongs judgment in all things, and Who ordains what He wills and judges between His servants with the truth and justice.

translations.name: 精明的
translations.short_meaning_val: 精明的：没有什么东西可以对他隐藏，即使是很细小的东西，善待他的仆人，怜悯他们，使他们在有益于他们的事务中顺利。

english_name.name: Al-Latīf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Latīf (The All-Subtle) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, no matter how small it may be, and the One Who shows kindness and leniency to His servants and guides them to what is good for them.

translations.name: 彻知的
translations.short_meaning_val: 彻知的：他是知道事物内在的、隐藏的和外表的主。

english_name.name: Al-Khabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khabīr (The All-Aware) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses the inward and hidden aspects of things, as well as their outward aspects.

translations.name: 至容的
translations.short_meaning_val: 至容的：不急于使他的仆人以他们的罪行遭受惩罚的宽容的主。

english_name.name: Al-Halīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Halīm (The Forbearing) is the One Who possesses deliberation and does not hasten to punish His servants for their sins.

translations.name: 伟大的
translations.short_meaning_val: 伟大的：集所有完美、荣耀、尊大和伟大的属性与一体，心悦诚服并发自内心的尊重。

english_name.name: Al-‘Azhīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azhīm (The Magnificent) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection, glory, pride, and majesty, and Who is loved and extolled by His servants.

translations.name: 饶恕的
translations.short_meaning_val: 饶恕的：保护他的仆人免受罪恶的折磨，不以他们的罪行而惩罚他们。

english_name.name: Al-Ghafūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ghafūr (The All-Forgiving) is the One Who spares His servants the evil of their sins and does not punish them.

translations.name: 感谢的
translations.short_meaning_val: 感谢的：给很少的善功给予加倍的、巨大的回报，对许多的过失给予宽恕。

english_name.name: Ash-Shakūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shakūr (The Most Appreciative) is the One Who appreciates even little deeds and gives immense and multiple rewards in return, and Who forgives numerous errors.

translations.name: 至高无上的
translations.short_meaning_val: 至高无上的：无论任何方面，他都有绝对的至高，即地位高、权利高、本体高。

english_name.name: Al-‘Alyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alyy (The High) is the One Who possesses absolute highness in all aspects: His status, His power, and His essence.

translations.name: 至大的
translations.short_meaning_val: 至大的：他是伟大的主，没有什么比他更大，他是至大的。

english_name.name: Al-Kabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kabīr (The Great) is the One Who is greater than everything, and all else are inferior to Him.

translations.name: 维护万物的
translations.short_meaning_val: 维护万物的：真主是保护他的众生的，真主确知他所造化的一切，保护他们免遭罪责和毁灭，他为仆人统计他们的善功和回赐。

english_name.name: Al-Hafīzh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hafīzh (The All-Preserver) is the One Who preserves what He created; Whose knowledge encompasses all that He brought into existence; Who protects His pious servants from committing sins and ruinous acts; and Who records their deeds and the recompense for them.

translations.name: 供给的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 供给的主：以他的知识为众生定量给养，然后以他的能力将给养分配和派送给他们。

english_name.name: Al-Muqīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqīt (The All-Nourisher) is the One Who determines the sustenance of His creation according to His knowledge, brings it to them with His power, and distributes it amongst them.

translations.name: 清算者
translations.short_meaning_val: 清算者：能满足信仰且托靠他的信士仆人，洞察仆人的行为，并以此清算他们。

english_name.name: Al-Hasīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hasīb (The Ever-Reckoner) is the One Who grants sufficiency to His believing servants who rely upon Him, and Who knows their deeds and holds them accountable for them.

translations.name: 慷慨的
translations.short_meaning_val: 慷慨的：即多福多利的主。

english_name.name: Al-Karīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Karīm (The Generous) is the One Who gives abundant good and welfare.

translations.name: 监视的
translations.short_meaning_val: 监视的：洞察一切的主，可以看到秘密和内心的主，他能够知道和看到一切，任何秘密都不能隐藏于他。

english_name.name: Ar-Raqīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Raqīb (The Ever-Watchful) is the One Who watches over everything and witnesses inner thoughts and secrets, and Who knows and sees all things and no secret or private talk is hidden from Him.

translations.name: 应答的
translations.short_meaning_val: 应答的：他是应答和接受祈祷之人的祈祷，要求之人的要求。

english_name.name: Al-Mujīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mujīb (The All-Responsive) is the One Who responds to supplications by answering them and to requests by fulfilling them.

translations.name: 宽大的
translations.short_meaning_val: 宽大的：所有对完整意义和完全能力的描述都属于真主。

english_name.name: Al-Wāsi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāsi‘ (The All-Embracing) is the One to Whom belongs the most perfect and complete meaning of every attribute.

translations.name: 睿智的
translations.short_meaning_val: 睿智的：这是对真主在他的命令和立法中的完美智慧，及众生之间的完美裁决的表述。

english_name.name: Al-Hakīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakīm (The All-Wise) is the One Who possesses perfect wisdom in His commands and legislations, and perfect judgment between His creation.

translations.name: 至爱的
translations.short_meaning_val: 至爱的：即喜爱被喜爱者，他喜爱他的众先知、使者及其跟随者们，他们也喜爱他。

english_name.name: Al-Wadūd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wadūd (The Most Affectionate) is the One Who loves and is loved. He loves His prophets and messengers and their followers, and they love Him.

translations.name: 至爱的
translations.short_meaning_val: 至爱的：即喜爱被喜爱者，他喜爱他的众先知、使者及其跟随者们，他们也喜爱他。

english_name.name: Al-Majīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Majīd (The Most Glorious) is the One Who possesses the various attributes of supreme majesty and perfection.

translations.name: 见证的
translations.short_meaning_val: 见证的：没有任何东西可以对真主隐藏，他是洞察和见证一切的主，彻知所有的细节。

english_name.name: Ash-Shahīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shahīd (The Ever-Witness) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, rather He knows and witnesses everything and is Aware of its details.

translations.name: 真宰
translations.short_meaning_val: 真宰：即真主的存在是真实的，他的尊名、属性、行为、判决和赏赐是真实的，所有这一切都是完美的、真实的，其中没有任何的虚妄。

english_name.name: Al-Haqq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Haqq (The Truth) is the True One in terms of His being and His existence; and the One Whose names, attributes, actions, judgments, and recompense are all perfect and true.

translations.name: 受托的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 受托的主：保障他的众生给养的主，赋予他们福利的主，为他的盟友担保一切，真主使他们容易，不使他们困难，保障他们的事务。

english_name.name: Al-Wakīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wakīl (The Trustee) is the One Who guarantees the sustenance of His creation and manages their affairs and maintains their welfare; and Who supports His pious servants and, thus, guides them to ease, grants them sufficiency, and keeps them away from difficulty.

translations.name: 强大的
translations.short_meaning_val: 强大的：具有完美力量，任何人不可战胜他，他所判决的事物任何人不能阻止。

english_name.name: Al-Qawiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qawiyy (The All-Powerful) is the One with complete power Who cannot be overcome and Whose predestination cannot be repelled.

translations.name: 坚定的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 坚定的主：具有无极限的力量和能力，任何软弱和困难不能到于他。

english_name.name: Al-Matīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Matīn (The Most Firm) is the One Who possesses infinite power and ability so He never experiences any weakness or hardship.

translations.name: 掌管的
translations.short_meaning_val: 掌管的：援助他的信士仆人的主，主持他的众生一切事务的主。

english_name.name: Al-Walyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Walyy (The Guardian) is the One Who supports His believing servants and manages the affairs of all His creation.

translations.name: 可颂的
translations.short_meaning_val: 可颂的：为真主证明所有完美的和可颂的一个名称，因真主本体、名称和属性之完美，故他应受一切赞颂。

english_name.name: Al-Hamīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hamīd (The Praiseworthy) is a name that denotes all the praiseworthy and perfect attributes of Allah Almighty, Who deserves praise for the perfection of His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: 永生的
translations.short_meaning_val: 永生的：他是空前绝后的，集所有完美生命意义为一体的主。

english_name.name: Al-Hayy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayy (The Ever-Living) is the One to Whom belong all meanings of perfect life that is not preceded by nothingness nor followed by doom.

translations.name: 不灭的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 不灭的主：真主是自主的，他不需要任何人，所有的一切都依靠他，而他无求于任何物。

english_name.name: Al-Qayyūm
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Qayyūm (The Self-Subsisting) is the One Who is self-sustaining, so He does not need anyone, and everything depends on Him and none can dispense with Him.

translations.name: 独一的
translations.short_meaning_val: 独一的：在真主的本体、属性和行为的所有完美性中是独一的，在这一切中他没有任何匹敌。

english_name.name: Al-Wāhid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāhid (The One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His essence, attributes, and actions, and none shares any of this with Him.

translations.name: 万物仰赖的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 万物仰赖的主：完美的养育者，伟大的掌管者，在任何需求都是仆人害怕和希望的主宰。

english_name.name: As-Samad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samad (The Eternal Refuge) is the Perfect Lord and the Magnificent Master to Whom everyone turns, out of hope and fear.

translations.name: 全能的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 全能的主：他是具有完全、全面、绝对能力的主，任何物不能使其无能，他不会放弃任何要求。

english_name.name: Al-Qādir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qādir (The Able) is the One Who possesses complete and comprehensive power, nothing can challenge Him, and none can escape His power or will.

translations.name: 万能的
translations.short_meaning_val: 万能的：具有完全能力的主，没有什么可以阻止他。

english_name.name: Al-Muqtadir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqtadir (The Dominant) is the One Who possesses complete unopposed power.

translations.name: 提前的
translations.short_meaning_val: 提前的：将事物放在应该放置的地方，提前他所意欲提前的，退后他所意欲退后的。

english_name.name: Al-Muqaddim
