english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqaddim (The Advancer) is the One Who puts things in their due places, advancing what He wills and delaying what He wills.

translations.name: 推迟者
translations.short_meaning_val: 推迟者：将应该推迟的事务推迟，将其放在它的位置。

english_name.name: Al-Mu’akhkhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu’akhkhir (The Delayer) is the One Who delays things that should be delayed, thus putting them in their proper place.

translations.name: 前无始的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 前无始的主：在真主之前没有任何物。

english_name.name: Al-Awwal
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Awwal (The First) is the One before Whom there was nothing.

translations.name: 后无终的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 后无终的主：在真主以后再无他物。

english_name.name: Al-Ākhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ākhir (The Last) is the One after Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: 明显的
translations.short_meaning_val: 明显的：真主之上没有任何一物。

english_name.name: Azh-Zhāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Azh-Zhāhir (The Manifest) is the One above Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: 隐秘的
translations.short_meaning_val: 隐秘的：他是绝无仅有的。

english_name.name: Al-Bātin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Bātin (The Hidden) is the One beneath Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: 崇高的
translations.short_meaning_val: 崇高的：无论任何方面，都证明绝对的至高，即地位高、权利高、本体高。

english_name.name: Al-Muta‘āl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muta‘āl (The Exalted) is a name that denotes the absolute exaltation of Allah in all aspects: His essence, His status, and His power.

translations.name: 仁爱的
translations.short_meaning_val: 仁爱的：施恩的，给予仆人各种恩典的主。

english_name.name: Al-Barr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Barr (The Beneficent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of blessings upon His servants.

translations.name: 接受忏悔的
translations.short_meaning_val: 接受忏悔的：就是让仆人的忏悔顺利，并被接受。

english_name.name: At-Tawwāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tawwāb (The Accepting of Repentance) is the One Who guides His servants to repentance and accepts it from them.

translations.name: 宽恕的
translations.short_meaning_val: 宽恕的：消除恶行，原谅犯罪者的主。

english_name.name: Al-‘Afuww
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Afuww (The Pardoner) is the One Who erases misdeeds and pardons sins.

translations.name: 至爱的
translations.short_meaning_val: 至受的：对他的仆人非常的热爱和怜悯。

english_name.name: Ar-Ra’ūf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Ra’ūf (The All-Kind) is the One Who is the most kind and merciful towards His creation.

english_name.name: Maalik-Ul-Mulk
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE ETERNAL POSSESSOR OF SOVEREIGNTY

The One who controls the Dominion and gives dominion to whoever He willed.

translations.name: 具有伟大和慷慨的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 具有伟大和慷慨的主：具有崇高、伟大、仁慈和慷慨的主，他应受尊崇和赞颂。

english_name.name: Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām (Lord of Majesty and Bounty) is the Possessor of greatness, pride, mercy, and bounty, Who deserves glorification and praise.

translations.name: 无求的
translations.short_meaning_val: 无求的：除他以外的所有一切都需要他，他无求于任何一物。

english_name.name: A-Ghanyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿A-Ghanyy (The Self-Sufficient) is the One Who is needed by all and Who does not need anyone.

translations.name: 引领者
translations.short_meaning_val: 引领者：引导他的仆人至所有的福利，避免所有的伤害，使他所意欲者走向正道。

english_name.name: Al-Hādi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hādi (The Guide) is the One Who guides His servants to all beneficial things and leads them away from harmful ones, and Who leads whomever He wills to guidance.

translations.name: 继承者
translations.short_meaning_val: 继承者：真主就是在众生毁灭之后留下并继承大地及其一切的主。

english_name.name: Al-Wārith
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wārith (The Inheritor) is the One Who lasts after the doom of all creation and Who inherits the earth and all that is in it.

translations.name: 完美的
translations.short_meaning_val: 完美的：在本体、尊名、属性和行为中绝对完美的主。

english_name.name: Al-Jamīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jamīl (The Beautiful) is the One Who possesses absolute beauty in His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: 征服的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 征服的主：所有的被造物都屈服于真主，都在真主面前毕恭毕敬，并臣服于真主的能力和意欲。

english_name.name: Al-Qāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qāhir (The Vanquisher) is the One to Whom all beings submit and before Whose power and will all beings stand humbly.

translations.name: 临近的
translations.short_meaning_val: 临近的：他的赏赐临近顺从者，他的应答临近祈祷者，他的全知临近他的其他众仆，临近不否定清高伟大真主高的属性。

english_name.name: Al-Qarīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qarīb (The Near) is the One Who is near His obedient servants with reward; near those who supplicate Him with the answer; and near the rest of His servants with knowledge. This does not contradict His being high above.

translations.name: 养育的
translations.short_meaning_val: 养育的：真主是有益于他人的，掌握王权的主宰，以各种恩典养育他的所有仆人，并管理他们的主。

english_name.name: Ar-Rabb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rabb (The Lord) is the Master, the Owner, the Reformer, and the One Who fosters His servants by managing their affairs and bestowing favors upon them.

translations.name: 显著的
translations.short_meaning_val: 显著的：在真主的独一性方面是明确的，他没有任何匹敌，他给他的仆人阐释了真理。

english_name.name: Al-Mubīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mubīn (The Evident) is the One Who is evident in His Oneness and that He has no partner, and Who clarifies the truth to His servants.

translations.name: 给予的
translations.short_meaning_val: 给予的：他是真实意义的独自赐予，他要给予的没有谁可以阻止，他要阻止的没有谁可以给予。

english_name.name: Al-Mu‘ti
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu‘ti (The Giver) is the only One Who gives, and no one can withhold what He has given or give what He has withheld.

translations.name: 满足的
translations.short_meaning_val: 满足的：真主使他的仆人满足于他们所需求的，使仆人以他的援助而无求于其他的，只以真主而满足。

english_name.name: Al-Kāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kāfi (The All-Sufficient) is the One Who fulfills all the needs of His servants and Who is sufficient for them beyond need for anyone else.

translations.name: 单独的
translations.short_meaning_val: 单数的：真主是独一的，他没有任何匹敌和同类。

english_name.name: Al-Witr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Witr (The Odd) is the One Who has no partner or equal.

translations.name: 独一的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 独一的主：独自具有一切完美的养育性、受拜性，及尊名和属性，在这一切中没有任何匹敌。

english_name.name: Al-Ahad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ahad (The Only One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His lordship, divinity, names, and attributes, and none shares any of them with Him.

translations.name: 慷慨的
translations.short_meaning_val: 慷慨的：给予很多，他的给予涵盖万物。

english_name.name: Al-Jawād
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jawād (The Munificent) is the One Who gives abundantly to all creatures.

translations.name: 和蔼的
translations.short_meaning_val: 和蔼的：在事务中温和并循序渐进的主，不急于惩罚犯罪的主。

english_name.name: Ar-Rafīq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rafīq (The Kind) is the One Who acts deliberately and gradually, and does not hasten to punish sinners.

translations.name: 主人
translations.short_meaning_val: 主人：养育者，掌管者，事实上的最高权利所有者，人们在今后两世的事务都归于真主。

english_name.name: As-Sayyid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Sayyid (The Master) is the Lord and the Owner, the One Who possesses true dominance, and to Whom all creation turns for their worldly and their Hereafter affairs.

translations.name: 清静的
translations.short_meaning_val: 清静的：没有任何缺点和瑕疵的主，天地间的一切都赞他清净。

english_name.name: As-Subbūh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Subbūh (The All-Glorious) is the One far exalted above deficiencies and defects and Who is extolled and glorified by all those in the heavens and the earth.

translations.name: 治愈的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 治愈的主：使仆人从身体的疾病、心灵的模糊和欲望中得以痊愈。

english_name.name: Ash-Shāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shāfi (The Healer) is the One Who cures His servants from the illnesses of their bodies, the doubts of their hearts, and the vain desires of their selves.

translations.name: 感谢的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 感谢的主：对于顺从他者予以赞扬和夸奖，并赐予超出他的所行善功的回赐。

english_name.name: Ash-Shākir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shākir (The Appreciative) is the One Who praises those who obey Him and rewards them beyond what is due to them.

translations.name: 美好的
translations.short_meaning_val: ﻿美好的：意思就是崇高的真主神圣纯洁于一切缺点和瑕疵。

english_name.name: At-Tayyib
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tayyib (The Good) means that Allah Almighty is extolled and exalted far above all deficiencies and defects.

translations.name: 至高的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 至高的主：该名称证明各个方面真主之高的所有意义，即本体之高、地位之高、权利之高。

english_name.name: Al-A‘la
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-A‘la (The Most High) is a name that denotes the affirmation of all meanings of highness for Allah Almighty from every aspect: highness in His essence, highness in His status, and highness in His power.

translations.name: 全能的
translations.short_meaning_val: 全能的：他是具有完美能力的主，任何无能和松懈不能侵犯他。

english_name.name: Al-Qadīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qadīr (The Omnipotent) is the One Who possesses complete power and does not suffer any incapability or fatigue.

translations.name: 施恩者
translations.short_meaning_val: 施恩的：他是赋予恩典的主，在祈求以前就给予了许多恩典的主。

english_name.name: Al-Mannān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mannān (The Bestower of Favors) is the One Who bestows great favors and gives blessings to His servants before they ask for them.

translations.name: 周知的
translations.short_meaning_val: 周知的：证明真主高于一切的名称，他的知识、能力和权利包围一切。

english_name.name: Al-Muhīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhīt (The All-Encompassing) is a name that denotes the exaltedness of Allah above His creation and that He encompasses everything in terms of knowledge, power, and subjugation.

translations.name: 最慷慨的
translations.short_meaning_val: 最慷慨的：赋予许多福利和馈赠的主，掌握着所有好处的主，所有的好处都源自崇高的主。

english_name.name: Al-Akram
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Akram (The Most Generous) is the One Who gives generously, and all goodness lies in His hand and comes from Him.

translations.name: 主宰
translations.short_meaning_val: 主宰：他是聚合了所有完美属性和尊大的形容，他是受崇拜的，除了他以外没有应受崇拜的。

english_name.name: Al-Ilāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ilāh (The God) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection and majesty and Who alone is worthy of being worshiped.

translations.name: 援助的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 援助的主：援助他的信士仆人，协助他们取得胜利。

english_name.name: An-Nasīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿An-Nasīr (The Helper) is the One Who helps and supports His believing servants.

translations.name: 保护者
translations.short_meaning_val: 保护者：真主是所有被造者的保护者，意思就是，真主是他们的主宰，是他们的掌管者、造化者以及他们真正的应受崇拜者，是他的信士仆人的保护者，真主喜爱他们，使他们一切顺利，援助他们，给予他们各种利益，使他们在今后两世的福利中顺利。

english_name.name: Al-Mawla
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mawla (The Protector) of all creation is their Master, Owner, Creator, and True Deity worthy of worship; and Al-Mawla of the believing servants is the One Who loves them, guides and supports them, and leads them to their religious and worldly interests.

translations.name: 害羞的主
translations.short_meaning_val: 害羞的主：多害羞，这种害羞是符合伟大真主的，不与被造物的害羞相似，而是放弃与他完美的仁慈、慷慨、原谅和温和不相适宜的。

english_name.name: Al-Hayiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayiyy (The Modest) is the One Who is very modest. This description befits Allah Almighty and it is nothing like the modesty of people. Rather, it means abandoning what does not suit His vast mercy, perfect generosity, and great forgiveness and forbearance.

translations.name: 施恩的
translations.short_meaning_val: 施恩的：恩赐他的仆人表面和内在的各种各样恩典的主。

english_name.name: Al-Muhsin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhsin (The Superb Benevolent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of outward and inward favors upon His servants.

translations.name: আল্লাহ
translations.short_meaning_val: -আল্লাহ: আশা, ভয় ও ভালোবাসার বিবেচনায় তিনিই সত্যিকার উপাস্য ইলাহ। আল্লাহর সুন্দর নামসমূহের যাবতীয় অর্থের একত্রকারী এবং আল্লাহর সব সিফাতের অন্তর্ভুক্তকারী।

english_name.name: Allāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Allah is the deity worthy of being worshiped out of love, hope, and fear. This name encompasses all the meanings of the beautiful names and attributes of the Almighty Lord.

translations.name: আর-রহমান (পরম দয়ালু)
translations.short_meaning_val: ﻿আর-রহমান (পরম দয়ালু): মহান ও সুবিশাল রহমাতের মালিক, যা সবকিছুকে শামিল করে।

english_name.name: Ar-Rahmān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahmān (The Most Compassionate) is the One with great and immense mercy that encompasses everything.

translations.name: আর রাহীম (পরম দয়ালু)
translations.short_meaning_val: আর রাহীম (পরম দয়ালু): মহা রহমাতের অধিকারী, যা রহমকৃতদের সাথে সম্পৃক্ত।

english_name.name: Ar-Rahīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.

translations.name: আল-মালিক (বাদশাহ)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মালিক (বাদশাহ): যিনি মহত্ব, সর্বক্ষমতা ও নিয়স্ত্রকের গুণে গুনান্বিত। আর যিনি সবকিছুর মালিক, তাতে কোন প্রকার বাঁধা-বিঘ্ন ও প্রতিরোধ ছাড়া পরিচালনাকারী।

english_name.name: Al-Malik
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.

translations.name: আল-কুদ্দূস (মহা পবিত্র)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-কুদ্দূস (মহা পবিত্র): দুর্বলতা ও যাবতীয় অপূর্ণতার দোষ থেকে এবং কোন মাখলুক তার সদৃশ হওয়া থেকে তিনি মহা পবিত্র।

english_name.name: Al-Quddūs
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Quddūs (The Holy One) is the Glorified One Who is exalted far above any defect and far above resembling any of His creation.

translations.name: আস-সালাম (নিরাপত্তা-দানকারী, শান্তি-দানকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আস-সালাম (নিরাপত্তা-দানকারী, শান্তি-দানকারী): যিনি সর্ব প্রকার দুর্বলতা, দোষ ও ত্রুটি-বিচ্যুতি থেকে পবিত্র।

english_name.name: As-Salām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ As-Salām (The Source of Perfection) is the One free from any defect or fault.

translations.name: আল-মু‘মিন (নিরাপত্তা ও ঈমান দানকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মু‘মিন (নিরাপত্তা ও ঈমান দানকারী): সত্যায়নকারী, যিনি দলীল প্রমাণ ও অলৌকিকতা স্থাপন করা দ্বারা স্বীয় নবীগণকে বিশ্বাস করাতেন। আর যিনি তার সৃষ্টিকে স্বীয় ইনসাফের পরিপূর্ণতার কারণে নিরাপত্তা প্রদান করেন।

english_name.name: Al-Mu’min
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.

translations.name: আল-মুহাইমিন (পরিপূর্ণ রক্ষণাবেক্ষণকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মুহাইমিন (পরিপূর্ণ রক্ষণাবেক্ষণকারী): মাখলুকের তত্বাবধায়ক, তাদের নিয়ন্ত্রক এবং তাদের পরিচালক, যিনি প্রতিটি বস্তুকে তার ইলম দ্বারা পরিবেষ্টিত করে রেখেছেন।

english_name.name: Al-Muhaymin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhaymin (The All-Controller) is the Guardian over His creation, their Ruler, and the Disposer of all their affairs, Who encompasses everything in His knowledge.

translations.name: আল-আযীয (পরাক্রমশালী, অপরাজেয়)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-আযীয (পরাক্রমশালী, অপরাজেয়): যার জন্য রয়েছে পরিপূর্ণ সম্মান। যিনি নিজেকে ছাড়া বাকী সবকিছুকে তার শক্তি, ক্ষমতা ও অধিকার দিয়ে করায়ত্ব করে রেখেছেন।

english_name.name: Al-‘Azīz
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azīz (The All-Mighty) is the One Who possesses the absolute might and vanquishes all others with His power, dominance, and invincibility.

translations.name: আল-জাব্বার (প্রতাপশালী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-জাব্বার (প্রতাপশালী): স্বীয় মাখলুকের ওপর মহান, সবকিছুর ওপর ক্ষমতাধর সত্বা যার জন্য সবকিছু নমনীয় ও বিনয়াবলম্বনকারী। আর যে তার কাছে আশ্রয় চায় তাকে তিনি আশ্রয় দেন।

english_name.name: Al-Jabbār
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.

translations.name: আল-মুতাকাব্বির (নিরঙ্কুশ শ্রেষ্ঠত্বের অধিকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মুতাকাব্বির (নিরঙ্কুশ শ্রেষ্ঠত্বের অধিকারী): যিনি তার পূর্ণতা ও মহিমান্বিত হওয়ার কারণে অকল্যাণ, অপূর্ণতা, দুর্বলতা ও দোষত্রৃটির উর্ধ্বে।

english_name.name: Al-Mutakabbir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mutakabbir (The Supreme) is the One Who is far exalted above evil, deficiency, and defects, given His perfection and majesty.

translations.name: আল-খালিক (সৃষ্টিকর্তা)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-খালিক (সৃষ্টিকর্তা): পূর্বে কোন দৃষ্টান্ত ছাড়া সবকিছুর আবিষ্কারক ও অস্তিত্বদানকারী।

english_name.name: Al-Khāliq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khāliq (The Creator) is the One Who brings things into existence and invents them in an unprecedented way.

translations.name: আল-বারী (সঠিকভাবে সৃষ্টিকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-বারী (সঠিকভাবে সৃষ্টিকারী): সঠিকভাবে সৃষ্টিকারী: যিনি সমগ্র বস্তুকে সৃষ্টি করেছেন, আকৃতি দান করেছেন এবং অস্তিত্বহীনতা থেকে অস্তিত্ব দান করেছেন।

english_name.name: Al-Bāri’
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Bāri’ (The Initiator) is the Creator Who created the whole creation from nothing and gave them forms after they were non-existent.

translations.name: আল-মুসাওব্বির (আকৃতি-দানকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মুসাওব্বির (আকৃতি-দানকারী): যিনি তার মাখলুককে বিভিন্ন আকৃতি ও একাধিক অবস্থার ওপর সৃষ্টি করেছেন, যা তার ইলম ও প্রজ্ঞার পরিপূর্ণতার প্রমাণ বহন করে।

english_name.name: Al-Musawwir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Musawwir (The Supreme Fashioner) is the One Who fashioned His creation in different forms and appearances that indicate His perfect knowledge and wisdom.

english_name.name: Al-Ghaffaar
english_name.short_meaning_val:
AL-Ghaffaar (The Great Forgiver)

The Forgiver, The One who forgives the sins of His slaves time and time again

english_name.name: Al-Qahhār
english_name.short_meaning_val: THE ALL-PREVAILING ONE
english_name.meanings_val: <p><span style="font-size: 19px; color: #202122; font-weight: normal; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Arial'; font-style: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none;">The Dominant, The One who has the perfect Power and is not unable over anything.</span></p>

translations.name: আল-ওয়াহহাব (সবকিছু দানকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-ওয়াহহাব (সবকিছু দানকারী): তিনি অনুদানে ও দানে ব্যাপক। যার অনুদান ও দান সমগ্র জগতকে শামিল করে।

english_name.name: Al-Wahhāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wahhāb (The Bestower) is the One Who gives abundantly, and Whose generosity and bounty encompass all beings.

translations.name: আর-রাযযাক (রিযিকদাতা)
translations.short_meaning_val: ﻿আর-রাযযাক (রিযিকদাতা): বান্দাদের রিযিকের জিম্মা গ্রহণকারী যার দ্বারা তাদের দেহ ও মনের বেঁচে থাকা।

english_name.name: Ar-Razzāq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Razzāq (The All-Provider) is the One Who guarantees His servants the sustenance that maintains their hearts and bodies.

translations.name: আল-ফাত্তাহ (বিজয়দানকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-ফাত্তাহ (বিজয়দানকারী): যিনি তার বান্দাদের মাঝে শরীআতের বিধানসমূহ দ্বারা ফায়সালা করেন। আর তিনি তাদের মাঝে তার কাদরী বিধান দ্বারা ফায়সালা করেন এবং প্রতিদান মুলক বিধানসমূহ দ্বারা তাদের হিসাব গ্রহণ করেন।

english_name.name: Al-Fattāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Fattāh (The Greatest Judge) is the One Who judges between His servants by His religious rulings, decrees His predestination for them, and calls them to account.

translations.name: আল-আলীম (সর্বজ্ঞ)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-আলীম (সর্বজ্ঞ): অর্থাৎ তার ইলম সবকিছুকে পরিবেষ্টনকারী।

english_name.name: Al-‘Alīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alīm (The All-Knowing) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses everything.

english_name.name: Al-Qaabid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE RESTRICTING ONE

The Constrictor, The Withholder, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Baasit
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE EXTENDER

The Englarger, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Khaafid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE REDUCER

The One who lowers whoever He willed by His Destruction and raises whoever He willed by His Endowment.

translations.name: আর-রাফি` (মর্যাদা দানকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আর-রাফি` (মর্যাদা দানকারী): তিনি যাকে চান, যেভাবে চান মর্যদা দান করেন। যেমন, তিনি তার ওলীগণকে দুনিয়া ও আখিরাতে মর্যাদা দান করেন।

english_name.name: Ar-Rāfi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Rāfi‘ (The Raiser) is the One Who raises whomever He wills the way He wills, as He elevates the ranks of His pious servants in this world and in the Hereafter.

translations.name: আস-সামীউ (সর্বশ্রোতা)
translations.short_meaning_val: আস-সামীউ (সর্বশ্রোতা): যিনি শ্রবণযোগ্য সবকিছু সম্পর্কে অবগত। ফলে তিনি গোপন ও কানে কানে বলা কথাগুলো শোনেন। তার কাছে জোরে বলা ও আস্তে বলা এবং মুখে বলা ও চুপ থাকা সবই সমান।

english_name.name: As-Samī‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samī‘ (The All-Hearing) is the One Who hears everything. He hears secret and private talk. Loud and low voices, and speaking and silence are all the same to Him - He grasps all.

translations.name: আল-বাসীর (সর্ববিষয়-দর্শনকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-বাসীর (সর্ববিষয়-দর্শনকারী): যিনি তার দৃষ্টি শক্তি দিয়ে সবকিছুকে পরিবেষ্টিত করে রেখেছেন যদিও সুক্ষ্ম ও ক্ষুদ্র হোক। সবকিছুর প্রতি দ্রষ্টা, অবগত ও তার বাতেনী বিষয় সম্পর্কে সম্যক অবগত।

english_name.name: Al-Basīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Basīr (The All-Seeing) is the One Whose sight encompasses everything, no matter how small or minute they may be, and He is the One Who is All-Aware of everything and All-Knowing of their hidden aspects.

translations.name: আল-হাকাম (বিচার-ফায়সালাকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-হাকাম (বিচার-ফায়সালাকারী): সবকিছু ফায়সালা তার কাছেই। তিনি যা চান তা ফায়সালা করেন। তিনি তার বান্দাদের মাঝে ন্যায় ও হকের সাথে ফায়সালা করেন।

english_name.name: Al-Hakam
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakam (The Judge) is the One to Whom belongs judgment in all things, and Who ordains what He wills and judges between His servants with the truth and justice.

translations.name: আল-লাতীফ (সকল-গোপন-বিষয়ে-অবগত)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-লাতীফ (সকল-গোপন-বিষয়ে-অবগত): যার কাছে কোন বস্তুই গোপন নয় তা যতই সুক্ষ্ম হোক। স্বীয় বান্দাদের প্রতি কল্যাকর যিনি তাদের প্রতি অনুগ্রহ করেন এবং তাদের এমন সব কর্মের তাওফীক দেন যাতে রয়েছে তাদের সংশোধন।

english_name.name: Al-Latīf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Latīf (The All-Subtle) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, no matter how small it may be, and the One Who shows kindness and leniency to His servants and guides them to what is good for them.

translations.name: আল-খাবীর (সর্ব ব্যাপারে জ্ঞাত)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-খাবীর (সর্ব ব্যাপারে জ্ঞাত): যার ইলম সবকিছুর অভ্যন্তরীণ ও গোপনীয় বিষয় সম্পর্কে জ্ঞাত যেমন বাহ্যিক বিষয় সম্পর্কে জ্ঞাত।

english_name.name: Al-Khabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khabīr (The All-Aware) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses the inward and hidden aspects of things, as well as their outward aspects.

translations.name: আল-হালীম (অত্যন্ত ধৈর্যশীল)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-হালীম (অত্যন্ত ধৈর্যশীল): ধৈর্যশীল যিনি তার বান্দাদের ওপর তাদের গুনাহের কারণে শাস্তি প্রদানের তাড়াহুড়া করেন না।

english_name.name: Al-Halīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Halīm (The Forbearing) is the One Who possesses deliberation and does not hasten to punish His servants for their sins.

translations.name: আল-আযীম (মহা-মর্যাদাশীল)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-আযীম (মহা-মর্যাদাশীল): পূর্ণতা, সম্মান, বড়ত্ব ও মহত্বের সব গুণের একত্রকারী যাকে অন্তরসমূহ ভালোবাসে এবং আত্মাসমূহ তাযীম করে।

english_name.name: Al-‘Azhīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azhīm (The Magnificent) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection, glory, pride, and majesty, and Who is loved and extolled by His servants.

translations.name: আল-গফূর (পরম ক্ষমাশীল)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-গফূর (পরম ক্ষমাশীল): যিনি তার বান্দাকে তাদের গুনাহের অনিষ্টতা থেকে বাঁচান এবং তার কারণে তাদের শাস্তি দেন না।

english_name.name: Al-Ghafūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ghafūr (The All-Forgiving) is the One Who spares His servants the evil of their sins and does not punish them.

translations.name: আশ-শাকূর (কৃতজ্ঞতা প্রকাশকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আশ-শাকূর (কৃতজ্ঞতা প্রকাশকারী): যিনি অল্প আমলের সাওয়াব অধিক ও বহুগুন সাওয়াব প্রধান করে অনুগ্রহ করেন এবং অগণিত ভুলত্রুটিকে ক্ষমা করেন।

english_name.name: Ash-Shakūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shakūr (The Most Appreciative) is the One Who appreciates even little deeds and gives immense and multiple rewards in return, and Who forgives numerous errors.

translations.name: আল-আলীউ (উচ্চ-মর্যাদাশীল)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-আলীউ (উচ্চ-মর্যাদাশীল): যার জন্য রয়েছে সর্বদিক থেকে উচ্চ মর্যদা। সর্বোচ্চ মর্যাদাবান, ক্ষমতার উচ্চতা ও সত্বার উচ্চতা।

english_name.name: Al-‘Alyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alyy (The High) is the One Who possesses absolute highness in all aspects: His status, His power, and His essence.

translations.name: আল-কাবীর (সুমহান)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-কাবীর (সুমহান): এমন মহা সত্ত্বা যার অধীনে সবকিছু, কোন কিছুই তার চেয়ে বড় নয়।

english_name.name: Al-Kabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kabīr (The Great) is the One Who is greater than everything, and all else are inferior to Him.

translations.name: আল-হাফীয (সংরক্ষণকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-হাফীয (সংরক্ষণকারী): যিনি যা সৃষ্টি করেছেন তার হিফাযত করেছেন এবং তার ইলম তিনি যা আবিষ্কার করেছেন তা সংরক্ষণ করেছে। আর তিনি তার ওলীদের গুনাহ ও ধ্বংসে নিপতিত হওয়া থেকে হিফাযত করেছেন এবং তার বান্দাদের আমলসমূহ ও তার বিনিময় ও প্রতিদান রক্ষা করেছেন।

english_name.name: Al-Hafīzh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hafīzh (The All-Preserver) is the One Who preserves what He created; Whose knowledge encompasses all that He brought into existence; Who protects His pious servants from committing sins and ruinous acts; and Who records their deeds and the recompense for them.

translations.name: আল-মুকীত (আহার দানকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মুকীত (আহার দানকারী): যিনি তার ইলম অনুযায়ী মাখলুকের আহার নির্ধারণ করেন তারপর তা তিনি তাদের নিকট স্বীয় কুদরাত দ্বারা পৌছে দেন এবং তাদের মাঝে বন্টন করেন।

english_name.name: Al-Muqīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqīt (The All-Nourisher) is the One Who determines the sustenance of His creation according to His knowledge, brings it to them with His power, and distributes it amongst them.

translations.name: আল-হাসীব (হিসাব-গ্রহণকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-হাসীব (হিসাব গ্রহণকারী): তার মুমিন বান্দাদের থেকে যার তার ওপর ভরসাকারী তাদের জন্য যথেষ্ট। তার বান্দাদের কর্মসমূহ সম্পর্কে সর্বজ্ঞ। তার ওপর তাদের হিসাব রক্ষক।

english_name.name: Al-Hasīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hasīb (The Ever-Reckoner) is the One Who grants sufficiency to His believing servants who rely upon Him, and Who knows their deeds and holds them accountable for them.

translations.name: আল-কারীম (সুমহান দাতা)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-কারীম (সুমহান দাতা): তিনি অসংখ্য কল্যাণের মালিক এবং মহা উপকারী।

english_name.name: Al-Karīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Karīm (The Generous) is the One Who gives abundant good and welfare.

translations.name: আর-রাকীব (তত্ত্বাবধায়ক)
translations.short_meaning_val: আর-রাকীব (তত্ত্বাবধায়ক): সবকিছুর ওপর অবগত। গোপনীয় বিষয় ও অন্তরের বিষয়গুলো সম্পর্কে সাক্ষী। যিনি জানেন ও দেখেন। তার কাঝে কোন বেধ ও রহস্য লুকায়িত নয়।

english_name.name: Ar-Raqīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Raqīb (The Ever-Watchful) is the One Who watches over everything and witnesses inner thoughts and secrets, and Who knows and sees all things and no secret or private talk is hidden from Him.

translations.name: আল-মুজিব (সাড়াদানকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মুজিব (সাড়াদানকারী): যিনি যারা চায় তাদের চাওয়াকে পুরণ করেন এবং যারা তাকে ডাকে তাদের ডাকে সাড়া দেন।

english_name.name: Al-Mujīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mujīb (The All-Responsive) is the One Who responds to supplications by answering them and to requests by fulfilling them.

translations.name: আল-ওয়াসি` (সর্ব-ব্যাপী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-ওয়াসি` (সর্ব-ব্যাপী): যার জন্য রয়েছে পরিপূণ অর্থের গুণাবলী এবং পূর্ণাঙ্গ মর্যাদা।

english_name.name: Al-Wāsi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāsi‘ (The All-Embracing) is the One to Whom belongs the most perfect and complete meaning of every attribute.

translations.name: আল-হাকীম (পরম-প্রজ্ঞাময়)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-হাকীম (পরম-প্রজ্ঞাময়): যিনি তার আদেশ ও বিধানসমূহে পরিপূর্ণ হিকমাতের গুণে গুণান্বিত এবং স্বীয় মাখলুকের মাঝে ফায়সালা দানে পরিপূর্ণ।

english_name.name: Al-Hakīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakīm (The All-Wise) is the One Who possesses perfect wisdom in His commands and legislations, and perfect judgment between His creation.

translations.name: আল-ওয়াদূদ (বান্দাদের প্রতি ভালোবাসা পোষণকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-ওয়াদূদ (বান্দাদের প্রতি ভালোবাসা পোষণকারী): প্রিয়দের পছন্দকারী। সুতরাং তিনি তার নবীগণ, রাসূলগণ এবং তাদের অনুসারীদের ভালোবাসেন এবং তারা তাকে ভালোবাসে।

english_name.name: Al-Wadūd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wadūd (The Most Affectionate) is the One Who loves and is loved. He loves His prophets and messengers and their followers, and they love Him.

translations.name: আল-মাজীদ (সকল মর্যাদার অধিকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মাজীদ (সকল মর্যাদার অধিকারী): পরিপূর্ণতা সিফাতসমূহ হতে যিনি একাধিক সু-বিশাল মহৎ গুণসমূহের সাথে গুণান্বিত।

english_name.name: Al-Majīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Majīd (The Most Glorious) is the One Who possesses the various attributes of supreme majesty and perfection.

translations.name: আশ-শাহীদ (সর্বজ্ঞ-স্বাক্ষী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আশ-শাহীদ (সর্বজ্ঞ-স্বাক্ষী): যার থেকে কোন কিছুই অনুপস্থিত হয় না। বরং তিনি সবকিছু সম্পর্কে অবগত, সবকিছুর প্রত্যক্ষ্যদর্শী। সবকিছুর ব্যাখ্যা সম্পর্কে তিনি সর্বজ্ঞ।

english_name.name: Ash-Shahīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shahīd (The Ever-Witness) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, rather He knows and witnesses everything and is Aware of its details.

translations.name: আল-হাক্ক (পরম সত্য)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-হাক্ক (পরম সত্য): যার হওয়া ও অস্তিত্ব সাব্যস্ত। আর তাঁর নামসমূহ, সিফাতসমূহ, কর্মসমূহ, বিধানসমূহ এবং তার প্রতিদানসমূহ সবই পরিপূর্ণ ও সত্য। তাতে কোন বাতিল কিছু নাই।

english_name.name: Al-Haqq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Haqq (The Truth) is the True One in terms of His being and His existence; and the One Whose names, attributes, actions, judgments, and recompense are all perfect and true.

translations.name: আল-ওয়াকীল (পরম নির্ভরযোগ্য কর্ম-সম্পাদনকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-ওয়াকীল (পরম নির্ভরযোগ্য কর্ম-সম্পাদনকারী): স্বীয় মাখলুকের রিযিক সম্পাদনের দায়িত্বশীল। তাদের যাবতীয় কল্যাণের তত্ববধায়ক। আর যিনি তার ওলীদের অভিভাবক। ফলে সহজ কর্মকে তাদের জন্য সহজ করে দেন এবং কঠিন থেকে তাদের দূরে সরান। আর তাদের যাবতীয় বিষয়ের জন্য তিনিই যথেষ্ট।

english_name.name: Al-Wakīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wakīl (The Trustee) is the One Who guarantees the sustenance of His creation and manages their affairs and maintains their welfare; and Who supports His pious servants and, thus, guides them to ease, grants them sufficiency, and keeps them away from difficulty.

translations.name: আল-ক্বাবিউ (পরম-শক্তির-অধিকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-ক্বাবিউ (পরম-শক্তির-অধিকারী): পরিপূর্ণ শক্তি কোন বিজয়ী তাকে পরাহত করতে পারে না এবং কোন বাধাদানকারী তার ফায়সালাকে বাধাগ্রস্থ করতে পারে না।

english_name.name: Al-Qawiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qawiyy (The All-Powerful) is the One with complete power Who cannot be overcome and Whose predestination cannot be repelled.

translations.name: আল-মাতীন (সুদৃঢ়, মজবুত)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মাতীন (সুদৃঢ়, মজবুত): শক্তি ও ক্ষমতায় সীমাহীন কঠোর। ফলে তার সাথে কোন দুর্বলতা ও কষ্ট সম্পৃক্ত হয় না।

english_name.name: Al-Matīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Matīn (The Most Firm) is the One Who possesses infinite power and ability so He never experiences any weakness or hardship.

translations.name: আল-ওয়ালী (অভিভাবক ও সাহায্যকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-ওয়ালী (অভিভাবক ও সাহায্যকারী): মুমিন বান্দাদের সাহায্যকারী। আর সব মাখলুকের যাবতীয় কর্মের তত্বাবধানকারী।

english_name.name: Al-Walyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Walyy (The Guardian) is the One Who supports His believing servants and manages the affairs of all His creation.

translations.name: আল-হামীদ (সকল প্রশংসার অধিকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-হামীদ (সকল প্রশংসার অধিকারী): এটি এমন একটি নাম যেটি যাবতীয় সব ধরনের প্রশংসা ও পূর্ণতা আল্লাহর জন্য হওয়ার প্রমান বহন করে। স্বীয় সত্বা, নাম, সিফাত ও কর্মসমূহে তার পূর্ণতার কারণে তিনিই যাবতীয় প্রশংসার উপযুক্ত।

english_name.name: Al-Hamīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hamīd (The Praiseworthy) is a name that denotes all the praiseworthy and perfect attributes of Allah Almighty, Who deserves praise for the perfection of His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: আল-হাইয়ু (চিরঞ্জীব)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-হাইয়ু (চিরঞ্জীব): যার জন্য রয়েছে পূর্ণাঙ্গ জীবনের সব দিক, যার ওপর অস্তিত্বহীনতা অতিবাহিত হয়নি এবং যার সাথে কখনো নিঃশেষ হওয়া যোগ হবে না।

english_name.name: Al-Hayy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayy (The Ever-Living) is the One to Whom belong all meanings of perfect life that is not preceded by nothingness nor followed by doom.

translations.name: আল-কাইয়ূম (সমস্ত কিছুর ধারক ও সংরক্ষণকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-কাইয়ূম (সমস্ত কিছুর ধারক ও সংরক্ষণকারী): যিনি নিজেই প্রতিষ্ঠিত। ফলে কারো প্রতি তিনি মুখাপেক্ষী হননি। প্রতি বস্তু তার দ্বারাই প্রতিষ্ঠা লাভ করে কোন কিছুই তার থেকে অমুখাপেকী নয়।

english_name.name: Al-Qayyūm
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Qayyūm (The Self-Subsisting) is the One Who is self-sustaining, so He does not need anyone, and everything depends on Him and none can dispense with Him.

translations.name: আল-ওয়াহিদ (এক ও একক)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-ওয়াহিদ (এক ও একক): স্বীয় সত্বা, সিফাত ও কর্মসমূহে যাবতীয় পূর্ণতার একক অধিকারী। এ সবের কোন কিছুতেই তার কোন শরীক নাই।

english_name.name: Al-Wāhid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāhid (The One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His essence, attributes, and actions, and none shares any of this with Him.

translations.name: আস-সামাদ (অমুখাপেক্ষী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আস-সামাদ (অমুখাপেক্ষী): পরিপূর্ণ রব, মহান সরদার। আগ্রহ ও ভয়ের সাথে যাবতীয় সব প্রয়োজনের তিনি উদ্দেশ্য।

english_name.name: As-Samad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samad (The Eternal Refuge) is the Perfect Lord and the Magnificent Master to Whom everyone turns, out of hope and fear.

translations.name: আল-কাদির (সর্বশক্তিমান)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-কাদির (সর্বশক্তিমান): যার রয়েছে পরিপূর্ণ, ব্যাপক ও পূর্ণাঙ্গ ক্ষমতা যাকে কোন কিছু অক্ষম করতে পারে না এবং তার কোন উদ্দেশ্য ছুটে যায় না।

english_name.name: Al-Qādir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qādir (The Able) is the One Who possesses complete and comprehensive power, nothing can challenge Him, and none can escape His power or will.

translations.name: আল-মুকতাদির (নিরঙ্কুশ-সিদ্ধান্তের-অধিকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মুকতাদির (নিরঙ্কুশ-সিদ্ধান্তের-অধিকারী): যার জন্য রয়েছে পরিপূর্ণ ক্ষমতা যার ওপর কোন কিছুই বাধা হতে পারে না।

english_name.name: Al-Muqtadir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqtadir (The Dominant) is the One Who possesses complete unopposed power.

english_name.name: Al-Muqaddim
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqaddim (The Advancer) is the One Who puts things in their due places, advancing what He wills and delaying what He wills.

translations.name: আল-মুআখিখির (অবকাশ দানকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মুআখিখির (অবকাশ দানকারী): যিনি যে সব বস্তু সুযোগ লাভের উপযুক্ত তিনি তাদরে সুযোগ দান করেন। ফলে তিনি তা যথোপযুক্ত স্থানে রাখেন।

english_name.name: Al-Mu’akhkhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu’akhkhir (The Delayer) is the One Who delays things that should be delayed, thus putting them in their proper place.

translations.name: আল-আউয়াল (প্রথম আদি)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-আউয়াল (প্রথম আদি): সর্ব প্রথম যার পূর্বে আর কোন কিছু নাই।

english_name.name: Al-Awwal
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Awwal (The First) is the One before Whom there was nothing.

translations.name: আল-আখির (অনন্ত, সর্বশেষ)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-আখির (অনন্ত, সর্বশেষ): সর্বশেষ যার পরে আর কোন কিছু নাই।

english_name.name: Al-Ākhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ākhir (The Last) is the One after Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: আয-যাহির (সম্পূর্নরূপে-প্রকাশিত)
translations.short_meaning_val: আয-যাহির (সম্পূর্নরূপে-প্রকাশিত): তিনি সে সত্বা যার ওপর কোন কিছু নাই।

english_name.name: Azh-Zhāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Azh-Zhāhir (The Manifest) is the One above Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: আল-বাতিন (দৃষ্টি হতে অদৃশ্য)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-বাতিন (দৃষ্টি হতে অদৃশ্য): এমন সত্বা তারপর আর কোন কিছু নাই।

english_name.name: Al-Bātin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Bātin (The Hidden) is the One beneath Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: আল-মুতাআল (সৃষ্টির গুণাবলীর উর্ধ্বে)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মুতাআল (সৃষ্টির গুণাবলীর উর্ধ্বে): এমন একটি নাম যেটি সর্বদিক থেকে আল্লাহর উচ্চ মর্যদার বিষয়টি প্রমান করে। কাদরের উচ্চতা, ক্ষমতা উচ্চতা ও সত্বার উচ্চা।

english_name.name: Al-Muta‘āl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muta‘āl (The Exalted) is a name that denotes the absolute exaltation of Allah in all aspects: His essence, His status, and His power.

translations.name: আল-বার (পরম-উপকারী, অনুগ্রহশীল)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-বার (পরম-উপকারী, অনুগ্রহশীল): যিনি বান্দাগণের ওপর বিভিন্ন ধরনের নিয়ামত দান করেছেন।

english_name.name: Al-Barr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Barr (The Beneficent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of blessings upon His servants.

translations.name: আত-তাওয়াব (তাওবার তাওফিক দানকারী এবং কবুলকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আত-তাওয়াব (তাওবার তাওফিক দানকারী এবং কবুলকারী): যিনি বান্দাকে তাওবার তাওফীক দান করেন এবং তার তাওবা কবুল করেন।

english_name.name: At-Tawwāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tawwāb (The Accepting of Repentance) is the One Who guides His servants to repentance and accepts it from them.

translations.name: আল-আফউউ (পরম-উদার)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-আফউউ (পরম-উদার): যিনি অপরাধসমূহকে মিটিয়ে দেন এবং গুনাহগুলোকে এড়িয়ে যান।

english_name.name: Al-‘Afuww
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Afuww (The Pardoner) is the One Who erases misdeeds and pardons sins.

translations.name: আর-রঊফ (পরম-স্নেহশীল)
translations.short_meaning_val: আর-রঊফ (পরম-স্নেহশীল): বান্দাদের প্রতি পরম-স্নেহশীল ও দয়ালু।

english_name.name: Ar-Ra’ūf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Ra’ūf (The All-Kind) is the One Who is the most kind and merciful towards His creation.

english_name.name: Maalik-Ul-Mulk
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE ETERNAL POSSESSOR OF SOVEREIGNTY

The One who controls the Dominion and gives dominion to whoever He willed.

translations.name: যুল-জালালি ওয়াল ইকরাম (মহিমান্বিত ও দয়াবান সত্ত্বা)
translations.short_meaning_val: যুল-জালালি ওয়াল ইকরাম (মহিমান্বিত ও দয়াবান সত্ত্বা): মহত্ব, বড়ত্ব, রহমত ও দয়ার অধিকারী। প্রশংসা ও তাযীমের তিনিই হকদার।

english_name.name: Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām (Lord of Majesty and Bounty) is the Possessor of greatness, pride, mercy, and bounty, Who deserves glorification and praise.

translations.name: আল-গানী (অমুখাপেক্ষী, ধনী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-গানী (অমুখাপেক্ষী, ধনী): তিনি ছাড়া সবকিছুই তার প্রতি মুখাপেক্ষি, আর তিনি কারো প্রতি মুখাপেক্ষি নন।

english_name.name: A-Ghanyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿A-Ghanyy (The Self-Sufficient) is the One Who is needed by all and Who does not need anyone.

translations.name: আল-হাদী (পথ-প্রদর্শক)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-হাদী (পথ-প্রদর্শক): যিনি তার বান্দাদের যাবতীয় সব ধরনের সুবিধা লাভ এবং ক্ষতি প্রতিহত করার প্রতি নির্দেশনা দেন এবং তাদের থেকে যাকে চান তাকে হিদায়াতের তাওফীক দেন।

english_name.name: Al-Hādi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hādi (The Guide) is the One Who guides His servants to all beneficial things and leads them away from harmful ones, and Who leads whomever He wills to guidance.

translations.name: আল-ওয়ারিস (উত্তরাধিকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-ওয়ারিস (উত্তরাধিকারী): সমস্ত মাখলুক নিঃশেষ হওয়ার পর তিনিই কেবল বাকী থাকবেন, তিনিই হবেন যমীন ও তার ওপর যা কিছু আছে তার উত্তরসূরী।

english_name.name: Al-Wārith
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wārith (The Inheritor) is the One Who lasts after the doom of all creation and Who inherits the earth and all that is in it.

translations.name: আল-জামিল (পরম সুন্দর)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-জামিল (পরম সুন্দর): যার জন্য রয়েছে সত্বা, সিফাত, নামসমূহে ও কর্মসমূহে সবধরনের সৌন্দর্য্য।

english_name.name: Al-Jamīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jamīl (The Beautiful) is the One Who possesses absolute beauty in His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: আল-কাহির (ক্ষমতাবান)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-কাহির (ক্ষমতাবান): সমগ্র জগত যার জন্য মাথাবনত এবং সমস্ত মাখলুক যার জন্য নমনীয়। আর সবকিছু তার কুদরত ও ইচ্ছার কাছে দায়বদ্ধ।

english_name.name: Al-Qāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qāhir (The Vanquisher) is the One to Whom all beings submit and before Whose power and will all beings stand humbly.

translations.name: আল-কারীব (অতি নিকটে)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-কারীব (অতি নিকটে): অনুগ্রহের সাথে তার অনুসারীদের অতি নিকটে, যে ডাকে তার সাড়া দানে অনেক নিকটে। আর ইলমের সাথে তার সব বান্দাদের অতি নিকটে। এটি তার উপরে থাকার কোন পরিপন্থী নয়।

english_name.name: Al-Qarīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qarīb (The Near) is the One Who is near His obedient servants with reward; near those who supplicate Him with the answer; and near the rest of His servants with knowledge. This does not contradict His being high above.

translations.name: আর-রাব্ব (রব, মালিক)
translations.short_meaning_val: আর-রাব্ব (রব, মালিক): তিনি সরদার, বাদশাহ, অপরের কল্যাণকারী এবং বিভিন্ন ধরনের নিয়ামতসমূহ ও কৌশল দ্বারা সব বান্দাদের লালন পালনকারী।

english_name.name: Ar-Rabb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rabb (The Lord) is the Master, the Owner, the Reformer, and the One Who fosters His servants by managing their affairs and bestowing favors upon them.

translations.name: আল-মুবীন (স্পষ্টকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মুবীন (স্পষ্টকারী): একত্ববাদের ক্ষেত্রে তার বিষয়টি স্পষ্ট। তার কোন শরীক নাই। যিনি তার বান্দাদের জন্য হককে স্পষ্ট করেন।

english_name.name: Al-Mubīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mubīn (The Evident) is the One Who is evident in His Oneness and that He has no partner, and Who clarifies the truth to His servants.

translations.name: আল-মু‘তী (অনুদানকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মু‘তী (অনুদানকারী): প্রকৃত পক্ষে অনুদানের সাথে তিনি একক। যাকে দান করে তার কোন বাধা দানকারী নাই এবং যাকে না করেন তাকে দানকারী কেউ নেই।

english_name.name: Al-Mu‘ti
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu‘ti (The Giver) is the only One Who gives, and no one can withhold what He has given or give what He has withheld.

translations.name: আল-কাফী (যথেষ্ট)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-কাফী (যথেষ্ট): তার বান্দাগণ যে সবের প্রতি মুখাপেক্ষি তার সবকিছুর জন্য তিনিই যথেষ্ট। অন্যদের বাদ দিয়ে তার সাহায্যকে যথেষ্ট বলে মানা যায় এবং তার দ্বারাই তিনি ছাড়া অন্য কারো থেকে মুখ ফিরানো যায়।

english_name.name: Al-Kāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kāfi (The All-Sufficient) is the One Who fulfills all the needs of His servants and Who is sufficient for them beyond need for anyone else.

translations.name: আল-বিতর (বে-জোড়)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-বিতর (বে-জোড়): তিনি একক যার কোন শরীক নাই এবং কোন দৃষ্টান্ত নাই।

english_name.name: Al-Witr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Witr (The Odd) is the One Who has no partner or equal.

translations.name: আল-আহাদ (এক ও অদ্বিতীয়)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-আহাদ (এক ও অদ্বিতীয়): এক ও অদ্বিতীয়: রবুবিয়্যাত, উলুহিয়্যাত, নাম ও সিফাতসমূহে সব ধরণের পূর্ণঙ্গতায় তিনি একক তাতে কেউ শরীক নাই।

english_name.name: Al-Ahad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ahad (The Only One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His lordship, divinity, names, and attributes, and none shares any of them with Him.

translations.name: আল-জাওয়াদ (মহান দাতা)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-জাওয়াদ (মহান দাতা): অধিক অনুদানকারী যিনি তার অনুদান দ্বারা সমগ্র জগৎকে শামিল করেন।

english_name.name: Al-Jawād
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jawād (The Munificent) is the One Who gives abundantly to all creatures.

translations.name: আর-রফীক (নমনীয়তা প্রদর্শনকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আর-রফীক (নমনীয়তা প্রদর্শনকারী): যাবতীয় কমে ধীরস্থিরতা অবলম্বনকারী। আস্তে আস্তে অগ্রসরমান। অপরাধীদের শাস্তি দানে তাড়াহুড়া করেন না।

english_name.name: Ar-Rafīq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rafīq (The Kind) is the One Who acts deliberately and gradually, and does not hasten to punish sinners.

translations.name: আস-সায়্যিদ (সরদার, নেতা)
translations.short_meaning_val: আস-সায়্যিদ (সরদার, নেতা): রব, মালিক। প্রকৃত নেতৃত্বের অধিকারী। দুনিয়া ও আখিরাতের যাবতীয় বিষয়ে মাখলুক তার দিকেই ফিরে যায়।

english_name.name: As-Sayyid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Sayyid (The Master) is the Lord and the Owner, the One Who possesses true dominance, and to Whom all creation turns for their worldly and their Hereafter affairs.

translations.name: আস-সুব্বূহ (পুত-পবিত্র)
translations.short_meaning_val: আস-সুব্বূহ (পুত-পবিত্র): যিনি সব ধরনের দোষ-ত্রুটি ও দুর্বলতা থেকে পবিত্র। আসমান ও যমীনে যা কিছু আছে সবকিছুই তার পবিত্রতা বর্ণনা করে।

english_name.name: As-Subbūh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Subbūh (The All-Glorious) is the One far exalted above deficiencies and defects and Who is extolled and glorified by all those in the heavens and the earth.

translations.name: আশ-শাফী (শিফাদানকারী, আরোগ্যদানকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আশ-শাফী (শিফাদানকারী, আরোগ্যদানকারী): যিনি বান্দাদের দৈহিক ব্যাধিসমূহ, অন্তরসমূহের সংশয় এবং প্রবৃত্তির চাহিদাসমূহ থেকে মুক্তিদান করেন ও নিরাপত্তা প্রদান করেন।

english_name.name: Ash-Shāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shāfi (The Healer) is the One Who cures His servants from the illnesses of their bodies, the doubts of their hearts, and the vain desires of their selves.

translations.name: আশ-শাকির (গুণগানকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আশ-শাকির (গুণগানকারী): যিনি তার আনুগত্য করে তার প্রসংশাকারী, গুণগ্রাহী। তার আনুগত্যের ওপর উপযুক্ত পাওনার চেয়েও অধিক সাওয়াব দানকারী।

english_name.name: Ash-Shākir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shākir (The Appreciative) is the One Who praises those who obey Him and rewards them beyond what is due to them.

translations.name: আত-তায়্যিব (পবিত্র)
translations.short_meaning_val: আত-তায়্যিব (পবিত্র): আল্লাহ তা‘আলা সব ধরনের দোষ-ত্রুটি ও দুর্বলতা থেকে পবিত্র।

english_name.name: At-Tayyib
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tayyib (The Good) means that Allah Almighty is extolled and exalted far above all deficiencies and defects.

translations.name: আল-আলা (সু-উচ্চ ও মহান)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-আলা (সু-উচ্চ ও মহান): এমন একটি নাম যেটি সবদিক দিয়ে আল্লাহর জন্য যাবতীয় উচ্চতা সাব্যস্ত হওয়ার ওপর প্রমাণ বহন করে।

english_name.name: Al-A‘la
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-A‘la (The Most High) is a name that denotes the affirmation of all meanings of highness for Allah Almighty from every aspect: highness in His essence, highness in His status, and highness in His power.

translations.name: আল-কাদীর (সর্ব শক্তিমান)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-কাদীর (সর্ব শক্তিমান): যিনি পরিপূর্ণ ক্ষমতার অধিকারী যার ক্ষমতায় কখনো অক্ষমতা ও কোন দূর্বলতা আসে না।

english_name.name: Al-Qadīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qadīr (The Omnipotent) is the One Who possesses complete power and does not suffer any incapability or fatigue.

translations.name: আল-মান্নান (মহা অনুদানকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মান্নান (মহা অনুদানকারী): যিনি নিয়ামত দাতা, অনুদানকারী। মহান দাতা, যিনি চাওয়া আগেই নিয়ামত দ্বারা অনুগ্রহ করে থাকেন।

english_name.name: Al-Mannān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mannān (The Bestower of Favors) is the One Who bestows great favors and gives blessings to His servants before they ask for them.

translations.name: আল-মুহীত (পরিবেষ্টনকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মুহীত (পরিবেষ্টনকারী): এমন একটি নাম যা মাখলুকের ওপর আল্লাহর উচ্চতা এবং প্রতিটি বস্তুকে ইলম, কুদরাত ও ক্ষমতা দ্বারা তার পরিবেষ্টনকে বুঝায়।

english_name.name: Al-Muhīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhīt (The All-Encompassing) is a name that denotes the exaltedness of Allah above His creation and that He encompasses everything in terms of knowledge, power, and subjugation.

translations.name: আল-আকরাম (অতি দয়াবান)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-আকরাম (অতি দয়াবান): অধিক দয়াবান ও অনুদানকারী। যার হাতে রয়েছে যাবতীয় সব কল্যাণ আর সব কল্যাণ তার থেকেই।

english_name.name: Al-Akram
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Akram (The Most Generous) is the One Who gives generously, and all goodness lies in His hand and comes from Him.

translations.name: আল-ইলাহ (সতিকার ইলাহ)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-ইলাহ (সতিকার ইলাহ): যিনি পূর্ণতার ও মহত প্রশংসার যাবতীয় সব গুণাগুণের একত্রকারী এবং সত্যিকার উপাস্য তিনি ছাড়া আর কেউ ইবাদতের উপযুক্ত নয়।

english_name.name: Al-Ilāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ilāh (The God) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection and majesty and Who alone is worthy of being worshiped.

translations.name: আন-নাসীর (সাহায্যকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আন-নাসীর (সাহায্যকারী): যিনি তার মুমিন বান্দাদের সাহায্য সহযোগিতা করেন।

english_name.name: An-Nasīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿An-Nasīr (The Helper) is the One Who helps and supports His believing servants.

translations.name: আল-মাওলা (অভিভাবক)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মাওলা (অভিভাবক): সব সৃষ্টির অভিভাবক। অর্থাৎ, তিনি তাদের সরদার, মালিক, স্রষ্টা ও তাদের সত্যিকার উপাস্য। আর তিনি তার মুমিন বান্দাদের অভিভাবক, তিনি তাদের মহব্বত করেন, তাদের ভালো কাজের তাওফীক দেন, তাদের সাহায্য করেন, তাদের কাছে তাদের প্রয়োজনী বস্তু পৌছে দেন এবং দীনি ও দুনিয়াবী উপকারী বিষয়গুলো তাদের জন্য সহজ করে দেন।

english_name.name: Al-Mawla
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mawla (The Protector) of all creation is their Master, Owner, Creator, and True Deity worthy of worship; and Al-Mawla of the believing servants is the One Who loves them, guides and supports them, and leads them to their religious and worldly interests.

translations.name: আল-হাইউ (অতি লজ্জাশীল)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-হাইউ (অতি লজ্জাশীল): অর্থাৎ, অধিক লজ্জা। এটি এমন একটি গুন যা তার সাথে প্রযোজ্য। এটি মাখলুকের লজ্জার মতো নয়। বরং তিনি তার রহমাতের প্রসস্থতা, অনুগ্রহ ও দয়ার পূর্ণতা এবং ক্ষমা ও সহশীলতার মহত্বের সাথে যা মুনাসিব নয় তা ছেড়ে দিয়েছেন।

english_name.name: Al-Hayiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayiyy (The Modest) is the One Who is very modest. This description befits Allah Almighty and it is nothing like the modesty of people. Rather, it means abandoning what does not suit His vast mercy, perfect generosity, and great forgiveness and forbearance.

translations.name: আল-মুহসিন (অনুগ্রহকারী)
translations.short_meaning_val: আল-মুহসিন (অনুগ্রহকারী): স্বীয় বান্দাদের ওপর বিভিন্ন ধরনের প্রকার প্রকাশ্য ও গোপন নিআমতসমূহ দ্বারা অনুগ্রহকারী।

english_name.name: Al-Muhsin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhsin (The Superb Benevolent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of outward and inward favors upon His servants.

translations.name: Allāh
translations.short_meaning_val: Si Allāh ay ang Diyos na sinasamba ayon sa karapatan, pag-ibig, paghahangad, at pangamba, na tagatipon ng lahat ng mga kahulugan ng mga pinakamagagandang pangalan ni Allāh, ang naglalaman ng nalalabi sa mga katangian ni Allāh (pagkataas-taas Siya).

english_name.name: Allāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Allah is the deity worthy of being worshiped out of love, hope, and fear. This name encompasses all the meanings of the beautiful names and attributes of the Almighty Lord.

translations.name: Ang Napakamaawain
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Napakamaawain ay ang may malawak na dakilang awa na sumakop sa bawat bagay.

english_name.name: Ar-Rahmān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahmān (The Most Compassionate) is the One with great and immense mercy that encompasses everything.

translations.name: Ang Maawain
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Maawain: ay ang may awang sukdulang nakaugnay sa kinaawaan.

english_name.name: Ar-Rahīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.

translations.name: Ang Hari
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Hari ay ang nailalarawan sa mga katangian ng kadakilaan, panlulupig, at pangangasiwa, ang tagapagmay-ari ng lahat ng mga bagay, ang nakapangyayari sa mga ito nang walang pagmamalabis at walang pagtutol.

english_name.name: Al-Malik
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.

translations.name: Ang Kabanal-banalan
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Kabanal-banalan ay ang dinakilang pinawalang-kinalaman sa mga katangian ng kakulangan sa kabuuan ng mga ito at pakikitulad sa Kanya ng isa man sa mga nilikha.

english_name.name: Al-Quddūs
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Quddūs (The Holy One) is the Glorified One Who is exalted far above any defect and far above resembling any of His creation.

translations.name: Ang Sakdal
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Sakdal ay ang malaya sa bawat kakulangan, salot, at kapintasan.

english_name.name: As-Salām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ As-Salām (The Source of Perfection) is the One free from any defect or fault.

translations.name: Ang Tagapagpasampalataya
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapagpasampalataya ay ang tagapagpatotoo na nagpapatotoo sa mga propeta Niya sa pamamagitan ng paglalatag ng mga katunayan at mga himala sa kanila at ang nagpapatiwasay sa nilikha laban sa kawalang-katarungan dahil sa kalubusan ng katarungan Niya.

english_name.name: Al-Mu’min
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.

translations.name: Ang Tagapagsubaybay
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapagsubaybay ay ang tagapag-aruga sa nilikha, ang tagapamahala sa kanila, ang nakapangyayari sa kanila, na pumaligid sa bawat bagay sa kaalaman.

english_name.name: Al-Muhaymin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhaymin (The All-Controller) is the Guardian over His creation, their Ruler, and the Disposer of all their affairs, Who encompasses everything in His knowledge.

translations.name: Ang Makapangyarihan
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Makapangyarihan na taglay Niya ang kapangyarihang lubos, na lumupig sa bawat anumang iba sa Kanya sa pamamagitan ng lakas Niya, pananaig Niya, at pagpigil Niya.

english_name.name: Al-‘Azīz
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azīz (The All-Mighty) is the One Who possesses the absolute might and vanquishes all others with His power, dominance, and invincibility.

translations.name: Ang Palasupil
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Palasupil ay ang nakatataas sa nilikha Niya, ang tagapanaig sa bawat bagay, na nagpasaklaw sa Kanya ang bawat bagay at nagpasailalim sa Kanya ang bawat bagay at na sumusupil sa sinumang nagpakalinga sa Kanya.

english_name.name: Al-Jabbār
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.

translations.name: Ang Nakapagmamalaki
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Nakapagmamalaki ay ang Pagkataas-taas na pagkasukdol-sukdol sa layo sa kasagwaan, kakulangan, at kapintasan dahil sa kalubusan Niya at kapitaganan sa Kanya.

english_name.name: Al-Mutakabbir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mutakabbir (The Supreme) is the One Who is far exalted above evil, deficiency, and defects, given His perfection and majesty.

translations.name: Ang Tagalikha
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagalikha ay ang tagapagpairal ng mga bagay at ang tagapagpasimula ng mga ito nang walang naunang pagkatulad.

english_name.name: Al-Khāliq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khāliq (The Creator) is the One Who brings things into existence and invents them in an unprecedented way.

translations.name: Ang Tagapaglalang
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapaglalang ay ang Tagalikha na lumikha ng lahat ng mga umiiral, nagbigay-anyo sa mga ito, at nagpairal sa mga ito matapos ng kawalan ng mga ito.

english_name.name: Al-Bāri’
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Bāri’ (The Initiator) is the Creator Who created the whole creation from nothing and gave them forms after they were non-existent.

translations.name: Ang Tagapag-anyo
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapag-anyo na nagpasimula sa paglikha Niya sa mga anyong nagkakaiba-iba at mga hugis na nagkakaibahan bilang tagapagpatunay sa kalubusan ng kaalaman Niya at karunungan Niya.

english_name.name: Al-Musawwir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Musawwir (The Supreme Fashioner) is the One Who fashioned His creation in different forms and appearances that indicate His perfect knowledge and wisdom.

english_name.name: Al-Ghaffaar
english_name.short_meaning_val:
AL-Ghaffaar (The Great Forgiver)

The Forgiver, The One who forgives the sins of His slaves time and time again

english_name.name: Al-Qahhār
english_name.short_meaning_val: THE ALL-PREVAILING ONE
english_name.meanings_val: <p><span style="font-size: 19px; color: #202122; font-weight: normal; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Arial'; font-style: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none;">The Dominant, The One who has the perfect Power and is not unable over anything.</span></p>

translations.name: Ang Palakaloob
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Palakaloob ay ang malawak ang mga bigay at ang mga kaloob, na sumaklaw sa mga nilalang sa kabuuan ng mga ito sa pagkamapagbigay Niya.

english_name.name: Al-Wahhāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wahhāb (The Bestower) is the One Who gives abundantly, and Whose generosity and bounty encompass all beings.

translations.name: Ang Palatustos
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Palatustos ay ang tagapaggarantiya ng mga panustos ng mga lingkod, na sa mga ito ang sinasalalayan ng mga puso nila at mga katawan nila.

english_name.name: Ar-Razzāq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Razzāq (The All-Provider) is the One Who guarantees His servants the sustenance that maintains their hearts and bodies.

translations.name: Ang Palahatol
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Palahatol ay ang humahatol sa mga lingkod Niya ng mga hatol Niyang pambatas, humuhusga sa kanila ng mga hatol niyang pang-itinakda, at nagtutuos sa kanila ng mga hatol Niyang pangganti.

english_name.name: Al-Fattāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Fattāh (The Greatest Judge) is the One Who judges between His servants by His religious rulings, decrees His predestination for them, and calls them to account.

translations.name: Ang Maalam
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Maalam ay ang nakapaligid ang kaalaman Niya sa bawat bagay.

english_name.name: Al-‘Alīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alīm (The All-Knowing) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses everything.

english_name.name: Al-Qaabid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE RESTRICTING ONE

The Constrictor, The Withholder, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Baasit
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE EXTENDER

The Englarger, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Khaafid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE REDUCER

The One who lowers whoever He willed by His Destruction and raises whoever He willed by His Endowment.

translations.name: Ang Tagapag-angat
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapag-angat ay ang nag-aangat ng sinumang niloloob Niya, gaya ng pag-angat sa mga katangkilik Niya sa Mundo at Kabilang-buhay.

english_name.name: Ar-Rāfi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Rāfi‘ (The Raiser) is the One Who raises whomever He wills the way He wills, as He elevates the ranks of His pious servants in this world and in the Hereafter.

translations.name: Ang Madinigin
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Madinigin ay ang nakatatalos ng lahat ng mga naririnig sapagkat Siya ay nakaririnig ng lihim at bulungan; magkapantay sa ganang Kanya ang matunog at ang mahina at ang pagbigkas at ang pananahimik.

english_name.name: As-Samī‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samī‘ (The All-Hearing) is the One Who hears everything. He hears secret and private talk. Loud and low voices, and speaking and silence are all the same to Him - He grasps all.

translations.name: Ang Nakakikita
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Nakakikita na pumaligid ang pagkakita Niya sa bawat bagay kahit pa man numipis o lumiit, ang may pagkakita sa mga bagay, ang Mapagbatid sa mga ito, ang tagaarok sa mga nakapaloob ng mga ito.

english_name.name: Al-Basīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Basīr (The All-Seeing) is the One Whose sight encompasses everything, no matter how small or minute they may be, and He is the One Who is All-Aware of everything and All-Knowing of their hidden aspects.

translations.name: Ang Hukom
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Hukom ay ang nasa Kanya ang hatol sa bawat bagay. Siya ay humahatol ng ninanais Niya at humahatol sa mga lingkod Niya ayon sa totoo at katarungan.

english_name.name: Al-Hakam
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakam (The Judge) is the One to Whom belongs judgment in all things, and Who ordains what He wills and judges between His servants with the truth and justice.

translations.name: Ang Mapagtalos
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mapagtalos ay ang hindi naikukubli sa Kanya ang mga bagay kahit pa man numipis ang mga ito, ang Mabuting-loob na naglulumanay sa kanila at nagtutuon sa kanila sa anumang naroon ang kaayusan nila.

english_name.name: Al-Latīf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Latīf (The All-Subtle) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, no matter how small it may be, and the One Who shows kindness and leniency to His servants and guides them to what is good for them.

translations.name: Ang Mapagbatid
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mapagbatid ay ang nakapaligid ang kaalaman niya sa mga nakapaloob ng mga bagay at mga kubli ng mga ito kung paanong nakapaligid iyon sa mga nakalantad ng mga ito.

english_name.name: Al-Khabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khabīr (The All-Aware) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses the inward and hidden aspects of things, as well as their outward aspects.

translations.name: Ang Matimpiin
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Matimpiin ay ang may kahinahunan na hindi nagmamadali sa mga lingkod Niya sa pagparusa sa kanila sa mga pagkakasala nila.

english_name.name: Al-Halīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Halīm (The Forbearing) is the One Who possesses deliberation and does not hasten to punish His servants for their sins.

translations.name: Ang Sukdulan
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Sukdulan ay ang tagapagtipon ng lahat ng mga katangian ng kalubusan, karingalan, pagkamalaki, at kadakilaan na iniibig ng mga puso at dinadakila ng mga kaluluwa.

english_name.name: Al-‘Azhīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azhīm (The Magnificent) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection, glory, pride, and majesty, and Who is loved and extolled by His servants.

translations.name: Ang Mapagpatawad
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mapagpatawad ay ang nagsasanggalang sa mga lingkod Niya sa kasamaan ng mga pagkakasala nila at hindi nagpaparusa sa kanila sa mga ito.

english_name.name: Al-Ghafūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ghafūr (The All-Forgiving) is the One Who spares His servants the evil of their sins and does not punish them.

translations.name: Ang Mapagpasalamat
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mapagpasalamat ay ang nagpapasalamat sa kaunti mula sa gawa sa pamamagitan ng masaganang pinag-ibayong paggagantimpala at nagpapaumanhin sa marami sa mga pagkatisod.

english_name.name: Ash-Shakūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shakūr (The Most Appreciative) is the One Who appreciates even little deeds and gives immense and multiple rewards in return, and Who forgives numerous errors.

translations.name: Ang Mataas
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mataas ay ang taglay Niya ang kataasang walang-takda sa lahat ng mga paraan: kataasan ng antas, kataasan ng paggapi, at kataasan ng sarili.

english_name.name: Al-‘Alyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alyy (The High) is the One Who possesses absolute highness in all aspects: His status, His power, and His essence.

translations.name: Ang Malaki
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Malaki ay ang sukdulan, na ang bawat bagay ay mababa sa Kanya at walang bagay na higit na sukdulan kaysa sa Kanya.

english_name.name: Al-Kabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kabīr (The Great) is the One Who is greater than everything, and all else are inferior to Him.

translations.name: Ang Mapag-ingat
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mapag-ingat ay ang nag-ingat ng nilikha Niya, pumaligid ang kaalaman Niya sa anumang pinairal Niya, nag-ingat ng mga katangkilik Niya laban sa pagbagsak nila sa mga pagkakasala at mga kasawian, at nag-isa-isa sa mga lingkod ng mga gawa nila at ganti sa mga ito.

english_name.name: Al-Hafīzh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hafīzh (The All-Preserver) is the One Who preserves what He created; Whose knowledge encompasses all that He brought into existence; Who protects His pious servants from committing sins and ruinous acts; and Who records their deeds and the recompense for them.

translations.name: Ang Tagapagpakain
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapagpakain ay ang nagtatakda ng mga pakain sa mga nilikha sa pamamagitan ng kaalaman Niya, pagkatapos nag-aakay ng mga ito patungo sa kanila sa pamamagitan ng kapangyarihan Niya at naghahati-hati ng mga ito sa pagitan nila.

english_name.name: Al-Muqīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqīt (The All-Nourisher) is the One Who determines the sustenance of His creation according to His knowledge, brings it to them with His power, and distributes it amongst them.

translations.name: Ang Mapagtuos
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mapagtuos ay ang tagapagpasapat sa mga lingkod Niya, na mga mananampalatayang nananalig sa Kanya, ang maalam sa mga gawain ng mga lingkod Niya, ang tagapagtuos sa kanila sa mga ito.

english_name.name: Al-Hasīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hasīb (The Ever-Reckoner) is the One Who grants sufficiency to His believing servants who rely upon Him, and Who knows their deeds and holds them accountable for them.

translations.name: Ang Mapagbigay
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mapagbigay ay ang marami ang kabutihan, ang sukdulan ang pakinabang.

english_name.name: Al-Karīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Karīm (The Generous) is the One Who gives abundant good and welfare.

translations.name: Ang Mapagmasid
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mapagmasid ay ang tagaarok sa bawat bagay, ang tagasaksi sa mga lihim at mga budhi, na nakaalam, nakakikita, at hindi nakakukubli sa kanya ang lihim at ang bulungan.

english_name.name: Ar-Raqīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Raqīb (The Ever-Watchful) is the One Who watches over everything and witnesses inner thoughts and secrets, and Who knows and sees all things and no secret or private talk is hidden from Him.

translations.name: Ang Tagasagot
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagasagot ay ang nagtatapat sa paghiling ng mga tagahiling at panalangin ng mga tagadalangin ng pagsagot at pagtanggap.

english_name.name: Al-Mujīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mujīb (The All-Responsive) is the One Who responds to supplications by answering them and to requests by fulfilling them.

translations.name: Ang Malawak
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Malawak ay ang taglay Niya mula sa bawat paglalarawan ng kahulugan ang pinakaganap at ang antas na pinakalubos.

english_name.name: Al-Wāsi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāsi‘ (The All-Embracing) is the One to Whom belongs the most perfect and complete meaning of every attribute.

translations.name: Ang Marunong
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Marunong ay ang inilalarawan sa kalubusan ng karunungan sa mga utos Niya at mga pagbabatas Niya at sa kalubusan ng paghahatol sa pagitan ng mga nilikha Niya.

english_name.name: Al-Hakīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakīm (The All-Wise) is the One Who possesses perfect wisdom in His commands and legislations, and perfect judgment between His creation.

translations.name: Ang Mapagmahal
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mapagmahal ay ang tagaibig ng iniibig sapagkat Siya ay ang umiibig sa mga propeta Niya at mga sugo Niya at ang mga tagasunod nila ay umiibig sa Kanya.

english_name.name: Al-Wadūd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wadūd (The Most Affectionate) is the One Who loves and is loved. He loves His prophets and messengers and their followers, and they love Him.

translations.name: Ang Maringal
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Maringal ay ang nagkakatangian ng maraming dakilang malawak na katangian ng kalubusan.

english_name.name: Al-Majīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Majīd (The Most Glorious) is the One Who possesses the various attributes of supreme majesty and perfection.

translations.name: Ang Saksi
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Saksi ay ang walang nalilingid sa Kanya na anuman, bagkus Siya ay nakatatalos sa bawat bagay, na nakasasaksi rito, na maalam sa mga detalye nito.

english_name.name: Ash-Shahīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shahīd (The Ever-Witness) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, rather He knows and witnesses everything and is Aware of its details.

translations.name: Ang Totoo
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Totoo ay ang nagkatotoo ang pagiging Niya at ang kairalan Niya at na ang mga pangalan Niya, ang mga katangian Niya, ang mga gawa Niya, ang mga hatol Niya, at ang ganti Niya ay kalubusan at totoo sapagkat walang anuman sa mga ito na bulaan.

english_name.name: Al-Haqq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Haqq (The Truth) is the True One in terms of His being and His existence; and the One Whose names, attributes, actions, judgments, and recompense are all perfect and true.

translations.name: Ang Pinananaligan
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Pinananaligan ay ang mapagpanagot sa mga panustos ng nilikha Niya, ang tagapag-aruga sa kanila sa mga kapakanan nila, at ang tumangkilik sa mga katangkilik Niya saka nagpadali sa kanila para sa pinakamadali, nagpaiwas sa kanila ng pinakamahirap, at nagpasapat sa kanila ng mga nauukol.

english_name.name: Al-Wakīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wakīl (The Trustee) is the One Who guarantees the sustenance of His creation and manages their affairs and maintains their welfare; and Who supports His pious servants and, thus, guides them to ease, grants them sufficiency, and keeps them away from difficulty.

translations.name: Ang Malakas
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Malakas ay ang ganap ang lakas na hindi nadadaig ng isang tagadaig at hindi natututulan ang paghuhusga Niya ng isang tagatutol.

english_name.name: Al-Qawiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qawiyy (The All-Powerful) is the One with complete power Who cannot be overcome and Whose predestination cannot be repelled.

translations.name: Ang Matibay
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Matibay ay ang matinding kadulu-duluhan sa lakas at kakayahan kaya hindi Siya nasusundan ng isang kahinaan at isang hirap.

english_name.name: Al-Matīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Matīn (The Most Firm) is the One Who possesses infinite power and ability so He never experiences any weakness or hardship.

translations.name: Ang Katangkilik
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Katangkilik ay tagapag-adya ng mga mananampalatayang lingkod Niya at ang tagapag-aruga sa mga nauukol sa nilikha Niya nang magkakasama.

english_name.name: Al-Walyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Walyy (The Guardian) is the One Who supports His believing servants and manages the affairs of all His creation.

translations.name: Ang Kapuri-puri
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Kapuri-puri ay isang pangngalang nagpahiwatig ng lahat ng mga pagpupuri at mga kalubusan ukol kay Allāh (pagkataas-taas Siya), ang karapat-dapat sa papuri dahil sa kalubusan Niya sa sarili Niya, mga pangalan Niya, mga katangian Niya, at mga gawa Niya.

english_name.name: Al-Hamīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hamīd (The Praiseworthy) is a name that denotes all the praiseworthy and perfect attributes of Allah Almighty, Who deserves praise for the perfection of His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: Ang Buháy
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Buháy ay ang taglay Niya ang lahat ng mga kahulugan ng buhay na lubos na hindi nauunahan ng kawalan at hindi nasusundan ng pagkalipol.

english_name.name: Al-Hayy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayy (The Ever-Living) is the One to Whom belong all meanings of perfect life that is not preceded by nothingness nor followed by doom.

translations.name: Ang Mapagpanatili
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mapagpanatili ay ang nanatili sa sarili Niya sapagkat hindi Siya nangailangan sa isa man at nanatili ang bawat bagay dahil sa Kanya sapagkat walang isang walang-pangangailangan sa Kanya.

english_name.name: Al-Qayyūm
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Qayyūm (The Self-Subsisting) is the One Who is self-sustaining, so He does not need anyone, and everything depends on Him and none can dispense with Him.

translations.name: Ang Nag-iisa
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Nag-iisa ay nagpakabukod-tangi sa lahat ng mga kalubusan sa sarili Niya, sa mga katangian Niya, at mga gawa Niya sapagkat walang katambal sa Kanya sa anuman mula roon.

english_name.name: Al-Wāhid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāhid (The One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His essence, attributes, and actions, and none shares any of this with Him.

translations.name: Ang Dulugan
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Dulugan ay ang lubos na panginoon at ang dakilang soberano, ang pinapakay sa bawat pangangailangan sa pagkaibig at pagkasindak.

english_name.name: As-Samad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samad (The Eternal Refuge) is the Perfect Lord and the Magnificent Master to Whom everyone turns, out of hope and fear.

translations.name: Ang Nakakakaya
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Nakakakaya ay ang taglay Niya ang ganap na sumasaklaw na lubos na kakayahan na walang nakapagpapawalang-kakayahan sa Kanya na anuman at walang nakaaalpas sa Kanya na isang hiniling.

english_name.name: Al-Qādir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qādir (The Able) is the One Who possesses complete and comprehensive power, nothing can challenge Him, and none can escape His power or will.

translations.name: Ang Tagakaya
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagakaya ay ang taglay Niya ang ganap na kakayahan na walang nakapipigil dito na anuman.

english_name.name: Al-Muqtadir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqtadir (The Dominant) is the One Who possesses complete unopposed power.

translations.name: Ang Tagapagpauna
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapagpauna ay ang tagapababa ng mga antas ng nagiging karapat-dapat sa mga ito. Nagpapauna Siya ng anumang niloob Niya mula sa mga ito at nagpapahuli Siya ng anumang niloob Niya.

english_name.name: Al-Muqaddim
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqaddim (The Advancer) is the One Who puts things in their due places, advancing what He wills and delaying what He wills.

translations.name: Ang Tagapagpahuli
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapagpahuli ay ang nagpapahuli ng mga bagay na nagiging karapat-dapat sa pagpapahuli para maglagay Siya ng mga ito sa kalalagyan ng mga ito.

english_name.name: Al-Mu’akhkhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu’akhkhir (The Delayer) is the One Who delays things that should be delayed, thus putting them in their proper place.

translations.name: Ang Una
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Una ay ang wala pang anuman bago Niya.

english_name.name: Al-Awwal
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Awwal (The First) is the One before Whom there was nothing.

translations.name: Ang Huli
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Huli ay ang wala nang anuman matapos Niya.

english_name.name: Al-Ākhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ākhir (The Last) is the One after Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: Ang Nakaiibabaw
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Nakaiibabaw ay ang walang anumang nasa itaas Niya.

english_name.name: Azh-Zhāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Azh-Zhāhir (The Manifest) is the One above Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: Ang Nakaiilalim
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Nakaiilalim ay ang walang anumang nasa ibaba Niya.

english_name.name: Al-Bātin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Bātin (The Hidden) is the One beneath Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: Ang Pagkataas-taas
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Pagkataas-taas ay pangngalang tagapagpahiwatig ng walang-takdang kataasan ni Allāh sa lahat ng mga paraan: kataasan ng sarili, kataasan ng antas, at kataasan ng panlulupig.

english_name.name: Al-Muta‘āl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muta‘āl (The Exalted) is a name that denotes the absolute exaltation of Allah in all aspects: His essence, His status, and His power.

translations.name: Ang Mabuting-loob
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mabuting-loob ay ang tagagawa ng maganda na nagbiyaya sa mga tao ng mga uri ng mga biyaya.

english_name.name: Al-Barr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Barr (The Beneficent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of blessings upon His servants.

translations.name: Ang Palatanggap ng Pagbabalik-loob
