translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Palatanggap ng Pagbabalik-loob ay ang nagtutuon sa tao sa pagbabalik-loob at tumatanggap nito mula sa kanya.

english_name.name: At-Tawwāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tawwāb (The Accepting of Repentance) is the One Who guides His servants to repentance and accepts it from them.

translations.name: Ang Mapagpaumanhin
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mapagpaumanhin ay ang pumapawi sa mga masagwang gawa at nagpapalampas sa mga pagsuway.

english_name.name: Al-‘Afuww
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Afuww (The Pardoner) is the One Who erases misdeeds and pardons sins.

translations.name: Ang Mahabagin
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mahabagin ay ang matindi ang pagkahabag sa mga lingkod Niya at ang pagkaawa sa kanila.

english_name.name: Ar-Ra’ūf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Ra’ūf (The All-Kind) is the One Who is the most kind and merciful towards His creation.

english_name.name: Maalik-Ul-Mulk
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE ETERNAL POSSESSOR OF SOVEREIGNTY

The One who controls the Dominion and gives dominion to whoever He willed.

translations.name: Ang May Pagpipitagan at Pagpaparangal
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang May Pagpipitagan at Pagpaparangal ay ang may kadakilaan, pagkamalaki, pagkaawa, pagkamapagbigay-loob, ang karapat-dapat sa pagdakila at papuri.

english_name.name: Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām (Lord of Majesty and Bounty) is the Possessor of greatness, pride, mercy, and bounty, Who deserves glorification and praise.

translations.name: Ang Walang-pangangailangan
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Walang-pangangailangan ay ang bawat iba sa Kanya ay nangangailangan sa Kanya at wala sa Kanyang pangangailangan sa isa man.

english_name.name: A-Ghanyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿A-Ghanyy (The Self-Sufficient) is the One Who is needed by all and Who does not need anyone.

translations.name: Ang Tagapatnubay
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapatnubay ay ang gumagabay sa lingkod Niya tungo sa lahat ng mga pakinabang at tungo sa pagtulak ng mga pinsala at nagtutuon sa sinumang niloob Niya mula sa kanila tungo sa patnubay.

english_name.name: Al-Hādi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hādi (The Guide) is the One Who guides His servants to all beneficial things and leads them away from harmful ones, and Who leads whomever He wills to guidance.

translations.name: Ang Tagapagmana
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapagmana ay ang matitira matapos ng pagkalipol ng nilikha, na magmamana sa lupa at sinumang nasa ibabaw nito.

english_name.name: Al-Wārith
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wārith (The Inheritor) is the One Who lasts after the doom of all creation and Who inherits the earth and all that is in it.

translations.name: Ang Marikit
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Marikit ay ang taglay Niya ang karikitang walang-takda sa sarili Niya, mga pangalan Niya, mga katangian Niya, at mga gawa Niya.

english_name.name: Al-Jamīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jamīl (The Beautiful) is the One Who possesses absolute beauty in His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: Ang Tagagapi
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagagapi ay ang nagpasailalim sa Kanya ang lahat ng mga nilalang, nagpakaaba sa Kanya ang lahat ng mga nilikha, at nagpasaklaw ang mga ito sa kapangyarihan Niya at kalooban Niya.

english_name.name: Al-Qāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qāhir (The Vanquisher) is the One to Whom all beings submit and before Whose power and will all beings stand humbly.

translations.name: Ang Malapit
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Malapit ay ang malapit mula sa tagatalima sa Kanya sa pamamagitan ng paggagantimpala, mula sa tagapanalangin sa Kanya sa pamamagitan ng pagsagot, at mula sa lahat ng mga lingkod Niya sa pamamagitan ng kaalaman. Ito ay hindi nagkakaila sa kataasan Niya (kaluwalhatian sa Kanya).

english_name.name: Al-Qarīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qarīb (The Near) is the One Who is near His obedient servants with reward; near those who supplicate Him with the answer; and near the rest of His servants with knowledge. This does not contradict His being high above.

translations.name: Ang Panginoon
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Panginoon ay ang soberano, ang tagapagmay-ari, ang tagapagpaayos ng iba pa sa Kanya, ang tagapag-alaga ng lahat ng mga lingkod Niya sa pamamagitan ng pangangasiwa at ng mga uri ng mga biyaya.

english_name.name: Ar-Rabb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rabb (The Lord) is the Master, the Owner, the Reformer, and the One Who fosters His servants by managing their affairs and bestowing favors upon them.

translations.name: Ang Tagalinaw
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagalinaw ay ang malinaw ang nauukol sa Kanya sa kaisahan at na Siya ay walang katambal, at ang naglilinaw sa mga lingkod Niya ng totoo.

english_name.name: Al-Mubīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mubīn (The Evident) is the One Who is evident in His Oneness and that He has no partner, and Who clarifies the truth to His servants.

translations.name: Ang Tagapagbigay
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapagbigay ay ang namumukod-tangi sa pagbibigay ayon sa katotohanan, na walang tagapigil sa anumang ibinigay Niya at walang tagapagbigay sa anuman pinigil Niya.

english_name.name: Al-Mu‘ti
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu‘ti (The Giver) is the only One Who gives, and no one can withhold what He has given or give what He has withheld.

translations.name: Ang Tagapagpasapat
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapagpasapat ay ang nagpapasapat sa mga lingkod Niya ng lahat ng kinakailangan nila at ang nakasasapat ang pantulong Niya higit sa iba pa sa Kanya at maipangkakasya higit sa iba sa Kanya.

english_name.name: Al-Kāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kāfi (The All-Sufficient) is the One Who fulfills all the needs of His servants and Who is sufficient for them beyond need for anyone else.

translations.name: Ang Gansal
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Gansal ay ang nag-iisa na walang katambal sa Kanya at walang kapuwa.

english_name.name: Al-Witr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Witr (The Odd) is the One Who has no partner or equal.

translations.name: Ang Kaisa-isa
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Kaisa-isa ay ang nagpakaisa sa lahat ng mga kalubusan sa pagkapanginoon Niya, pagkadiyos Niya, at mga pangalan Niya at mga katangian Niya; at nagpakabukod-tangi sa mga ito yayamang walang nakikitambal sa Kanya sa mga ito na isang nakikitambal.

english_name.name: Al-Ahad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ahad (The Only One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His lordship, divinity, names, and attributes, and none shares any of them with Him.

translations.name: Ang Mapagbigay-loob
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mapagbigay-loob ay ang marami ang pagbibigay na lumahat sa pagbibigay Niya sa lahat ng mga nilalang.

english_name.name: Al-Jawād
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jawād (The Munificent) is the One Who gives abundantly to all creatures.

translations.name: Ang Malumanay
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Malumanay ay ang tagapaghinay-hinay sa mga nauukol, ang tagapagdahan-dahan sa mga ito, na hindi nagmamadali sa kaparusahan ng mga tagasuway.

english_name.name: Ar-Rafīq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rafīq (The Kind) is the One Who acts deliberately and gradually, and does not hasten to punish sinners.

translations.name: Ang Soberano
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Soberano ay ang Panginoon at ang Tagapagmay-ari, ang May-ari ng soberenya sa reyalidad, na bumabalik ang paglikha sa Kanya sa mga nauukol sa Mundo at Kabilang-buhay.

english_name.name: As-Sayyid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Sayyid (The Master) is the Lord and the Owner, the One Who possesses true dominance, and to Whom all creation turns for their worldly and their Hereafter affairs.

translations.name: Ang Kaluwa-luwalhati
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Kaluwa-luwalhati ay pinawalang-kinalaman sa mga kakulangan at mga kapintasan, na binabanal at pinawawalang-kinalaman ng bawat sinumang nasa mga langit at lupa.

english_name.name: As-Subbūh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Subbūh (The All-Glorious) is the One far exalted above deficiencies and defects and Who is extolled and glorified by all those in the heavens and the earth.

translations.name: Ang Tagapagpagaling
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapagpagaling ay ang naglulunas sa mga lingkod mula sa mga sakit ng mga katawan, mga paghihinala ng mga puso, at mga pagnanasa ng mga kaluluwa.

english_name.name: Ash-Shāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shāfi (The Healer) is the One Who cures His servants from the illnesses of their bodies, the doubts of their hearts, and the vain desires of their selves.

translations.name: Ang Tagapagpasalamat
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapagpasalamat ay ang tagapuri sa sinumang tumatalima sa Kanya, ang tagapagbunyi niyon, at ang tagagantimpala niyon sa pagtalima sa Kanya higit sa nagiging karapat-dapat dahil doon.

english_name.name: Ash-Shākir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shākir (The Appreciative) is the One Who praises those who obey Him and rewards them beyond what is due to them.

translations.name: Ang Kaaya-aya
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Kaaya-aya ay nangangahulugan na Siya (pagkataas-taas Siya) ay binabanal at pinawawalang-kinalaman sa mga kakulangan at mga kapintasan sa kabuuan ng mga ito.

english_name.name: At-Tayyib
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tayyib (The Good) means that Allah Almighty is extolled and exalted far above all deficiencies and defects.

translations.name: Ang Pinakamataas
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Pinakamataas ay isang pangngalang tagapagpahiwatig ng pananatili ng lahat ng mga kahulugan ng kataasan kay Allāh sa bawat paraan ayon sa kataasan ng sarili, kataasan ng antas, at kataasan ng paggapi.

english_name.name: Al-A‘la
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-A‘la (The Most High) is a name that denotes the affirmation of all meanings of highness for Allah Almighty from every aspect: highness in His essence, highness in His status, and highness in His power.

translations.name: Ang May-kakayahan
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang May-kakayahan ay ang may lubos na kakayahan na hindi dinadapuan ng isang kawalang-kakayahan ni isang pananamlay.

english_name.name: Al-Qadīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qadīr (The Omnipotent) is the One Who possesses complete power and does not suffer any incapability or fatigue.

translations.name: Ang Palamagandang-loob
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Palamagandang-loob ay ang tagapagbiyaya, ang tagapagbigay, ang sukdulan ang mga kaloob, na nagbibigay-loob ng biyaya bago ng paghingi nito.

english_name.name: Al-Mannān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mannān (The Bestower of Favors) is the One Who bestows great favors and gives blessings to His servants before they ask for them.

translations.name: Ang Tagapaligid
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagapaligid ay isang pangngalang nagpapahiwatig ng kataasan ni Allāh sa nilikha Niya at pagpaligid Niya sa bawat bagay sa kaalaman, sa kakayahan, at sa paggapi.

english_name.name: Al-Muhīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhīt (The All-Encompassing) is a name that denotes the exaltedness of Allah above His creation and that He encompasses everything in terms of knowledge, power, and subjugation.

translations.name: Ang Pinakamapagbigay
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Pinakamapagbigay ay ang marami ang kabutihan at ang pagbibigay, na nasa kamay Niya ang kabutihan sa kabuuan nito at ang bawat kabutihan ay mula sa Kanya (kaluwalhatian sa Kanya).

english_name.name: Al-Akram
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Akram (The Most Generous) is the One Who gives generously, and all goodness lies in His hand and comes from Him.

translations.name: Ang Diyos
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Diyos ay ang tagapagtipon ng lahat ng mga katangian ng kalubusan at mga pang-uri ng kapitaganan, ang sinasamba na walang nagiging karapat-dapat sa pagsamba na isa man maliban sa Kanya.

english_name.name: Al-Ilāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ilāh (The God) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection and majesty and Who alone is worthy of being worshiped.

translations.name: Ang Mapag-adya
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mapag-adya ay ang nag-aadya sa mga mananampalatayang lingkod Niya at tumutulong sa kanila.

english_name.name: An-Nasīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿An-Nasīr (The Helper) is the One Who helps and supports His believing servants.

translations.name: Ang Pinagpapatangkilikan
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Pinagpapatangkilikan ay ang pinagpapatangkilikan ng mga nilikha nang sama-sama sa kahulugang Siya ay ang soberano nila, ang tagapagmay-ari nila, ang sinasamba nilang totoo, at ang pinagpapatangkilikan ng mga mananampalatayang tagasamba Niya. Umiibig Siya sa kanila, nagtutuon Siya sa kanila, nag-aadya Siya sa kanila, nagpaparating Siya sa kanila sa mga kapakanan nila, nagpapadali Siya para sa kanila ng mga kapakinabangan nilang panrelihiyon at pangkabilang-buhay.

english_name.name: Al-Mawla
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mawla (The Protector) of all creation is their Master, Owner, Creator, and True Deity worthy of worship; and Al-Mawla of the believing servants is the One Who loves them, guides and supports them, and leads them to their religious and worldly interests.

translations.name: Ang Mahiyain
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Mahiyain ay ang marami ang hiya. Ito ay paglalarawang nababagay sa Kanya, na hindi gaya ng hiya ng mga nilikha; bagkus Siya ay nag-iwan ng anumang hindi naaangkop sa lawak ng pagkaawa Niya at kalubusan ng pagkamapagbigay-loob Niya, karangalan Niya, at kadakilaan ng pagpapaumanhin Niya at pagtitimpi Niya.

english_name.name: Al-Hayiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayiyy (The Modest) is the One Who is very modest. This description befits Allah Almighty and it is nothing like the modesty of people. Rather, it means abandoning what does not suit His vast mercy, perfect generosity, and great forgiveness and forbearance.

translations.name: Ang Tagagawa ng Maganda
translations.short_meaning_val: Ang Tagagawa ng Maganda ay ang tagapagmagandang-loob sa mga lingkod Niya ng mga uri ng mga biyayang nakalantad at nakapaloob.

english_name.name: Al-Muhsin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhsin (The Superb Benevolent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of outward and inward favors upon His servants.

translations.name: അല്ലാഹു (യഥാർഥ ആരാധ്യൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: ﻿അല്ലാഹു: (അങ്ങേയറ്റത്തെ) സ്നേഹത്തോടെയും ഭയത്തോടെയും പ്രതീക്ഷയോടെയും ആരാധിക്കപ്പെടാൻ അർഹതയുള്ള യഥാർത്ഥ ആരാധ്യൻ. അല്ലാഹുവിൻ്റെ അത്യുൽകൃഷ്ടമായ എല്ലാ നാമങ്ങളുടെയും ആശയം ഈ നാമം ഒരുമിപ്പിക്കുന്നു. അവൻ്റെ എല്ലാ വിശേഷണങ്ങളും ഈ നാമം ഉൾക്കൊള്ളുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.

english_name.name: Allāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Allah is the deity worthy of being worshiped out of love, hope, and fear. This name encompasses all the meanings of the beautiful names and attributes of the Almighty Lord.

translations.name: അർ-റഹ്മാൻ (പരമകാരുണ്യമുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-റഹ്മാൻ: സർവ്വതിനെയും വിശാലമായി ചൂഴ്ന്നിരിക്കുന്ന, മഹത്തരമായ കാരുണ്യത്തിൻ്റെ ഉടമ.

english_name.name: Ar-Rahmān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahmān (The Most Compassionate) is the One with great and immense mercy that encompasses everything.

translations.name: അൽ-റഹീം (ധാരാളമായി കരുണ ചൊരിയുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-റഹീം: സൃഷ്ടികളിലേക്ക് എത്തുന്ന മഹത്തരമായ കാരുണ്യത്തിൻ്റെ ഉടമ.

english_name.name: Ar-Rahīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.

translations.name: അൽ-മലിക് (സർവ്വാധികാരി).
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മലിക്: മഹത്വത്തിൻ്റെയും അധീശത്വത്തിൻ്റെയും നിയന്ത്രണത്തിൻ്റെയും വിശേഷണങ്ങളുള്ളവൻ. സർവ്വതിനെയും ഉടമപ്പെടുത്തുന്നവനും, അവയെ അതിരുകവിയാതെയും കുറഞ്ഞു പോകാതെയും മാറ്റിമറിക്കുന്നവനും അവനത്രെ.

english_name.name: Al-Malik
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.

translations.name: അൽ-ഖുദ്ദൂസ് (പരമപരിശുദ്ധൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഖുദ്ദൂസ്: അങ്ങേയറ്റം ആദരണീയനും, ന്യൂനതയുടെ എല്ലാ വിശേഷണങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നും പരിശുദ്ധനുമായവൻ. സൃഷ്ടികളിൽ ആരെങ്കിലും അവനോട് സമമാവുക എന്നതിൽ നിന്നും അവൻ പരിശുദ്ധനായിരിക്കുന്നു.

english_name.name: Al-Quddūs
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Quddūs (The Holy One) is the Glorified One Who is exalted far above any defect and far above resembling any of His creation.

translations.name: അസ്സലാം: സർവ്വന്യൂനതകളിൽ നിന്നും പരിശുദ്ധനായവൻ.
translations.short_meaning_val: അസ്സലാം: എല്ലാ ന്യൂനതകളിൽ നിന്നും കുറവുകളിൽ നിന്നും കുഴപ്പങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നും പരിശുദ്ധനായവൻ.

english_name.name: As-Salām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ As-Salām (The Source of Perfection) is the One free from any defect or fault.

translations.name: അൽ-മുഅ്മിൻ (നിർഭയത്വമേകുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുഅ്മിൻ: തൻ്റെ ദൂതന്മാർക്ക് വേണ്ടി തെളിവുകൾ സ്ഥാപിച്ചും (ഒരു സൃഷ്ടിക്കും സാധ്യമല്ലാത്ത) അത്ഭുതപ്രവൃത്തികൾ നൽകിയും അവരെ സത്യപ്പെടുത്തുന്നവനും, സർവ്വസൃഷ്ടികൾക്കും അവൻ്റെ പരിപൂർണ്ണ നീതിയാൽ അനീതിയിൽ നിന്ന് നിർഭയത്വം നൽകുന്നവനും.

english_name.name: Al-Mu’min
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.

translations.name: അൽ-മുഹൈമിൻ (മേൽനോട്ടം വഹിക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുഹൈമിൻ: സൃഷ്ടികളെ നിലനിർത്തുന്നവനും, അവരുടെ മേൽ വിധി പ്രഖ്യാപിക്കുന്നവനും അവരെ നിയന്ത്രിക്കുന്നവനും. സർവ്വതിനെയും അവൻ തൻ്റെ അറിവ് കൊണ്ട് വലയം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു.

english_name.name: Al-Muhaymin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhaymin (The All-Controller) is the Guardian over His creation, their Ruler, and the Disposer of all their affairs, Who encompasses everything in His knowledge.

translations.name: അൽ-അസീസ് (മഹാപ്രതാപവാൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-അസീസ്: സമ്പൂർണ്ണ പ്രതാപമുള്ളവൻ. എല്ലാ സൃഷ്ടികളെയും തൻ്റെ ശക്തിയാലും, അവരെ വിജയിച്ചടക്കി കൊണ്ടും, അവൻ്റെ സംരക്ഷണം കൊണ്ടും അവൻ കീഴൊതുക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.

english_name.name: Al-‘Azīz
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azīz (The All-Mighty) is the One Who possesses the absolute might and vanquishes all others with His power, dominance, and invincibility.

translations.name: അൽ-ജബ്ബാർ
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ജബ്ബാർ: സർവ്വതിൻ്റെയും മേൽ ഔന്നത്യവും അധീശത്വവുമുള്ളവൻ. എല്ലാ വസ്തുക്കളും കീഴൊതുങ്ങുകയും, താഴ്മയോടെ വണങ്ങുകയും ചെയ്തവൻ. തന്നിലേക്ക് അഭയം തേടിവന്നവരുടെ കുറവുകൾ നികത്തിനൽകുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Jabbār
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.

translations.name: അൽ-മുതകബ്ബിർ (അഹങ്കാരമുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുതകബ്ബിർ: പ്രൗഢി പ്രകടിപ്പിക്കുന്നവനും സർവ്വന്യൂനതകളിൽ നിന്നും കുറവുകളിൽ നിന്നും മോശങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നും മഹത്വം സ്വീകരിച്ചവനും. കാരണം അവൻ എല്ലാ സമ്പൂർണ്ണതയും മഹത്വവും ഉള്ളവനാകുന്നു.

english_name.name: Al-Mutakabbir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mutakabbir (The Supreme) is the One Who is far exalted above evil, deficiency, and defects, given His perfection and majesty.

translations.name: അൽ-ഖാലിഖ് (സർവ്വതിൻ്റെയും സ്രഷ്ടാവ്)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഖാലിഖ്: എല്ലാ വസ്തുക്കളെയും ഒരു മുൻ മാതൃകയുമില്ലാതെ സൃഷ്ടിക്കുകയും നിർമ്മിക്കുകയും ചെയ്തവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Khāliq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khāliq (The Creator) is the One Who brings things into existence and invents them in an unprecedented way.

translations.name: അൽ-ബാരിഅ്: (സർവ്വതിനെയും നിർമ്മിച്ചവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ബാരിഅ്: സർവ്വ വസ്തുക്കളെയും സൃഷ്ടിക്കുകയും, അവക്ക് രൂപം നൽകുകയും, അവയെ ശൂന്യതയിൽ നിന്ന് ഉണ്ടാക്കുകയും ചെയ്തവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Bāri’
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Bāri’ (The Initiator) is the Creator Who created the whole creation from nothing and gave them forms after they were non-existent.

translations.name: അൽ-മുസ്വവ്വിർ: (രൂപം നൽകുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുസ്വവ്വിർ: തൻ്റെ സൃഷ്ടികളെ വ്യത്യസ്ത രൂപങ്ങളിൽ നിർമ്മിക്കുകയും, അവൻ്റെ പരിപൂർണ്ണ അറിവിനെയും യുക്തിയെയും അറിയിക്കുന്ന തരത്തിൽ അവരെ വിഭിന്നമായ കോലങ്ങളിൽ സൃഷ്ടിക്കുകയും ചെയ്തവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Musawwir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Musawwir (The Supreme Fashioner) is the One Who fashioned His creation in different forms and appearances that indicate His perfect knowledge and wisdom.

english_name.name: Al-Ghaffaar
english_name.short_meaning_val:
AL-Ghaffaar (The Great Forgiver)

The Forgiver, The One who forgives the sins of His slaves time and time again

english_name.name: Al-Qahhār
english_name.short_meaning_val: THE ALL-PREVAILING ONE
english_name.meanings_val: <p><span style="font-size: 19px; color: #202122; font-weight: normal; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Arial'; font-style: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none;">The Dominant, The One who has the perfect Power and is not unable over anything.</span></p>

translations.name: അൽ-വഹ്ഹാബ്: (ധാരാളമായി ഔദാര്യങ്ങൾ ചൊരിയുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-വഹ്ഹാബ്: വിശാലമായി ദാനം നൽകുന്നവനും ഔദാര്യങ്ങൾ ചൊരിയുന്നവനും. സർവ്വലോകങ്ങളും അവൻ തൻ്റെ ദാനങ്ങളാലും ഔദാര്യങ്ങളാലും പൊതിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.

english_name.name: Al-Wahhāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wahhāb (The Bestower) is the One Who gives abundantly, and Whose generosity and bounty encompass all beings.

translations.name: അർ-റസാഖ് (സർവ്വർക്കും ഉപജീവനം നൽകുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അർ-റസാഖ്: തൻ്റെ ദാസന്മാരുടെ ഹൃദയങ്ങൾക്കും ശരീരങ്ങൾക്കും നിലനിൽക്കാൻ വേണ്ട വിഭവങ്ങൾ (നൽകാനുള്ള ബാധ്യത സ്വയം) ഏറ്റെടുത്തവൻ.

english_name.name: Ar-Razzāq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Razzāq (The All-Provider) is the One Who guarantees His servants the sustenance that maintains their hearts and bodies.

translations.name: അൽ-ഫത്താഹ് (വിധികർത്താവ്)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഫത്താഹ്: തൻ്റെ അടിമകൾക്കിടയിൽ മതപരമായ നിയമങ്ങൾ കൊണ്ട് വിധിക്കുകയും, അവർക്കിടയിൽ അവൻ്റെ പ്രാപഞ്ചിക വിധികൾ നടപ്പിലാക്കുകയും, അവൻ നിശ്ചയിച്ച പ്രതിഫലത്തിൻ്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനത്തിൽ അവർക്കിടയിൽ വിചാരണ നടത്തുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Fattāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Fattāh (The Greatest Judge) is the One Who judges between His servants by His religious rulings, decrees His predestination for them, and calls them to account.

translations.name: അൽ-അലീം (സർവ്വതും അറിയുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-അലീം: എല്ലാത്തിനെയും തൻ്റെ അറിവ് കൊണ്ട് ചൂഴ്ന്നിരിക്കുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-‘Alīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alīm (The All-Knowing) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses everything.

english_name.name: Al-Qaabid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE RESTRICTING ONE

The Constrictor, The Withholder, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Baasit
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE EXTENDER

The Englarger, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Khaafid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE REDUCER

The One who lowers whoever He willed by His Destruction and raises whoever He willed by His Endowment.

translations.name: അർ-റാഫിഅ് (ഉയർത്തുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അർ-റാഫിഅ്: ഉദ്ദേശിക്കുന്നവർക്ക് ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്ന രൂപത്തിൽ ഉയർച്ച നൽകുന്നവൻ. ഇഹലോകത്തും പരലോകത്തും അവൻ്റെ ഇഷ്ടദാസന്മാർക്ക് ഉയർച്ച നൽകുന്നത് ഉദാഹരണം.

english_name.name: Ar-Rāfi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Rāfi‘ (The Raiser) is the One Who raises whomever He wills the way He wills, as He elevates the ranks of His pious servants in this world and in the Hereafter.

translations.name: അസ്സമീഅ് (എല്ലാം കേൾക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അസ്സമീഅ്: എല്ലാ ശബ്ദശകലങ്ങളും കേൾക്കുന്നവൻ. അവൻ രഹസ്യവും പരസ്യവും കേൾക്കുന്നു. ശബ്ദം ഉയർത്തുന്നതും താഴ്ത്തുന്നതും അവൻ്റെ അടുക്കൽ സമമത്രെ. സംസാരിക്കുന്നതും നിശബ്ദത പാലിക്കുന്നതും അവന് ഒരു പോലെ തന്നെ.

english_name.name: As-Samī‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samī‘ (The All-Hearing) is the One Who hears everything. He hears secret and private talk. Loud and low voices, and speaking and silence are all the same to Him - He grasps all.

translations.name: അൽ-ബസ്വീർ (എല്ലാം കാണുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ബസ്വീർ: എല്ലാ വസ്തുക്കളെയും - അവ എത്ര സൂക്ഷ്മമോ ചെറുതോ ആകട്ടെ; അവയെ എല്ലാം - തൻ്റെ കാഴ്ച കൊണ്ട് വലയം ചെയ്തവൻ. കാര്യങ്ങളെ കുറിച്ച് ഉൾക്കാഴ്ചയും, സൂക്ഷ്മമായ ജ്ഞാനവും, അവയുടെ ഉള്ളകങ്ങളെ കുറിച്ചുള്ള അറിവും ഉള്ളവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Basīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Basīr (The All-Seeing) is the One Whose sight encompasses everything, no matter how small or minute they may be, and He is the One Who is All-Aware of everything and All-Knowing of their hidden aspects.

translations.name: അൽ-ഹകം (വിധികർത്താവ്)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഹകം: സർവ്വ വിഷയങ്ങളിലും വിധികർതൃത്വത്തിന് അവകാശമുള്ളവൻ. അവൻ ഉദ്ദേശിക്കുന്നത് വിധിക്കുകയും, തൻ്റെ അടിമകൾക്കിടയിൽ നീതിയോടെയും സത്യപ്രകാരവും വിധി നടപ്പിലാക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.

english_name.name: Al-Hakam
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakam (The Judge) is the One to Whom belongs judgment in all things, and Who ordains what He wills and judges between His servants with the truth and justice.

translations.name: അല്ലത്വീഫ് (അതീവ സൂക്ഷ്മജ്ഞാനി)
translations.short_meaning_val: അല്ലത്വീഫ്: എത്ര ചെറുതോ സൂക്ഷ്മമോ ആയാലും അവയൊന്നും അവ്യക്തമായി തീരാത്തവൻ. തൻ്റെ അടിമകളോട് അനുകമ്പ പുലർത്തിയും, അവർക്ക് പ്രയോജനകരമായതിലേക്ക് അവർക്ക് സൗകര്യം ചെയ്തു നൽകിക്കൊണ്ടും അവരോട് നന്മ കാണിക്കുന്നവനും.

english_name.name: Al-Latīf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Latīf (The All-Subtle) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, no matter how small it may be, and the One Who shows kindness and leniency to His servants and guides them to what is good for them.

translations.name: അൽ-ഖബീർ (സൂക്ഷ്മജ്ഞാനി)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഖബീർ: എല്ലാ വസ്തുക്കളെയും കുറിച്ചുള്ള പ്രത്യക്ഷവിവരങ്ങൾ അറിഞ്ഞതു പോലെ തന്നെ, അവയുടെ ഉള്ളറകളും അതീവസൂക്ഷ്മ വിവരങ്ങളും ചൂഴ്ന്നറിഞ്ഞവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Khabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khabīr (The All-Aware) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses the inward and hidden aspects of things, as well as their outward aspects.

translations.name: അൽ-ഹലീം (അങ്ങേയറ്റം സഹനശീലമുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഹലീം: തൻ്റെ അടിമകളുടെ തെറ്റുകൾക്ക് ഉടനടി ശിക്ഷ നൽകാതെ, അവധാനത പുലർത്തുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Halīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Halīm (The Forbearing) is the One Who possesses deliberation and does not hasten to punish His servants for their sins.

translations.name: അൽ-അദ്വീം (സർവ്വ മഹത്വവുമുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-അദ്വീം: പൂർണ്ണതയുടെയും മഹത്വത്തിൻ്റെയും പ്രൗഢിയുടെയും ആദരവിൻ്റെയും സർവ്വവിശേഷണങ്ങളും ഒരുമിച്ചവൻ. ഹൃദയങ്ങൾ അവനെ സ്നേഹിക്കുകയും, മനസ്സുകൾ അവനെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.

english_name.name: Al-‘Azhīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azhīm (The Magnificent) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection, glory, pride, and majesty, and Who is loved and extolled by His servants.

translations.name: അൽ-ഗഫൂർ (അങ്ങേയറ്റം പൊറുത്തു കൊടുക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഗഫൂർ: തൻ്റെ അടിമകളെ അവർ ചെയ്ത തിന്മകളുടെ ദുഷ്ഫലങ്ങളിൽ നിന്ന് കാത്തുരക്ഷിക്കുന്നവനും, അവരെ അതിൻ്റെ പേരിൽ ശിക്ഷിക്കാതെ (പൊറുത്തു കൊടുക്കുന്നവനും).

english_name.name: Al-Ghafūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ghafūr (The All-Forgiving) is the One Who spares His servants the evil of their sins and does not punish them.

translations.name: അശ്ശകൂർ (നന്ദിയുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അശ്ശകൂർ: കുറഞ്ഞ പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങൾക്ക് ഇരട്ടിയിരട്ടിയായി ധാരാളം പ്രതിഫലം നൽകി നന്ദികാണിക്കുന്നവനും, ധാരാളം വരുന്ന തെറ്റുകൾ വിട്ടുപൊറുത്തു കൊടുക്കുന്നവനും.

english_name.name: Ash-Shakūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shakūr (The Most Appreciative) is the One Who appreciates even little deeds and gives immense and multiple rewards in return, and Who forgives numerous errors.

translations.name: അൽ-അലിയ്യ് (സർവ്വോന്നതൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-അലിയ്യ്: എല്ലാ നിലക്കും സർവ്വ ഔന്നത്യവുമുള്ളവൻ. (അല്ലാഹു എല്ലാത്തിനും മുകളിലാണ് എന്ന) അസ്തിത്വപരമായ ഔന്നത്യവും, (എല്ലാ വിശേഷണങ്ങളിലും അവൻ ഏറ്റവും മുകളിലാണ് എന്നറിയിക്കുന്ന) മഹത്വങ്ങളിലുള്ള ഔന്നത്യവും, (എല്ലാവരും അല്ലാഹുവിൻ്റെ അധീശത്വത്തിന് കീഴിലാണെന്ന് അറിയിക്കുന്ന) അധികാരത്തിൻ്റെ ഔന്നത്യവും ഉള്ളവനാണവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-‘Alyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alyy (The High) is the One Who possesses absolute highness in all aspects: His status, His power, and His essence.

translations.name: അൽ-കബീർ (ഏറ്റവും വലിയവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-കബീർ: ഏറ്റവും വലിയവൻ. മറ്റെല്ലാം അവൻ്റെ താഴെയാണ്. അവനെക്കാൾ വലിയ ഒന്നും തന്നെയില്ല.

english_name.name: Al-Kabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kabīr (The Great) is the One Who is greater than everything, and all else are inferior to Him.

translations.name: അൽ-ഹഫീദ്വ് (സർവ്വതിൻ്റെയും സംരക്ഷകൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഹഫീദ്വ്: താൻ സൃഷ്ടിച്ച സർവ്വതിനെയും സംരക്ഷിക്കുന്നവൻ. അവയെ എല്ലാം തൻ്റെ അറിവ് കൊണ്ട് ചൂഴ്ന്നവൻ. തൻ്റെ ഇഷ്ടദാസന്മാരെ തിന്മകളിലും നാശങ്ങളിലും വീണുപോകുന്നതിൽ നിന്ന് സംരക്ഷിക്കുന്നവൻ. തൻ്റെ ദാസന്മാരുടെ പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങളും അവരുടെ പ്രതിഫലവും തിട്ടപ്പെടുത്തിയവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Hafīzh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hafīzh (The All-Preserver) is the One Who preserves what He created; Whose knowledge encompasses all that He brought into existence; Who protects His pious servants from committing sins and ruinous acts; and Who records their deeds and the recompense for them.

translations.name: അൽ-മുഖീത് (ഉപജീവനം നിയന്ത്രിക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുഖീത്: സൃഷ്ടികളുടെ ഉപജീവനം തൻ്റെ അറിവിൻ്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനത്തിൽ നിശ്ചയിക്കുകയും, ശേഷം ആ ഉപജീവനം തൻ്റെ ശക്തി കൊണ്ട് അവർക്ക് എത്തിച്ചു കൊടുക്കുകയും, അവർക്കിടയിൽ വീതംവെക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Muqīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqīt (The All-Nourisher) is the One Who determines the sustenance of His creation according to His knowledge, brings it to them with His power, and distributes it amongst them.

translations.name: അൽ-ഹസീബ് (വിചാരണ നടത്തുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഹസീബ്: തന്നിൽ ഭരമേൽപ്പിച്ച വിശ്വാസികളായ ദാസന്മാർക്ക് വേണ്ടതെല്ലാം നൽകുന്നവൻ. തൻ്റെ ദാസന്മാരുടെ പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങളെ നന്നായി അറിയുകയും, അവയെല്ലാം വിചാരണ നടത്തുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Hasīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hasīb (The Ever-Reckoner) is the One Who grants sufficiency to His believing servants who rely upon Him, and Who knows their deeds and holds them accountable for them.

translations.name: അൽ-കരീം (മഹാഔദാര്യവാൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-കരീം: ധാരാളം നന്മകൾ ചൊരിയുന്ന, മഹത്തരമായ ഉപകാരങ്ങൾ നൽകുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Karīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Karīm (The Generous) is the One Who gives abundant good and welfare.

translations.name: അർ-റഖീബ് (സൂക്ഷ്മമായി നിരീക്ഷിക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അർ-റഖീബ്: സർവ്വതും അറിയുകയും, രഹസ്യങ്ങൾക്കും മനസ്സിൻ്റെ ഉള്ളറകൾക്കും സാക്ഷിയാവുകയും, സ്വകാര്യങ്ങളും രഹസ്യസംസാരങ്ങളും അറിയുകയും കാണുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Ar-Raqīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Raqīb (The Ever-Watchful) is the One Who watches over everything and witnesses inner thoughts and secrets, and Who knows and sees all things and no secret or private talk is hidden from Him.

translations.name: അൽ-മുജീബ് (ഉത്തരം നൽകുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുജീബ്: ചോദിക്കുന്നവരുടെ തേട്ടങ്ങളും പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കുന്നവരുടെ പ്രാർത്ഥനകളും സ്വീകരിക്കുകയും അവക്ക് ഉത്തരം നൽകുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Mujīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mujīb (The All-Responsive) is the One Who responds to supplications by answering them and to requests by fulfilling them.

translations.name: അൽ-വാസിഅ്: (സമ്പൂർണ്ണ വിശാലതയുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-വാസിഅ്: എല്ലാ വിശേഷണങ്ങളിലും അങ്ങേയറ്റത്തെ പരിപൂർണ്ണതയും ഏറ്റവും ഉന്നതമായ സ്ഥാനവും ഉള്ളവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Wāsi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāsi‘ (The All-Embracing) is the One to Whom belongs the most perfect and complete meaning of every attribute.

translations.name: അൽ-ഹകീം (മഹായുക്തിമാൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഹകീം: സർവ്വതും ഏറ്റവും യുക്തമായി പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നവൻ. അവൻ്റെ കൽപ്പനകളും, മതനിയമങ്ങളും പരിപൂർണ്ണമായും യുക്തമാണ്. അവൻ്റെ സൃഷ്ടികൾക്കിടയിൽ പൂർണ്ണ വിധിനിർണ്ണയവും അവൻ്റേത് തന്നെയാണ്.

english_name.name: Al-Hakīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakīm (The All-Wise) is the One Who possesses perfect wisdom in His commands and legislations, and perfect judgment between His creation.

translations.name: അൽ-വദൂദ് (അങ്ങേയറ്റം സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-വദൂദ്: സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നവനും സ്നേഹിക്കപ്പെടുന്നവനും എന്നർത്ഥം. തൻ്റെ ദൂതന്മാരെയും നബിമാരെയും അവരെ പിൻപറ്റിയവരെയും അല്ലാഹു ധാരാളമായി സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നു. അവർ അവനെയും സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നു.

english_name.name: Al-Wadūd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wadūd (The Most Affectionate) is the One Who loves and is loved. He loves His prophets and messengers and their followers, and they love Him.

translations.name: അൽ-മജീദ് (മഹാപ്രതാപശാലി)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മജീദ്: സമ്പൂർണ്ണത അറിയിക്കുന്ന, മഹത്വത്തിൻ്റെ അനേകം വിശേഷണങ്ങളുള്ളവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Majīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Majīd (The Most Glorious) is the One Who possesses the various attributes of supreme majesty and perfection.

translations.name: അശ്ശഹീദ് (സർവ്വതിനും സാക്ഷിയാകുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അശ്ശഹീദ്: ഒരു കാര്യവും മറഞ്ഞു പോകാതെ, എല്ലാം കാണുന്നവനും, എല്ലാത്തിനും സാക്ഷ്യം വഹിക്കുന്നവനും, സർവ്വതിൻ്റെയും വിശദാംശങ്ങൾ നന്നായി അറിയുന്നവനും.

english_name.name: Ash-Shahīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shahīd (The Ever-Witness) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, rather He knows and witnesses everything and is Aware of its details.

translations.name: അൽ-ഹഖ് (സത്യമായുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഹഖ്: സംശയമില്ലാത്ത വിധം അസ്തിത്വം സ്ഥിരപ്പെട്ടവൻ. അവനുണ്ട് എന്നതിൽ യാതൊരു സംശയവുമില്ല. അവൻ്റെ നാമങ്ങളും വിശേഷണങ്ങളും പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങളും വിധികളും പ്രതിഫലവുമെല്ലാം പരിപൂർണ്ണവും സത്യവുമാണ്. അതിലൊന്നും യാതൊരു അസത്യവുമില്ല.

english_name.name: Al-Haqq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Haqq (The Truth) is the True One in terms of His being and His existence; and the One Whose names, attributes, actions, judgments, and recompense are all perfect and true.

translations.name: അൽ-വകീൽ (സർവ്വരെയും ഏറ്റെടുത്തവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-വകീൽ: തൻ്റെ സൃഷ്ടികളുടെ ഉപജീവനം ഏറ്റെടുക്കുകയും, അവർക്ക് പ്രയോജനകരമായത് നിലനിർത്തുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ. തൻ്റെ ഇഷ്ടദാസന്മാരെ ഏറ്റെടുക്കുകയും, അവർക്ക് എളുപ്പമുള്ളതിലേക്ക് സൗകര്യം ചെയ്യുകയും, പ്രയാസങ്ങളിൽ നിന്ന് അവരെ അകറ്റുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ. എല്ലാ കാര്യങ്ങളിലും അവൻ അവർക്ക് മതിയാകുന്നതാണ്.

english_name.name: Al-Wakīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wakīl (The Trustee) is the One Who guarantees the sustenance of His creation and manages their affairs and maintains their welfare; and Who supports His pious servants and, thus, guides them to ease, grants them sufficiency, and keeps them away from difficulty.

translations.name: അൽ-ഖവിയ്യ് (അതിശക്തൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഖവിയ്യ്: ഒരാൾക്കും പരാജയപ്പെടുത്തുക സാധ്യമല്ലാത്ത പരിപൂർണ്ണ ശക്തിയുള്ളവൻ. അവൻ്റെ തീരുമാനത്തെ തടുക്കാൻ ആർക്കും സാധ്യമല്ല.

english_name.name: Al-Qawiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qawiyy (The All-Powerful) is the One with complete power Who cannot be overcome and Whose predestination cannot be repelled.

translations.name: അൽ-മതീൻ (സർവ്വശക്തൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മതീൻ: അങ്ങേയറ്റം ശക്തിയും കഴിവുമുള്ളവൻ. അവന് ഒരിക്കലും ദുർബലതയോ പ്രയാസമോ ബാധിക്കുകയില്ല.

english_name.name: Al-Matīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Matīn (The Most Firm) is the One Who possesses infinite power and ability so He never experiences any weakness or hardship.

translations.name: അൽ-വലിയ്യ് (സഹായിക്കുന്ന ഏകഒരുവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-വലിയ്യ്: തൻ്റെ വിശ്വാസികളായ ദാസന്മാരെ സഹായിക്കുകയും, സർവ്വ സൃഷ്ടികളുടെയും കാര്യങ്ങൾ നിർവ്വഹിച്ചു നൽകുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Walyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Walyy (The Guardian) is the One Who supports His believing servants and manages the affairs of all His creation.

translations.name: അൽ-ഹമീദ് (സ്തുത്യർഹൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഹമീദ്: സർവ്വ സ്തുതികളും പൂർണ്ണതകളും അല്ലാഹുവിനാണെന്ന് അറിയിക്കുന്ന നാമമാണ് ഹമീദ്. അവൻ്റെ അസ്തിത്വത്തിലും നാമങ്ങളിലും വിശേഷണങ്ങളിലും പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങളിലുമെല്ലാം പരിപൂർണ്ണനായതിനാൽ സർവ്വ സ്തുതികൾക്കും അർഹതയുള്ളവനാകുന്നു അവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Hamīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hamīd (The Praiseworthy) is a name that denotes all the praiseworthy and perfect attributes of Allah Almighty, Who deserves praise for the perfection of His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: അൽ-ഹയ്യ് (എന്നെന്നും ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഹയ്യ്: പരിപൂർണ്ണ ജീവിതത്തിൻ്റെ എല്ലാ അർത്ഥതലങ്ങളും ഉള്ളവൻ. അവൻ മുൻപ് ജീവൻ ഇല്ലാതിരുന്നവനോ, ഇനിയെന്നെങ്കിലും ജീവൻ നഷ്ടപ്പെടുന്നവനോ അല്ല.

english_name.name: Al-Hayy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayy (The Ever-Living) is the One to Whom belong all meanings of perfect life that is not preceded by nothingness nor followed by doom.

translations.name: അൽ-ഖയ്യൂം (സർവ്വനിയന്താവ്)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഖയ്യൂം: സ്വയം നിലനിൽക്കുന്നവൻ; അവന് നിലനിൽക്കുവാൻ ആരുടെയും ആവശ്യമില്ല. എല്ലാ വസ്തുക്കളും അവനെ കൊണ്ടാണ് നിലനിൽക്കുന്നത്; ഒരാൾക്കും അവൻ്റെ സഹായം കൂടാതെ കഴിയില്ല.

english_name.name: Al-Qayyūm
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Qayyūm (The Self-Subsisting) is the One Who is self-sustaining, so He does not need anyone, and everything depends on Him and none can dispense with Him.

translations.name: അൽ-വാഹിദ് (ഏകൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-വാഹിദ്: അസ്തിത്വത്തിലും വിശേഷണങ്ങളിലും പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങളിലുമെല്ലാം ഏകനായുള്ളവൻ. അവയിലൊന്നും ഒരു പങ്കാളിയും അവനില്ല.

english_name.name: Al-Wāhid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāhid (The One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His essence, attributes, and actions, and none shares any of this with Him.

translations.name: അസ്സ്വമദ് (സർവ്വരുടെയും ആശ്രയമായ പരാശ്രയമുക്തൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അസ്സ്വമദ്: പരിപൂർണ്ണനായ രക്ഷാധികാരിയും, അത്യാദരണീയനായ ആശ്രയവും. പ്രതീക്ഷയോടും ഭയത്തോടും കൂടെ എല്ലാ ആവശ്യങ്ങളും അവങ്കലേക്കത്രെ ഉയർത്തപ്പെടുന്നത്.

english_name.name: As-Samad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samad (The Eternal Refuge) is the Perfect Lord and the Magnificent Master to Whom everyone turns, out of hope and fear.

translations.name: അൽ-ഖാദിർ (അങ്ങേയറ്റം ശക്തിയുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഖാദിർ: പരിപൂർണ്ണവും വിശാലവുമായ ശക്തിയുള്ളവൻ. യാതൊരു കാര്യവും അവന് അസാധ്യമല്ല. അവൻ്റെ ഒരു ലക്ഷ്യവും നടപ്പാകാതെ പോവുകയുമില്ല.

english_name.name: Al-Qādir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qādir (The Able) is the One Who possesses complete and comprehensive power, nothing can challenge Him, and none can escape His power or will.

translations.name: അൽ-മുഖ്തദിർ (എല്ലാത്തിനും കഴിയുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുഖ്തദിർ: ഒരു കാര്യവും അസാധ്യമാകാത്ത തരത്തിലുള്ള പരിപൂർണ്ണ ശക്തിയുള്ളവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Muqtadir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqtadir (The Dominant) is the One Who possesses complete unopposed power.

translations.name: അൽ-മുഖദ്ദിം (മുന്തിക്കേണ്ടതിനെ മുന്തിക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുഖദ്ദിം: ഓരോന്നിനെയും അർഹമായ സ്ഥാനത്ത് നിശ്ചയിക്കുകയും, അവയിൽ മുന്തിക്കേണ്ടതിനെ മുന്തിക്കുകയും, പിന്തിക്കേണ്ടതിനെ പിന്തിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Muqaddim
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqaddim (The Advancer) is the One Who puts things in their due places, advancing what He wills and delaying what He wills.

translations.name: അൽ-മുഅഖ്ഖിർ (പിന്തിക്കേണ്ടതിനെ പിന്തിക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുഅഖ്ഖിർ: പിന്തിക്കാൻ അർഹതപ്പെട്ടതിനെ പിന്തിക്കുകയും, അവയുടെ സ്ഥാനത്ത് നിശ്ചയിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Mu’akhkhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu’akhkhir (The Delayer) is the One Who delays things that should be delayed, thus putting them in their proper place.

translations.name: അൽ-അവ്വൽ (ഒന്നാമതുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അല്ലാഹുവിന് മുൻപ് എന്തെങ്കിലും ഉണ്ടാവുക എന്നത് ഇല്ലാത്ത നിലയിൽ (ആരംഭമില്ലാതെ) എന്നേ ഉള്ളവനാണ് അല്ലാഹു.

english_name.name: Al-Awwal
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Awwal (The First) is the One before Whom there was nothing.

translations.name: അൽ-ആഖിർ (എന്നെന്നും ഉള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അല്ലാഹുവിന് ശേഷം ഒരാളുണ്ടാവുക എന്നതുണ്ടാകാത്ത നിലയിൽ, (അവസാനമില്ലാത്ത) എന്നെന്നും ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കുന്നവനാണ് അല്ലാഹു.

english_name.name: Al-Ākhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ākhir (The Last) is the One after Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: അദ്ദ്വാഹിർ (ഏറ്റവും മുകളിലുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അദ്ദ്വാഹിർ: ഏറ്റവും മുകളിലുള്ളവൻ; അവൻ്റെ മുകളിൽ മറ്റാരും തന്നെയില്ല.

english_name.name: Azh-Zhāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Azh-Zhāhir (The Manifest) is the One above Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: അൽ-ബാത്വിൻ: (ഏറ്റവും അടുത്തുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ബാത്വിൻ: അവനേക്കാൾ അടുത്തായി ഒരാളുമില്ലാത്തവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Bātin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Bātin (The Hidden) is the One beneath Whom there is nothing.

translations.name: അൽ-മുതആൽ (ഏറ്റവും മുകളിലുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുതആൽ: എല്ലാ നിലക്കും നിരുപാധികമായ സർവ്വോന്നതിയുള്ളവനാണ് അല്ലാഹു എന്നറിയിക്കുന്ന നാമം. (അല്ലാഹു എല്ലാത്തിനും മുകളിലാണ് എന്ന) അസ്തിത്വപരമായ ഔന്നത്യവും, (എല്ലാ വിശേഷണങ്ങളിലും അവൻ ഏറ്റവും മുകളിലാണ് എന്നറിയിക്കുന്ന) മഹത്വങ്ങളിലുള്ള ഔന്നത്യവും, (എല്ലാവരും അല്ലാഹുവിൻ്റെ അധീശത്വത്തിന് കീഴിലാണെന്ന് അറിയിക്കുന്ന) അധികാരത്തിൻ്റെ ഔന്നത്യവും ഉള്ളവനാണവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Muta‘āl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muta‘āl (The Exalted) is a name that denotes the absolute exaltation of Allah in all aspects: His essence, His status, and His power.

translations.name: അൽ-ബർറ്: (മഹാഔദാര്യവാൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ബർറ്: അടിമകൾക്ക് മേൽ വ്യത്യസ്ത തരം അനുഗ്രഹങ്ങൾ ചൊരിഞ്ഞു കൊണ്ട് അവരോട് നന്മ ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Barr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Barr (The Beneficent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of blessings upon His servants.

translations.name: അത്തവ്വാബ് (അങ്ങേയറ്റം പശ്ചാത്താപം സ്വീകരിക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അത്തവ്വാബ്: തൻ്റെ അടിമക്ക് പശ്ചാത്താപത്തിന് വഴിയൊരുക്കുകയും, അവനിൽ നിന്ന് അവൻ്റെ പശ്ചാത്താപം സ്വീകരിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: At-Tawwāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tawwāb (The Accepting of Repentance) is the One Who guides His servants to repentance and accepts it from them.

translations.name: അൽ-അഫുവ്വ് (അങ്ങേയറ്റം പൊറുത്തു കൊടുക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-അഫുവ്വ്: തിന്മകൾ മായ്ച്ചു കളയുകയും, തെറ്റുകൾ വിട്ടുപൊറുത്തു കൊടുക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-‘Afuww
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Afuww (The Pardoner) is the One Who erases misdeeds and pardons sins.

translations.name: അർ-റഊഫ് (മഹാദയയുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അർ-റഊഫ്: തൻ്റെ അടിമകളോട് അങ്ങേയറ്റം ദയയുള്ളവനും, അവരോട് കാരുണ്യമുള്ളവനും.

english_name.name: Ar-Ra’ūf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Ra’ūf (The All-Kind) is the One Who is the most kind and merciful towards His creation.

english_name.name: Maalik-Ul-Mulk
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE ETERNAL POSSESSOR OF SOVEREIGNTY

The One who controls the Dominion and gives dominion to whoever He willed.

translations.name: ദുൽ ജലാലി വൽ ഇക്റാം (മഹത്വവും ആദരവും ഉടയവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: ദുൽ ജലാലി വൽ ഇക്റാം: മഹത്വത്തിൻ്റെയും പ്രൗഢിയുടെയും കാരുണ്യത്തിൻ്റെയും ഉദാരതയുടെയും വിശേഷണങ്ങളുള്ളവൻ. ആദരിക്കപ്പെടാനും സ്തുതിക്കപ്പെടാനും അർഹതയുള്ളവൻ.

english_name.name: Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Dhul-Jalāl wa al-Ikrām (Lord of Majesty and Bounty) is the Possessor of greatness, pride, mercy, and bounty, Who deserves glorification and praise.

translations.name: അൽ-ഗനിയ്യ് (സമ്പൂർണ്ണ ധന്യതയുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഗനിയ്യ്: എല്ലാവർക്കും ആശ്രയമായ, ഒരാളുടെയും സഹായം ആവശ്യമില്ലാത്തവൻ.

english_name.name: A-Ghanyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿A-Ghanyy (The Self-Sufficient) is the One Who is needed by all and Who does not need anyone.

translations.name: അൽ-ഹാദീ (സന്മാർഗത്തിലേക്ക് നയിക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഹാദീ: തൻ്റെ അടിമകളെ എല്ലാ നന്മകളിലേക്കും വഴിനയിക്കുകയും, ഉപദ്രവങ്ങളിൽ അവരിൽ നിന്ന് തടുത്തു വെക്കുകയും, അവരിൽ അല്ലാഹു ഉദ്ദേശിക്കുന്നവർക്ക് സന്മാർഗം സ്വീകരിക്കാൻ സൗകര്യപ്പെടുത്തുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Hādi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hādi (The Guide) is the One Who guides His servants to all beneficial things and leads them away from harmful ones, and Who leads whomever He wills to guidance.

translations.name: അൽ-വാരിഥ് (അനന്തരമെടുക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-വാരിഥ്: സൃഷ്ടികളെല്ലാം നശിച്ചതിന് ശേഷവും എന്നെന്നും നിലനിൽക്കുന്ന, ഭൂമിയെയും അതിലുള്ളതിനെയുമെല്ലാം അനന്തരമെടുക്കുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Wārith
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wārith (The Inheritor) is the One Who lasts after the doom of all creation and Who inherits the earth and all that is in it.

translations.name: അൽ-ജമീൽ (അങ്ങേയറ്റം ഭംഗിയുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ജമീൽ: തൻ്റെ അസ്തിത്വത്തിലും നാമങ്ങളിലും വിശേഷണങ്ങളിലും പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങളിലുമെല്ലാം സർവ്വ മനോഹാരിതയും ഉള്ളവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Jamīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jamīl (The Beautiful) is the One Who possesses absolute beauty in His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: അൽ-ഖാഹിർ (സർവ്വതിനെയും വിജയിച്ചടക്കിയവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഖാഹിർ: സർവ്വവസ്തുക്കളും കീഴൊതുങ്ങുകയും, എല്ലാ സൃഷ്ടികളും വണങ്ങുകയും ചെയ്തിട്ടുള്ളവൻ. അവയെല്ലാം അവൻ്റെ ശക്തിയെയും ഉദ്ദേശത്തെയും അനുസരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.

english_name.name: Al-Qāhir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qāhir (The Vanquisher) is the One to Whom all beings submit and before Whose power and will all beings stand humbly.

translations.name: അൽ-ഖരീബ് (സമീപസ്ഥൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഖരീബ്: അല്ലാഹുവിനെ അനുസരിക്കുന്നവർക്ക് പ്രതിഫലം നൽകിക്കൊണ്ടും, അവനോട് പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കുന്നവർക്ക് ഉത്തരം നൽകിക്കൊണ്ടും അവരുടെ അടുത്തുള്ളവൻ. ഇതൊന്നും അവൻ്റെ പരിപൂർണ്ണമായ ഔന്നത്യത്തിന് വിരുദ്ധമല്ല.

english_name.name: Al-Qarīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qarīb (The Near) is the One Who is near His obedient servants with reward; near those who supplicate Him with the answer; and near the rest of His servants with knowledge. This does not contradict His being high above.

translations.name: അർ-റബ്ബ് (സർവ്വതിൻ്റെയും രക്ഷിതാവ്)
translations.short_meaning_val: അർ-റബ്ബ്: എല്ലാവരുടെയും യജമാനനും ഉടമസ്ഥനും അവരെ നന്നാക്കുന്നവനും. തൻ്റെ അടിമകളെ നിയന്ത്രിച്ചു കൊണ്ടും, അവർക്ക് വ്യത്യസ്തങ്ങളായ അനുഗ്രഹങ്ങൾ നൽകിക്കൊണ്ടും പടിപടിയായി വളർത്തിക്കൊണ്ടു വരുന്നവനും അവൻ തന്നെ.

english_name.name: Ar-Rabb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rabb (The Lord) is the Master, the Owner, the Reformer, and the One Who fosters His servants by managing their affairs and bestowing favors upon them.

translations.name: അൽ-മുബീൻ (സുവ്യക്തതയുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുബീൻ: എല്ലാ നിലക്കും ഏകനാണെന്നും, യാതൊരു പങ്കുകാരനും ഇല്ലെന്നുമുള്ള അല്ലാഹുവിൻ്റെ വിശേഷണത്തിൻ്റെ വ്യക്തതയെ അറിയിക്കുന്നു ഈ നാമം. തൻ്റെ അടിമകൾക്ക് സത്യം വ്യക്തമാക്കി നൽകുന്നവൻ എന്ന അർത്ഥവുമുണ്ട്.

english_name.name: Al-Mubīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mubīn (The Evident) is the One Who is evident in His Oneness and that He has no partner, and Who clarifies the truth to His servants.

translations.name: അൽ-മുഅ്ത്വി: (ധാരാളമായി നൽകുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുഅ്ത്വി: യഥാർത്ഥത്തിൽ ഉപകാരങ്ങൾ നൽകാൻ കഴിയുന്ന ഒരേയൊരുവൻ. അവൻ നൽകിയത് തടയാനോ, അവൻ തടഞ്ഞത് നൽകാനോ ആരും തന്നെയില്ല.

english_name.name: Al-Mu‘ti
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mu‘ti (The Giver) is the only One Who gives, and no one can withhold what He has given or give what He has withheld.

translations.name: അൽ-കാഫീ (മതിവരുവോളം നൽകുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-കാഫീ: തൻ്റെ അടിമകൾക്ക് ആവശ്യമായതെല്ലാം മതിവരുവോളം നൽകുന്നവൻ. മറ്റാരുടെയും സഹായമില്ലെങ്കിലും അവൻ്റെ സഹായം മാത്രം മതി. അവനുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ മറ്റെല്ലാവരിൽ നിന്നും (അടിമകൾ) ധന്യരാകുന്നു.

english_name.name: Al-Kāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kāfi (The All-Sufficient) is the One Who fulfills all the needs of His servants and Who is sufficient for them beyond need for anyone else.

translations.name: അൽ-വിത്ർ (ഒറ്റയായുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-വിത്ർ: ഒരു പങ്കാളിയോ തുല്ല്യനോ ഇല്ലാത്ത ഏകനും ഒറ്റയുമായവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Witr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Witr (The Odd) is the One Who has no partner or equal.

translations.name: അൽ-അഹദ് (ഏകൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-അഹദ്: സൃഷ്ടികർതൃത്വത്തിലും ആരാധ്യതയിലും നാമങ്ങളിലും വിശേഷണങ്ങളിലുമുള്ള എല്ലാ പൂർണ്ണതകളിലും ഏകനായവൻ. അവയിലൊന്നും യാതൊരു നിലക്കുമുള്ള പങ്കാളിയും അവനില്ല.

english_name.name: Al-Ahad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ahad (The Only One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His lordship, divinity, names, and attributes, and none shares any of them with Him.

translations.name: അൽ-ജവാദ് (അങ്ങേയറ്റം ദാനം നൽകുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ജവാദ്: ധാരാളമായി അനുഗ്രഹങ്ങൾ നൽകുന്നവൻ; അവൻ്റെ അനുഗ്രഹങ്ങൾ സർവ്വ ലോകങ്ങളെയും പൊതിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.

english_name.name: Al-Jawād
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jawād (The Munificent) is the One Who gives abundantly to all creatures.

translations.name: അർ-റഫീഖ് (അങ്ങേയറ്റം അവധാനതയുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അർ-റഫീഖ്: കാര്യങ്ങളിൽ അവധാനത പുലർത്തുകയും, ധിക്കാരികളെ ഉടനടി ശിക്ഷിക്കാതെ കാര്യങ്ങൾ ക്രമേണയായി നിർവ്വഹിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Ar-Rafīq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Rafīq (The Kind) is the One Who acts deliberately and gradually, and does not hasten to punish sinners.

translations.name: അസ്സയ്യിദ് (ഏവരുടെയും ആശ്രയം)
translations.short_meaning_val: അസ്സയ്യിദ്: രക്ഷിതാവും ഉടമസ്ഥനുമായവൻ. ഏവരുടെയും യഥാർഥ ആശ്രയം അവനാണ്. ഐഹികമോ പാരത്രികമോ ആയ ഏതൊരു കാര്യത്തിലും സർവ്വരും അവൻ്റെ അടുക്കലേക്കാണ് മടങ്ങിച്ചെല്ലുന്നത്.

english_name.name: As-Sayyid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Sayyid (The Master) is the Lord and the Owner, the One Who possesses true dominance, and to Whom all creation turns for their worldly and their Hereafter affairs.

translations.name: അസ്സുബ്ബൂഹ് (മഹാപരിശുദ്ധൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അസ്സുബ്ബൂഹ്: സർവ്വ കുറവുകളിൽ നിന്നും ന്യൂനതകളിൽ നിന്നും (സൃഷ്ടികളുടെ സ്തുതികീർത്തനങ്ങളിൽ) പരിശുദ്ധപ്പെടുത്തപ്പെടുന്ന, ആകാശങ്ങളിലും ഭൂമിയിലുമുള്ള സർവ്വരും സ്തുതിക്കുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: As-Subbūh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Subbūh (The All-Glorious) is the One far exalted above deficiencies and defects and Who is extolled and glorified by all those in the heavens and the earth.

translations.name: അശ്ശാഫീ (ശമനം നൽകുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അശ്ശാഫീ: ശരീരത്തിൻ്റെ രോഗങ്ങളും, ഹൃദയത്തിലെ സംശയങ്ങളും, മനസ്സുകളിലെ മോശമായ ദേഹേഛകളും സുഖപ്പെടുത്തുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Ash-Shāfi
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shāfi (The Healer) is the One Who cures His servants from the illnesses of their bodies, the doubts of their hearts, and the vain desires of their selves.

translations.name: അശ്ശാകിർ (അങ്ങേയറ്റം നന്ദി ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അശ്ശാകിർ: തന്നെ അനുസരിക്കുന്നവരെ പ്രശംസിക്കുകയും, അവരെ പുകഴ്ത്തുകയും, അവരുടെ നന്മകൾക്ക് അതിന് അർഹമായതിനെക്കാൾ എത്രയോ വലിയ പ്രതിഫലം നൽകുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Ash-Shākir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shākir (The Appreciative) is the One Who praises those who obey Him and rewards them beyond what is due to them.

translations.name: അത്ത്വയ്യിബ്
translations.short_meaning_val: അത്ത്വയ്യിബ്: സർവ്വ ന്യൂനതകളിൽ നിന്നും കുറവുകളിൽ നിന്നും പരിശുദ്ധനും മഹത്വമേറിയവനുമായ അല്ലാഹുവെന്ന് ഉദ്ദേശം.

english_name.name: At-Tayyib
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿At-Tayyib (The Good) means that Allah Almighty is extolled and exalted far above all deficiencies and defects.

translations.name: അൽ-അഅ്'ലാ (സർവ്വോന്നതൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-അഅ്'ലാ: ഔന്നത്യത്തിൻ്റെ എല്ലാ നിലക്കുമുള്ള അർത്ഥങ്ങൾ അല്ലാഹുവിന് സ്ഥിരപ്പെടുത്തുന്ന നാമം. (അല്ലാഹു എല്ലാത്തിനും മുകളിലാണ് എന്ന) അസ്തിത്വപരമായ ഔന്നത്യവും, (എല്ലാ വിശേഷണങ്ങളിലും അവൻ ഏറ്റവും മുകളിലാണ് എന്നറിയിക്കുന്ന) മഹത്വങ്ങളിലുള്ള ഔന്നത്യവും, (എല്ലാവരും അല്ലാഹുവിൻ്റെ അധീശത്വത്തിന് കീഴിലാണെന്ന് അറിയിക്കുന്ന) അധികാരത്തിൻ്റെ ഔന്നത്യവും അല്ലാഹുവിനാണ് ഉള്ളത്.

english_name.name: Al-A‘la
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-A‘la (The Most High) is a name that denotes the affirmation of all meanings of highness for Allah Almighty from every aspect: highness in His essence, highness in His status, and highness in His power.

translations.name: അൽ-ഖദീർ (സർവ്വശക്തൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഖദീർ: പരിപൂർണ്ണ ശക്തിയുള്ളവൻ. അവന് ഒരിക്കലും അശക്തിയോ തളർച്ചയോ ബാധിക്കുകയില്ല.

english_name.name: Al-Qadīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qadīr (The Omnipotent) is the One Who possesses complete power and does not suffer any incapability or fatigue.

translations.name: അൽ-മന്നാൻ (അനുഗ്രഹ വാരിധി)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മന്നാൻ: അനുഗ്രഹം ചൊരിയുകയും, ദാനം നൽകുകയും, മഹത്തരമായ ഔദാര്യങ്ങൾ ചൊരിയുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ. അനുഗ്രഹങ്ങൾ ചോദിക്കുന്നതിന് മുൻപ് തന്നെ അവൻ ധാരാളമായി (അടിമകൾക്ക് മേൽ) കോരിച്ചൊരിയുന്നു.

english_name.name: Al-Mannān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mannān (The Bestower of Favors) is the One Who bestows great favors and gives blessings to His servants before they ask for them.

translations.name: അൽ-മുഹീത്വ്: (സർവ്വതിനെയും വലയം ചെയ്തവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുഹീത്വ്: അല്ലാഹു സർവ്വതിൻ്റെയും മുകളിൽ ഔന്നത്യമുള്ളവനും, അവൻ്റെ അറിവിനാലും ശക്തിയാലും അധീശത്വത്താലും സർവ്വതിനെയും അവൻ വലയം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നുമറിയിക്കുന്ന നാമം.

english_name.name: Al-Muhīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhīt (The All-Encompassing) is a name that denotes the exaltedness of Allah above His creation and that He encompasses everything in terms of knowledge, power, and subjugation.

translations.name: അൽ-അക്റം (അങ്ങേയറ്റം ഔദാര്യം ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-അക്റം: ധാരാളമായി നന്മ ചൊരിയുന്നവനും ഔദാര്യം വർഷിക്കുന്നവനും. അവൻ്റെ കയ്യിലാകുന്നു സർവ്വ നന്മകളുമുള്ളത്. അവനിൽ നിന്നാകുന്നു എല്ലാ നന്മകളും വരുന്നതും.

english_name.name: Al-Akram
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Akram (The Most Generous) is the One Who gives generously, and all goodness lies in His hand and comes from Him.

translations.name: അൽ-ഇലാഹ് (യഥാർഥ ആരാധ്യൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഇലാഹ്: പൂർണ്ണതയുടെയും പ്രതാപത്തിൻ്റെയും വിശേഷണങ്ങൾ ഉള്ളവൻ. ആരാധനക്ക് അർഹതയുള്ള ഏക ആരാധ്യൻ; അവന് പുറമെ മറ്റൊരാൾക്കും ആരാധിക്കപ്പെടാനുള്ള അർഹതയില്ല.

english_name.name: Al-Ilāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ilāh (The God) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection and majesty and Who alone is worthy of being worshiped.

translations.name: അന്നസ്വീർ (അങ്ങേയറ്റം സഹായിക്കുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അന്നസ്വീർ: അല്ലാഹുവിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ച തൻ്റെ ദാസന്മാരെ പിന്തുണക്കുകയും സഹായിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: An-Nasīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿An-Nasīr (The Helper) is the One Who helps and supports His believing servants.

translations.name: അൽ-മൗലാ (വിശ്വാസികളെ ഏറ്റെടുത്തവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മൗലാ: സൃഷ്ടികളുടെ ആശ്രയവും ഉടമസ്ഥനും യഥാർത്ഥ ആരാധ്യനുമാണ് അല്ലാഹു എന്നാണ് സൃഷ്ടികളുടെയെല്ലാം മൗലാ ആണ് അവൻ എന്ന് പറയുന്നതിൻ്റെ അർത്ഥം. മുഅ്മിനീങ്ങളുടെ മൗലാ എന്നത് കൊണ്ട് ഉദ്ദേശിക്കുന്നത്, അല്ലാഹുവിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ച ദാസന്മാരെ സ്നേഹിക്കുകയും, അവർക്ക് നന്മയിലേക്ക് വഴിയൊരുക്കുകയും, അവരെ സഹായിക്കുകയും, അവർക്ക് പ്രയോജനകരമായത് എത്തിച്ചു നൽകുകയും, ഐഹികവും പാരത്രികവുമായ നന്മകളിലേക്ക് അവർക്ക് എളുപ്പം നൽകുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവനാണ് അവൻ എന്നാണ്.

english_name.name: Al-Mawla
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mawla (The Protector) of all creation is their Master, Owner, Creator, and True Deity worthy of worship; and Al-Mawla of the believing servants is the One Who loves them, guides and supports them, and leads them to their religious and worldly interests.

translations.name: അൽ-ഹയിയ്യ് (അതീവ ലജ്ജയുള്ളവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-ഹയിയ്യ്: അങ്ങേയറ്റം ലജ്ജയുള്ളവൻ. സൃഷ്ടികളുടെ ലജ്ജ പോലെയല്ല അല്ലാഹുവിൻ്റെ ലജ്ജ; അത് അല്ലാഹുവിന് യോജിച്ച രൂപത്തിലാണ് മനസ്സിലാക്കേണ്ടത്. അവൻ്റെ വിശാലമായ കാരുണ്യത്തിനും, പൂർണ്ണമായ ഔദാര്യത്തിനും ഉദാരതക്കും, മഹത്തരമായ ക്ഷമക്കും പൊറുക്കലിനും യോജിക്കാത്തവ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കുക എന്നതാണ് അല്ലാഹുവിൻ്റെ ലജ്ജ കൊണ്ടുള്ള വിവക്ഷ.

english_name.name: Al-Hayiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayiyy (The Modest) is the One Who is very modest. This description befits Allah Almighty and it is nothing like the modesty of people. Rather, it means abandoning what does not suit His vast mercy, perfect generosity, and great forgiveness and forbearance.

translations.name: അൽ-മുഹ്സിൻ (നന്മകൾ വാരിച്ചൊരിയുന്നവൻ)
translations.short_meaning_val: അൽ-മുഹ്സിൻ: തൻ്റെ അടിമകൾക്ക് മേൽ പ്രകടവും പരോക്ഷവുമായ അനേകതരം അനുഗ്രഹങ്ങൾ ഔദാര്യമായി ചൊരിയുന്നവൻ.

english_name.name: Al-Muhsin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhsin (The Superb Benevolent) is the One Who bestows all kinds of outward and inward favors upon His servants.

translations.name: అల్లాహ్.
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్లాహ్ :- ప్రేమ,నమ్మకం,భక్తితో న్యాయంగా ఆరాధించే ఆరాధ్య దైవం,సమస్త అల్లాహ్ నామాలఅర్థాన్ని ఇది తనలో ఇముడ్చుకున్నది,మరియు ఇది సర్వశక్తిమంతుడైన అల్లాహ్'దేవుని' ఇతర అన్నీ లక్షణాలను కలిగి ఉంది.

english_name.name: Allāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Allah is the deity worthy of being worshiped out of love, hope, and fear. This name encompasses all the meanings of the beautiful names and attributes of the Almighty Lord.

translations.name: అర్రహ్’మాను:- అనంత కరుణామయుడు.
translations.short_meaning_val: అర్రహ్మాను’కరుణామయుడు:సమస్తాన్ని ఆవరించి ఉన్నమహోన్నత,విశాల,కరుణామయుడు.

english_name.name: Ar-Rahmān
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahmān (The Most Compassionate) is the One with great and immense mercy that encompasses everything.

translations.name: అర్రహీమ్-అపార కృపాశీలుడు.
translations.short_meaning_val: అర్రహీమ్:-మహకృపాశీలుడు,మృతులకు సంభందించినది.

english_name.name: Ar-Rahīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Ar-Rahīm (The Most Merciful) is the One with great mercy.

translations.name: అల్-మలికు:-విశ్వసార్వభౌముడు
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్-మలికు:- ఇది గొప్పతనం,ఆధిక్యత మరియు ప్రణాళిక వంటి లక్షణాలతో వివరించబడింది, సమస్త వస్తువులకు యజమాని,మరియు ఎలాంటి హెచ్చుతగ్గులు లేకుండా అమలుపర్చే అధికారి.

english_name.name: Al-Malik
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Malik (The King) is the One Who possesses the attributes of majesty, subjugation, and managing of affairs, and Who owns and disposes of everything without any difficulty.

translations.name: అల్-ఖుద్దూస్-పరమపవిత్రుడు.
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్-ఖుద్దూస్:- సమస్త దోషాలకు మరియు సృష్టిజీవుల పోలికకు ఆయన మహోన్నతుడు,పరిశుద్దుడు.

english_name.name: Al-Quddūs
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Quddūs (The Holy One) is the Glorified One Who is exalted far above any defect and far above resembling any of His creation.

translations.name: అల్-సలాము:- శాంతికిమూలాధారి
translations.short_meaning_val: అస్సలాము: సమస్త లోపాలకు,బలహీనతలకు మరియు దోషాలకు అతీతుడు.

english_name.name: As-Salām
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ As-Salām (The Source of Perfection) is the One free from any defect or fault.

translations.name: అల్ ము'మిను- శాంతిప్రధాత
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్-ము'మిను:-ఆయన సత్యవంతుడు!తన ప్రవక్తలకోసం సూచనలను,అద్భుతాలను స్థాపించి’సత్యపరుస్తాడు,మరియు సృష్టితాలను సకల ఆపదలు మరియు యాతనల నుండి కాపాడి శాంతిని ప్రసాదిస్తాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Mu’min
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Mu’min (The Bestower of Faith and Security) is the One Who confirms the truthfulness of His prophets through signs and miracles, and He is the One Who secures His servants from injustice, on account of His perfect justice.

translations.name: అల్ ముహైమిను.
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ ముహైమిను-అంటే సృష్టిని నిర్మించేవాడు,వారిని పాలించువాడు,వారిపట్ల అధికారం చెలాయించువాడు,సమస్తవిషయాలను జ్ఞానపరంగా ఆవరించి ఉన్నవాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Muhaymin
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muhaymin (The All-Controller) is the Guardian over His creation, their Ruler, and the Disposer of all their affairs, Who encompasses everything in His knowledge.

translations.name: అల్ అజీజు.
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ అజీజు:- పూర్తిగౌరవము ఆయనకు మాత్రమే అంకితం,తన శక్తి,ఆధిక్యత మరియు సంయమనం ద్వారా ప్రతీదాన్ని లొంగతీసుకున్నాడు.

english_name.name: Al-‘Azīz
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azīz (The All-Mighty) is the One Who possesses the absolute might and vanquishes all others with His power, dominance, and invincibility.

translations.name: అల్-జబ్బారు.
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్-జబ్బారు:- తన సృష్టి పట్ల మహోన్నతుడు,ప్రతీదాన్ని నియంత్రించువాడు,సమస్తం ఆయన వైపుకు మోకరిల్లుతుంది,సమస్తము ఆయనకు అనుకువ చూపుతుంది మరియు ఆయనను ఆశ్రయించేవారి వ్యవహారాలను సరిచేస్తాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Jabbār
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.
english_name.meanings_val: ﻿ Al-Jabbār (The Compeller) is the One far exalted above His creation, Who controls everything and to Whom all things are subdued and submitted. He is also the One Who supports those who seek refuge in Him.

translations.name: అల్-ముతకబ్బిర్:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్-ముతకబ్బిర్:-చెడు,లోపం మరియు దోషం నుండి సంపూర్ణంగా అత్యున్నతుడు మరియు గొప్పవాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Mutakabbir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mutakabbir (The Supreme) is the One Who is far exalted above evil, deficiency, and defects, given His perfection and majesty.

translations.name: అల్ ఖాలికు;-సమస్త సృష్టికి కర్త.
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ ఖాలికు:-వస్తువులకు ఉనికిని ప్రసాదించువాడు,ఎటువంటి పూర్వప్రణాళిక,నమూనా లేకుండా ఆవిష్కరించువాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Khāliq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khāliq (The Creator) is the One Who brings things into existence and invents them in an unprecedented way.

translations.name: అల్-బారి.
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్-బారిఉ:-సృష్టించినవాడు,ఆయనే సర్వాన్ని పుట్టించాడు,రూపు దిద్దాడు,లేని దానికి ఉనికి పోసినవాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Bāri’
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Bāri’ (The Initiator) is the Creator Who created the whole creation from nothing and gave them forms after they were non-existent.

translations.name: అల్ ముసవ్విర్:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ ముసవ్విర్:- ఆయనే’వేర్వేరు ముఖచిత్రాలలో,విభిన్న శరీరాలతో తన సృష్టిని సృష్టించాడు,ఇది ఆయన యొక్క సంపూర్ణ జ్ఞానాన్ని మరియు వివేకాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది.

english_name.name: Al-Musawwir
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Musawwir (The Supreme Fashioner) is the One Who fashioned His creation in different forms and appearances that indicate His perfect knowledge and wisdom.

english_name.name: Al-Ghaffaar
english_name.short_meaning_val:
AL-Ghaffaar (The Great Forgiver)

The Forgiver, The One who forgives the sins of His slaves time and time again

english_name.name: Al-Qahhār
english_name.short_meaning_val: THE ALL-PREVAILING ONE
english_name.meanings_val: <p><span style="font-size: 19px; color: #202122; font-weight: normal; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Arial'; font-style: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none;">The Dominant, The One who has the perfect Power and is not unable over anything.</span></p>

translations.name: అల్ వహ్హాబు:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ వహ్హాబు:-ఆయనే విస్తృతంగా కానుకలు,బహుమతులు ఒసగేవాడు,తన ఔదార్యం మరియు దాతృత్వంతో ఆయనే సమస్తసృష్టిజీవులను చేర్చాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Wahhāb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wahhāb (The Bestower) is the One Who gives abundantly, and Whose generosity and bounty encompass all beings.

translations.name: అల్ రజ్జాక్:
translations.short_meaning_val: ﻿అల్ రజ్జాక్:- దాసుల జీవనోపాధికి బాధ్యత వహించేవాడు,ఆ ఉపాధి ద్వారానే వారిహృదయాలు మరియు శరీరాలు బలాన్నిపొందుతాయి.

english_name.name: Ar-Razzāq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ar-Razzāq (The All-Provider) is the One Who guarantees His servants the sustenance that maintains their hearts and bodies.

translations.name: అల్ ఫత్తాహు:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ ఫత్తాహు:-తన ఆరాధకుల మధ్య తన చట్టపరమైన తీర్పుల ప్రకారం పరిపాలించేవాడు మరియు వారిలో తన తక్దీర్’విధి తీర్పులను నిర్ణయిస్తాడు మరియు తన నేరపూరిత నిబంధనలతో వారిని శిక్షిస్తాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Fattāh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿ Al-Fattāh (The Greatest Judge) is the One Who judges between His servants by His religious rulings, decrees His predestination for them, and calls them to account.

translations.name: అల్ అలీము:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ అలీము:-తన జ్ఞానముతో సమస్తాన్ని ఆవరించి చుట్టుముట్టి ఉన్నాడు.

english_name.name: Al-‘Alīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alīm (The All-Knowing) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses everything.

english_name.name: Al-Qaabid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE RESTRICTING ONE

The Constrictor, The Withholder, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Baasit
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE EXTENDER

The Englarger, The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His Generosity and Mercy.

english_name.name: Al-Khaafid
english_name.short_meaning_val:
THE REDUCER

The One who lowers whoever He willed by His Destruction and raises whoever He willed by His Endowment.

translations.name: అర్రాఫి'ఉ
translations.short_meaning_val: అర్రాఫిఉ :- ఆయనే తను కోరినవారిని,కోరినవిధంగా గౌరవంతో ఎత్తుతాడు,ప్రపంచంలో,పరలోకంలో తన ఔలియాలను ఎత్తినట్లుగా.

english_name.name: Ar-Rāfi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Rāfi‘ (The Raiser) is the One Who raises whomever He wills the way He wills, as He elevates the ranks of His pious servants in this world and in the Hereafter.

translations.name: అస్సమీ’ఉ :
translations.short_meaning_val: అస్సమీ’ఉ :- సమస్త శబ్దాలను గ్రహించేవాడు,ఆయన గోప్యాలను,రహస్యాలను వింటాడు,అది బహిర్గతంగా, అంతర్గతంగా,సంభాషించినా,మౌనంవహించినా’సరే!

english_name.name: As-Samī‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samī‘ (The All-Hearing) is the One Who hears everything. He hears secret and private talk. Loud and low voices, and speaking and silence are all the same to Him - He grasps all.

translations.name: అల్ బసీరు
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్-బసీరు:-ప్రతి దానిని’అది ఎంత చిన్నదైన,రేణువైన కంటి చూపుతో చుట్టుముట్టినవాడు,విషయాలపై అంతర్దృష్టి కలవాడు,సర్వ విషయాలకు నిపుణుడు,అంతర్గత పరిజ్ఞానం కలవాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Basīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Basīr (The All-Seeing) is the One Whose sight encompasses everything, no matter how small or minute they may be, and He is the One Who is All-Aware of everything and All-Knowing of their hidden aspects.

translations.name: అల్ హకమ్:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ హకమ్:- ఆయన వైపుకు ప్రతీఆదేశం,తీర్పు మరలుతుంది,మరియు అతను కోరుకున్నది ఆదేశిస్తాడు,తన దాసుల మధ్య సత్యంతో,న్యాయంతో పరిపాలిస్తాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Hakam
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakam (The Judge) is the One to Whom belongs judgment in all things, and Who ordains what He wills and judges between His servants with the truth and justice.

translations.name: అల్-లతీఫు.
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ లతీఫు:-ఆయన వద్ద సుక్ష్మాతి సూక్ష్మవిషయాలు కూడా దాగలేవు, తనదాసుల పట్ల మృధువైఖరిని అవలంబిస్తాడు మరియు వారిని సంస్కరించదలిచినప్పుడు వారికి శుభాలను ప్రసాదిస్తాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Latīf
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Latīf (The All-Subtle) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, no matter how small it may be, and the One Who shows kindness and leniency to His servants and guides them to what is good for them.

translations.name: అల్ ఖబీర్:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ ఖబీర్:- ఆయన తన జ్ఞానముతో వస్తువుల ఆంతరంగాన్నిమరియు రహస్యాలను వాటి బహిర్గతను చుట్టిముట్టినట్లు ఆవరించియున్నాడు

english_name.name: Al-Khabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Khabīr (The All-Aware) is the One Whose knowledge encompasses the inward and hidden aspects of things, as well as their outward aspects.

translations.name: అల్-హలీము:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్-హలీము:- సహనశీలుడు,తన దాసులను వారి పాపాలకు బదులుగా శిక్షించడంలో తొందరపడనివాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Halīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Halīm (The Forbearing) is the One Who possesses deliberation and does not hasten to punish His servants for their sins.

translations.name: అల్ అజీము:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్-అజీము :-హృదయాలు ప్రేమించే,ఆత్మలు గొప్పగా భావించే సమస్త పరిపూర్ణ గుణాలను,కీర్తి,గర్వము మరియు గొప్పతనం వంటి లక్షణాలను ఇముడ్చుకున్నవాడు.

english_name.name: Al-‘Azhīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Azhīm (The Magnificent) is the One Who possesses all attributes of perfection, glory, pride, and majesty, and Who is loved and extolled by His servants.

translations.name: అల్ గఫూరు.
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ గఫూరు:-ఆయన తన దాసులను వారి పాపాల నుండి రక్షిస్తాడు మరియు ఆ చర్యలపై వారిని శిక్షించడు.

english_name.name: Al-Ghafūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Ghafūr (The All-Forgiving) is the One Who spares His servants the evil of their sins and does not punish them.

translations.name: అష్షుకూర్
translations.short_meaning_val: అష్శుకూర్ :-అతితక్కువ కార్యాసాధనపై రెట్టింపు పుణ్యఫలాన్ని ప్రసాదిస్తాడు,మరియు అనేక తప్పులను ఆయన క్షమిస్తాడు.

english_name.name: Ash-Shakūr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shakūr (The Most Appreciative) is the One Who appreciates even little deeds and gives immense and multiple rewards in return, and Who forgives numerous errors.

translations.name: అల్ అలీ:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ అలీ: ఆయనకు మాత్రమే సంపూర్ణ మహోన్నత ప్రతీకోణంలో చెందుతుంది:అనగా“సామర్థ్యపు ఆధిక్యత మరియు అస్తిత్వమహోన్నతలో చెందుతుంది

english_name.name: Al-‘Alyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-‘Alyy (The High) is the One Who possesses absolute highness in all aspects: His status, His power, and His essence.

translations.name: అల్ కబీర్:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ కబీర్:- సమస్తానికి ఆయనే పెద్ద,ఆయన కంటే పెద్దది మరొకటిలేదు.

english_name.name: Al-Kabīr
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Kabīr (The Great) is the One Who is greater than everything, and all else are inferior to Him.

translations.name: అల్ హఫీజ్ :
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ హఫీజ్ :- ఆయనే సృష్టించినదాన్ని రక్షిస్తాడు,ఉనికిని ప్రసాదించివాటిని జ్ఞానంతో చుట్టుముట్టాడు,మరియు తన మిత్రులను పాపాలనుండి వినాశకాలలో పడకుండా కాపాడుతాడు,మరియు దాసుల కార్యాచరణలను లెక్కించి ఆ పరంగా ప్రతిఫలం నొసగుతాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Hafīzh
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hafīzh (The All-Preserver) is the One Who preserves what He created; Whose knowledge encompasses all that He brought into existence; Who protects His pious servants from committing sins and ruinous acts; and Who records their deeds and the recompense for them.

translations.name: అల్ ముఖీతు
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ ముఖీతు:- ఆయనే సృష్టిజీవులకు తన జ్ఞానం ప్రకారం శక్తిని నిర్దారిస్తాడు,ఆపై దాన్ని వాటికి తన శక్తితో చేరవేస్తాడు,మరియు దాన్ని వారి మధ్య విభజిస్తాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Muqīt
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Muqīt (The All-Nourisher) is the One Who determines the sustenance of His creation according to His knowledge, brings it to them with His power, and distributes it amongst them.

translations.name: అల్ హసీబు.
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ హసీబు:- తనను విశ్వసించే దాసులకు మరియు,తవక్కలు వహించు దాసులకొరకు సరిపోయేవాడు,తనదాసుల కార్యక్రమాల పట్ల జ్ఞానం కలిగినవాడు మరియు ఆ ప్రకారం వారితో లెక్కతీసుకునేవాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Hasīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hasīb (The Ever-Reckoner) is the One Who grants sufficiency to His believing servants who rely upon Him, and Who knows their deeds and holds them accountable for them.

translations.name: అల్ కరీము.
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ కరీము:-అత్యధికంగా మేలు చేసేవాడు,గొప్పగా ప్రయోజనం చేకూర్చువాడు

english_name.name: Al-Karīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Karīm (The Generous) is the One Who gives abundant good and welfare.

translations.name: అర్రఖీబు:
translations.short_meaning_val: అర్రఖీబు:-ప్రతీవస్తువు యొక్క అవగాహన కలిగినవాడు;రహస్యాలను మరియు మనస్సాక్షి గురించి సాక్ష్యామిచ్చువాడు,ఆయన అన్నీ తెలిసినవాడు,చూసేవాడు,ఆయనతో ఎటువంటి రహస్యం మరియు గోప్యము’దాచలేము.

english_name.name: Ar-Raqīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Raqīb (The Ever-Watchful) is the One Who watches over everything and witnesses inner thoughts and secrets, and Who knows and sees all things and no secret or private talk is hidden from Him.

translations.name: అల్ ముజీబు:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ ముజీబు:- ఆయనే అర్ధించేవారి సమస్యలను మరియు వేడుకునే వారి దు’ఆ లను స్వీకరిస్తాడు,ఆమోదిస్తాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Mujīb
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Mujīb (The All-Responsive) is the One Who responds to supplications by answering them and to requests by fulfilling them.

translations.name: అల్-వాసిఉ:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్-వాసిఉ:-ఆయన కొరకు ప్రతీలక్షణము చెందుతుంది,అర్ధం-పరిపూర్ణం,సామర్థ్యం మరియు సంపూర్ణం.

english_name.name: Al-Wāsi‘
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāsi‘ (The All-Embracing) is the One to Whom belongs the most perfect and complete meaning of every attribute.

translations.name: అల్ హకీమ్-వివేకవంతుడు
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ హకీము:-తన ఆదేశాలలో మరియు చట్టాలలో సంపూర్ణజ్ఞానం కలవాడు,మరియు తన జీవులలో తీర్పుఅధికారం పరిపూర్ణంగాకలవాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Hakīm
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hakīm (The All-Wise) is the One Who possesses perfect wisdom in His commands and legislations, and perfect judgment between His creation.

translations.name: అల్ వదూదు:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ వదూదు:- అనగా ప్రియమైనవారిని ప్రేమించువాడు,ఆయనే’తనప్రవక్తలను,సందేశహరులను,వారి అనుచరులను’ మరియు తన అభిమానులను’ప్రేమిస్తాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Wadūd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wadūd (The Most Affectionate) is the One Who loves and is loved. He loves His prophets and messengers and their followers, and they love Him.

translations.name: అల్ మజీదు:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ మజీదు:-పరిపూర్ణగుణాల్లోని వివిధరకాలైన మహోన్నతమైన,విశాలమైన’లక్షణాలను కలిగి ఉన్నాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Majīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Majīd (The Most Glorious) is the One Who possesses the various attributes of supreme majesty and perfection.

translations.name: అష్షహీదు.
translations.short_meaning_val: అష్షహీదు:-ఆయన నుండి ఏ విషయం దాగదు, ఆయన ప్రతీవస్తువును గ్రహిస్తున్నవాడు,దానితో ఉంటాడు,దాని సర్వం వివరాలు తెలిసి ఉంటాడు.

english_name.name: Ash-Shahīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Ash-Shahīd (The Ever-Witness) is the One from Whom nothing is hidden, rather He knows and witnesses everything and is Aware of its details.

translations.name: అల్ హక్కు:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ హక్కు:- ఆయన ఉనికి మరియు అస్తిత్వం సత్యపరుస్తుంది,మరియు ఆయన నామాలు,గుణాలు మరియు’కార్యక్రమాలు,ఆదేశాలు,ప్రతిఫలాలు,సమస్తము పరిపూర్ణమైనవి మరియు సత్యమైనవి,అందులో ఎలాంటి అసత్యానికి తావులేదు.

english_name.name: Al-Haqq
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Haqq (The Truth) is the True One in terms of His being and His existence; and the One Whose names, attributes, actions, judgments, and recompense are all perfect and true.

translations.name: అల్ వకీలు
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ వకీలు:- తన సృష్టిజీవనోపాధికి సంరక్షకుడు,వారి ప్రయోజనాలకు బాధ్యుడు,మరియు ఆయనే తన మిత్రులను నియమిస్తాడు వారికి సౌలభ్యాన్ని ప్రసాదిస్తాడు,కష్టకారకాల నుండి రక్షిస్తాడు, వారి వ్యవహారాలకు సరిపోతాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Wakīl
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wakīl (The Trustee) is the One Who guarantees the sustenance of His creation and manages their affairs and maintains their welfare; and Who supports His pious servants and, thus, guides them to ease, grants them sufficiency, and keeps them away from difficulty.

translations.name: అల్ ఖవియ్యు:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ ఖవియ్యు:- సర్వ శక్తిమంతుడు,ఆయన పై ఎవడు ఆధిక్యాన్ని పొందలేడు,ఆయన తీర్పును ఎవరు దిక్కరించలేడు.

english_name.name: Al-Qawiyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Qawiyy (The All-Powerful) is the One with complete power Who cannot be overcome and Whose predestination cannot be repelled.

translations.name: అల్ మతీను:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ మతీను:- శక్తి సామర్థ్యాలలో అత్యంత బలవంతుడు,ఎటువంటి బలహీనత,కష్టము కలుగనివాడు.

english_name.name: Al-Matīn
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Matīn (The Most Firm) is the One Who possesses infinite power and ability so He never experiences any weakness or hardship.

translations.name: అల్ వలియ్యు .
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ వలియ్యు:- తన మోమిను దాసులకు మద్దతుదారుడు,మరియు తన సమస్తజీవుల వ్యవహారాలకు ఆధారభూతుడు.

english_name.name: Al-Walyy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Walyy (The Guardian) is the One Who supports His believing servants and manages the affairs of all His creation.

translations.name: అల్ హమీదు.
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ హమీదు:- ఈ పేరు సమస్త పొగడ్తలు,నైపుణ్యాలు కేవలం మహోన్నతుడైన అల్లాహ్ కొరకు సూచిస్తుంది,ఆయనే ఈ పొగడ్తలకు,నైపుణ్యాలకు అస్తిత్వ,లక్షణాల మరియు కార్యక్రమాల పరంగా హక్కుదారుడు.

english_name.name: Al-Hamīd
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hamīd (The Praiseworthy) is a name that denotes all the praiseworthy and perfect attributes of Allah Almighty, Who deserves praise for the perfection of His essence, names, attributes, and actions.

translations.name: అల్ హయ్యు:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ హయ్యు:- సంపూర్ణజీవనం యొక్క సమస్త అర్థాలు ఆయనకు చెందుతాయి,ఆయనకు పూర్వం శూన్యం లేదు,మరియు ఆయనకు అంతంలేదు.

english_name.name: Al-Hayy
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Hayy (The Ever-Living) is the One to Whom belong all meanings of perfect life that is not preceded by nothingness nor followed by doom.

translations.name: అల్ ఖయ్యూము:
translations.short_meaning_val: అల్ ఖయ్యూము:- స్వయంగా నిలబడినవాడు,ఎవరి అవసరం లేనివాడు,ప్రతీదీ ఆయనపై ఆధారపడి నిలబడుతుంది,ఆయన అవసరంలేకుండా ఎవ్వడూ ఉండడు.

english_name.name: Al-Qayyūm
english_name.short_meaning_val: Al-Qayyūm (The Self-Subsisting) is the One Who is self-sustaining, so He does not need anyone, and everything depends on Him and none can dispense with Him.

translations.name: అల్ వాహిదు :- ఒకేఒక్కడు.
translations.short_meaning_val: తన అస్తిత్వం,లక్షణాలు మరియు కార్యక్రమాలలో మరొక సాటిలేని ఒకేఒక్కడు.

english_name.name: Al-Wāhid
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿Al-Wāhid (The One) is the One Who alone possesses all perfection in His essence, attributes, and actions, and none shares any of this with Him.

translations.name: అస్సమదు
translations.short_meaning_val: అస్సమదు:-పరిపూర్ణప్రభువు మరియు గొప్పయజమాని,ప్రతీ అవసరములో ఆశతో,భయంతో తలుచుకోబడేవాడు.

english_name.name: As-Samad
english_name.short_meaning_val: ﻿As-Samad (The Eternal Refuge) is the Perfect Lord and the Magnificent Master to Whom everyone turns, out of hope and fear.

translations.name: అల్ ఖాదిరు:
